## Contratos por operação

Headers: Accept: application/json; Content-Type: application/json quando há body JSON. FileInterceptor identifica multipart e nome do arquivo no handler. SessionAuthGuard exige Authorization: Bearer <id-da-sessao>, token opaco. Não foram chamadas rotas autenticadas: o guard atualiza a sessão. Erros globais em [gai-backend/src/common/filters/http-exception.filter.ts:16](../../gai-backend/src/common/filters/http-exception.filter.ts#L16). Throttler global pode retornar 429, falhas inesperadas retornam 500 genérico. Códigos Swagger são declarados, não observados. Escopo de organização/projeto depende do serviço e das políticas; ver arquitetura-e-dados.md e auditoria-seguranca.md. Métodos auxiliares e repositórios não transcritos continuam disponíveis nos links de código. Não se considera o controller sozinho prova de funcionalidade.

Erros específicos no serviço transcrito e seus auxiliares; 400/401/403/404/409/429/500 são possibilidades condicionadas ao caminho de execução, não um conjunto garantido por rota.
- Persistência: mapa de entidades/tabelas por módulo em arquitetura-e-dados.md. Rastreio manual das rotas mobile em contratos-api.md; demais rotas são catálogo estático, sem validação individual de acesso ou persistência em execução.

```ts
@Get()
  @RequirePermissions('org_roles:read')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'Listar somente perfis concedíveis no contexto ativo',
  })
  list(
    @Query() query: AccessProfilesQuery,
    @Req() req: { user: AuthenticatedUser },
  ) {
    return this.profiles.list(
      {
        id: req.user.id,
        systemRoles: req.user.systemRoles,
        organizationId: req.user.organizationId,
      },
      query.organization_id,
    );
  }
```

<details><summary>Implementação chamada: AccessProfilesService.list</summary>

[gai-backend/src/modules/users/application/services/access-profiles.service.ts:29](../../gai-backend/src/modules/users/application/services/access-profiles.service.ts#L29)

```ts
async list(actor: ActorContext, requestedOrganizationId?: number) {
    const organizationId = this.scope.assertCanFilterByOrganization(
      actor,
      requestedOrganizationId,
    );
    if (organizationId !== undefined) {
      const organization = await this.db
        .getRepository(OrganizationEntity)
        .findOneBy({ id: organizationId, status: OrganizationStatus.ACTIVE });
      if (!organization)
        throw new NotFoundException({
          code: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: 'Active organization not found',
        });
    }
    const roles = await this.db.getRepository(RoleEntity).find({
      where:
        organizationId === undefined
          ? {
              type: RoleType.SYSTEM,
              key: UserRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN,
              organizationId: IsNull(),
              isActive: true,
            }
          : [
              {
                type: RoleType.SYSTEM,
                key: In([UserRole.ORG_ADMIN, UserRole.ORG_USER]),
                organizationId: IsNull(),
                isActive: true,
              },
              { type: RoleType.ORGANIZATION, organizationId, isActive: true },
            ],
      order: { type: 'DESC', name: 'ASC' },
    });
    const organizationalPermissions = await this.db
      .getRepository(PermissionEntity)
      .findBy({ scope: PermissionScope.ORGANIZATION });
    const result = await Promise.all(
      roles.map(async (role) => {
        const links = await this.db
          .getRepository(RolePermissionEntity)
          .findBy({ roleId: role.id });
        const permissions =
          role.key === UserRole.ORG_ADMIN
            ? organizationalPermissions
            : role.key === UserRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN
              ? await this.db.getRepository(PermissionEntity).find()
              : organizationalPermissions.filter((permission) =>
                  links.some(
                    (link) =>
                      Number(link.permissionId) === Number(permission.id),
                  ),
                );
        const count = await this.db
          .getRepository(UserRoleAssignmentEntity)
          .createQueryBuilder('assignment')
          .innerJoin(UserEntity, 'user', 'user.id = assignment.user_id')
          .select('COUNT(DISTINCT user.id)', 'total')
          .where(
            'assignment.role_id = :roleId AND assignment.is_active = 1 AND assignment.revoked_at IS NULL',
            { roleId: role.id },
          )
          .andWhere(
            organizationId === undefined
              ? 'user.organization_id IS NULL'
              : 'user.organization_id = :organizationId',
            { organizationId },
          )
          .getRawOne<{ total: string }>();
        return {
          id: Number(role.id),
          key: role.key,
          type: role.type,
          organization_id: organizationId ?? null,
          name:
            role.key === UserRole.ORG_ADMIN
              ? 'Administrador da organização'
              : role.key === UserRole.ORG_USER
                ? 'Usuário da organização'
                : role.key === UserRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN
                  ? 'Administrador da plataforma'
                  : role.name,
          description:
            role.key === UserRole.ORG_ADMIN
              ? 'Possui acesso administrativo aos recursos e configurações da organização, incluindo gerenciamento de usuários e perfis.'
              : role.key === UserRole.ORG_USER
                ? 'Perfil básico de acesso à organização, com funcionalidades definidas pelas permissões efetivamente associadas.'
                : role.description,
          user_count: Number(count?.total ?? 0),
          permission_count: permissions.length,
          access_areas: [
            ...new Set(permissions.map((permission) => permission.resource)),
          ],
          administrative:
            role.type === RoleType.SYSTEM &&
            [UserRole.ORG_ADMIN, UserRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN].includes(
              role.key as UserRole,
            ),
          editable: role.type === RoleType.ORGANIZATION,
        };
      }),
    );
    return result;
  }
```

```ts
@Post('activation/confirm')
  @HttpCode(200)
  @Throttle({ default: { limit: 5, ttl: 60000 } })
  activate(@Body() dto: PasswordResetConfirmDto, @Req() req: Request) {
```

<details><summary>Implementação chamada: CredentialTransactionsService.consumeToken</summary>

[gai-backend/src/modules/auth/application/services/credential-transactions.service.ts:275](../../gai-backend/src/modules/auth/application/services/credential-transactions.service.ts#L275)

```ts
async consumeToken(
    raw: string,
    password: string,
    purpose: 'INVITATION' | 'PASSWORD_RESET',
    ipAddress: string | null,
  ) {
    const hash = await this.hasher.hash(Password.create(password).getValue());
    const tokenHash = createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex');
    const candidate = await this.db
      .getRepository(PasswordResetTokenEntity)
      .findOneBy({ tokenHash, purpose });
    if (!candidate) throw this.invalid();
    await identityTransaction(this.db, async (manager) => {
      const user = await lockUser(manager, candidate.userId);
      const token = await manager
        .getRepository(PasswordResetTokenEntity)
        .findOneBy({ id: candidate.id, tokenHash, purpose, usedAt: IsNull() });
      if (!user || !token || token.expiresAt <= new Date())
        throw this.invalid();
      if (
        purpose === 'INVITATION'
          ? user.status !== UserStatus.PENDING_ACTIVATION
          : ![UserStatus.ACTIVE, UserStatus.LOCKED].includes(user.status)
      )
        throw this.invalid();
      await this.assertEligible(manager, user, purpose === 'INVITATION');
      if (purpose === 'INVITATION') user.status = UserStatus.ACTIVE;
      await this.replacePassword(manager, user, hash);
      await manager.getRepository(AuthAuditLogEntity).save({
        userId: user.id,
        operation:
          purpose === 'INVITATION'
            ? AuthAuditOperation.INVITATION_ACTIVATED
            : AuthAuditOperation.PASSWORD_RESET_CONFIRM,
        ipAddress,
        result: AuthAuditResult.SUCCESS,
      });
    });
    return {
      message:
        purpose === 'INVITATION'
          ? 'Conta ativada. Entre com sua senha.'
          : 'Senha redefinida. Entre novamente.',
    };
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async execute(dto: LoginDto, ip: string | null): Promise<LoginResponseDto> {
    const { user, session } = await this.credentials.authenticate(
      dto.identifier,
      dto.password,
      ip,
```

```ts
async execute(
    sessionId: string,
    userId: number,
    ipAddress: string | null,
  ): Promise<void> {
    const session = await this.sessions.findById(sessionId);
    if (!session || session.revokedAt) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException({
        code: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
        message: 'Invalid or expired session',
      });
    }

    await this.sessions.revoke(sessionId, new Date());

    await this.audit.save({
      userId,
      operation: AuthAuditOperation.LOGOUT,
      ipAddress,
      result: AuthAuditResult.SUCCESS,
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'LOGOUT',
      userId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });
  }
```

```ts
async execute(userId: number): Promise<CurrentUserDto> {
    const user = await this.users.findById(userId);
    if (!user) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException({
        code: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
        message: 'Invalid or expired session',
      });
    }

    return CurrentUserDto.fromUser({
      id: user.id,
      fullName: user.fullName,
      mustChangePassword: user.mustChangePassword,
      login: user.login,
      email: user.email,
      status: user.status,
      organizationId: user.organizationId,
      roleAssignments: roleAssignments.map((assignment) =>
        RoleAssignmentResponseDto.fromAssignedRole(assignment),
      ),
      permissions: user.mustChangePassword
        ? []
        : await this.permissions.resolveForUser(user.id),
    });
  }
```

```ts
async changeOwnPassword(
    userId: number,
    sessionId: string,
    current: string,
    next: string,
  ) {
    const hash = await this.hasher.hash(Password.create(next).getValue());
    await identityTransaction(this.db, async (manager) => {
      const user = await lockUser(manager, userId);
      const session = await manager
        .getRepository(SessionEntity)
        .findOneBy({ id: sessionId, revokedAt: IsNull() });
      if (
        !user ||
        !session ||
        session.authVersion !== user.authVersion ||
        session.expiresAt <= new Date() ||
        (user.mustChangePassword &&
          user.temporaryPasswordExpiresAt !== null &&
          user.temporaryPasswordExpiresAt <= new Date())
      )
        throw this.invalid();
      if (!(await this.hasher.verify(current, user.passwordHash)))
        throw this.invalid();
      if (await this.hasher.verify(next, user.passwordHash))
        throw new BadRequestException({
          code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
          message: 'Escolha uma senha diferente da atual.',
        });
      await this.replacePassword(manager, user, hash);
      await manager.getRepository(AuthAuditLogEntity).save({
        userId,
        operation: AuthAuditOperation.PASSWORD_CHANGE,
        result: AuthAuditResult.SUCCESS,
      });
    });
    return { message: 'Senha alterada. Entre novamente para continuar.' };
  }
```

</details>

[gai-backend/src/modules/budgets/budget.service.ts:616](../../gai-backend/src/modules/budgets/budget.service.ts#L616)

```ts
async list(f: BudgetListDto, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    const q = this.ds
      .getRepository(BudgetEntity)
      .createQueryBuilder('b')
      .where('b.organization_id = :org', {
        org: this.org(actor, f.organization_id),
      });
    if (f.company_id)
      q.andWhere('b.company_id = :company', { company: f.company_id });
    if (f.project_id)
      q.andWhere('b.project_id = :project', { project: f.project_id });
    if (f.status) q.andWhere('b.status = :status', { status: f.status });
    if (f.search?.trim())
      q.andWhere("b.number LIKE :search ESCAPE '!'", {
        search: '%' + f.search.trim().replace(/[!%_]/g, '!$&') + '%',
      });
    const total = await q.getCount(),
      page = Math.min(f.page ?? 1, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / 20)));
    const rows = await q
      .orderBy('b.id', 'DESC')
      .skip((page - 1) * 20)
      .take(20)
      .getMany();
    const items = await Promise.all(
      rows.map(async (b) => ({
        ...b,
        current: b.headVersionId
          ? await this.ds.getRepository(BudgetVersionEntity).findOneBy({
              id: b.headVersionId,
              budgetId: b.id,
              organizationId: b.organizationId,
            })
          : null,
      })),
    );
    return { items, total, page, page_size: 20 };
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async create(dto: BudgetDataDto, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    const org = this.org(actor, dto.organization_id);
    return this.ds.transaction(async (m) => {
      await this.orgLock(m, org);
      if (
        await m.existsBy(BudgetEntity, {
          organizationId: org,
          number: dto.number.trim(),
        })
      )
        conflict('Número de orçamento já utilizado nesta organização.');
      const snapshot = await this.snapshot(m, org, dto, actor);
      const row = await m.save(
        BudgetEntity,
        m.create(BudgetEntity, {
          organizationId: org,
          companyId: dto.company_id,
          projectId: dto.project_id ?? null,
          number: dto.number.trim(),
          revision: 1,
          status: 'draft',
          headVersionId: null,
          approvedVersionId: null,
          createdAt: new Date(),
        }),
      );
      const version = await this.append(
        m,
        row,
        snapshot,
        actor,
        'Versão inicial',
        'Cadastro do orçamento',
        'draft',
        null,
      );
      row.headVersionId = version.id;
      await m.update(
        BudgetEntity,
        { id: row.id, organizationId: org },
        { headVersionId: version.id },
      );
      await this.audit(m, row, actor, 'create', 'Cadastro do orçamento', {
        version_id: version.id,
      });
      return row;
    });
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async proposal(id: number, actor: ProjectActorContext, conversion = false) {
    const row = await this.budget(this.ds.manager, id, actor);
    if (
      !['approved', 'archived'].includes(row.status) ||
      row.approvedVersionId == null
    )
      conflict('Prévia comercial exige orçamento aprovado.');
    if (conversion && row.status !== 'approved')
      conflict(
        'Orçamento arquivado não está disponível para futura conversão.',
      );
    const version = await this.versionById(
      this.ds.manager,
      row,
      row.approvedVersionId,
    );
    const s = version.snapshot;
    const preview = {
      budget_id: row.id,
      number: row.number,
      version: version.version,
      hash: version.hash,
      company: s.context.company,
      project: s.context.project,
      scope: s.input.scope,
      services: s.input.services,
      assets: s.input.estimated_assets,
      units: s.context.units,
      addresses: s.input.addresses,
      field_days: s.calculation.sizing.field_days,
      team: s.calculation.sizing.team,
      valid_until: s.input.valid_until,
      currency: s.calculation.currency,
      final_price: s.calculation.final_price,
      payment: s.calculation.payment,
    };
    if (!conversion) return preview;
    await this.require(actor, 'budgets:approve');
    return {
      ...preview,
      operation: 'preview_only',
      eligible_for_future_conversion: !!row.projectId,
      creates_contract: false,
      creates_project: false,
      creates_receivables: false,
      contract_draft: {
        project_id: row.projectId,
        company_id: row.companyId,
        original_value: preview.final_price,
        currency: preview.currency,
        segment: s.input.segment,
        services: preview.services,
        estimated_assets: preview.assets,
        scope: preview.scope,
        status: 'draft',
      },
      required_before_conversion: [
        'Número do contrato',
        'Data de contratação',
        'Vigência contratual',
        ...(row.projectId ? [] : ['Projeto da mesma empresa/organização']),
      ],
    };
  }
```

```ts
async addVersion(
    id: number,
    dto: BudgetVersionDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
    scenario: boolean,
  ) {
    return this.ds.transaction(async (m) => {
      const row = await this.budget(m, id, actor, true);
      this.revision(row, dto.revision, dto.reason);
      if (!scenario && !['draft', 'rejected'].includes(row.status))
        conflict(
          'Somente rascunhos ou rejeitados podem ser editados. Aprovados aceitam cenários independentes.',
        );
      if (
        row.companyId !== dto.company_id ||
        row.number !== dto.number.trim() ||
        row.projectId !== (dto.project_id ?? null)
      )
        invalid(
          'Empresa, projeto e número identificam o orçamento e não podem ser substituídos.',
        );
      const baseId = dto.base_version_id ?? row.headVersionId!;
      await this.versionById(m, row, baseId);
      const snapshot = await this.snapshot(m, row.organizationId, dto, actor);
      const version = await this.append(
        m,
        row,
        snapshot,
        actor,
        dto.name,
        dto.reason,
        scenario ? 'scenario' : 'draft',
        baseId,
      );
      row.revision++;
      if (!scenario) {
        row.headVersionId = version.id;
        row.status = 'draft';
      }
      const update = await m.update(
        BudgetEntity,
        {
          id: row.id,
          organizationId: row.organizationId,
          revision: dto.revision,
        },
        {
          revision: row.revision,
          headVersionId: row.headVersionId,
          status: row.status,
        },
      );
      if (update.affected !== 1)
        conflict('Revisão alterada por outra operação.');
      await this.audit(
        m,
        row,
        actor,
        scenario ? 'scenario' : 'edit',
        dto.reason,
        { version_id: version.id, base_version_id: baseId },
      );
      return row;
    });
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async transition(
    id: number,
    dto: BudgetTransitionDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.ds.transaction(async (m) => {
      const row = await this.budget(m, id, actor, true);
      this.revision(row, dto.revision, dto.reason);
      const allowed: Record<string, string[]> = {
        draft: ['review', 'archived'],
        review: ['draft', 'approved', 'rejected'],
        approved: ['archived'],
        rejected: ['draft', 'archived'],
        archived: [],
      };
      if (!allowed[row.status].includes(dto.status))
        conflict('Transição de orçamento não permitida.');
      if (
        dto.status === 'approved' ||
        dto.status === 'rejected' ||
        row.status === 'approved'
      )
        await this.require(actor, 'budgets:approve');
      else await this.require(actor, 'budgets:edit');
      const version = await this.versionById(m, row, dto.version_id);
      if (dto.status === 'approved' || dto.status === 'review') {
        if (
          !(await m.existsBy(CompanyEntity, {
            id: row.companyId,
            organizationId: row.organizationId,
          }))
        )
          conflict('Empresa não está mais disponível nesta organização.');
        if (row.projectId != null) {
          const project = await m.findOneBy(ProjectEntity, {
            id: row.projectId,
            companyId: row.companyId,
            organizationId: row.organizationId,
          });
          if (
            !project ||
            !ProjectStatusTransitionPolicy.allowsOperationalMutation(
              project.status,
            )
          )
            conflict('Projeto não está disponível para revisão/aprovação.');
        }
        if (
          !(await m.existsBy(UserEntity, {
            id: version.snapshot.input.responsible_id,
            organizationId: row.organizationId,
            status: UserStatus.ACTIVE,
          }))
        )
          conflict('Responsável não está mais ativo nesta organização.');
        for (const unitId of version.snapshot.input.unit_ids) {
          const unit = await m.findOneBy(CompanyUnitEntity, {
            id: unitId,
            organizationId: row.organizationId,
            companyId: row.companyId,
          });
          if (!unit || unit.status !== CompanyUnitStatus.ACTIVE)
            conflict(
              'Unidade não está mais disponível para revisão/aprovação.',
            );
        }
      }
      if (dto.status === 'approved') {
        if (row.headVersionId !== version.id)
          conflict(
            'A aprovação deve consolidar a versão enviada para revisão.',
          );
        if (
          version.snapshot.input.valid_until <
          new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
        )
          conflict('Proposta vencida. Crie uma nova versão antes de aprovar.');
        row.approvedVersionId = version.id;
      }
      const previous = row.status;
      row.status = dto.status;
      row.revision++;
      if (dto.status === 'review') row.headVersionId = version.id;
      const update = await m.update(
        BudgetEntity,
        {
          id: row.id,
          organizationId: row.organizationId,
          revision: dto.revision,
        },
        {
          revision: row.revision,
          status: row.status,
          headVersionId: row.headVersionId,
          approvedVersionId: row.approvedVersionId,
        },
      );
      if (update.affected !== 1)
        conflict('Revisão alterada por outra operação.');
      await this.audit(m, row, actor, 'transition', dto.reason, {
        from: previous,
        to: row.status,
        version_id: version.id,
      });
      return row;
    });
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async generate(
    r: SourceRequest,
    dto: GenerateDocumentDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    if (!['pdf', 'docx'].includes(dto.format))
      throw new BadRequestException('Formato não suportado.');
    if (
      process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' &&
      process.env.DOCUMENT_STORAGE !== 'database'
    )
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'Armazenamento documental não homologado neste ambiente.',
      );
    const source = await this.source(r, actor, !!dto.include_memory);
    const cacheKey = documentHash({
      engine: DOCUMENT_ENGINE,
      org: source.organizationId,
      kind: r.kind,
      id: r.id,
      version: r.versionId,
      source_hash: source.hash,
      model: source.model,
      format: dto.format,
      memory: !!dto.include_memory,
    });
    try {
      let artifact = await this.ds.manager.findOneBy(DocumentArtifact, {
        cacheKey,
        organizationId: source.organizationId,
      });
      let cached = !!artifact;
      if (!artifact) {
        let task = this.pending.get(cacheKey);
        cached = !!task;
        if (!task) {
          task = this.create(
            source,
            dto.format,
            !!dto.include_memory,
            cacheKey,
            actor,
          );
          this.pending.set(cacheKey, task);
          void task
            .finally(() => this.pending.delete(cacheKey))
            .catch(() => undefined);
        }
        artifact = await task;
      }
      await this.source(r, actor, !!dto.include_memory);
      await this.audit(source, actor, 'generated', {
        artifact_id: artifact.id,
        format: dto.format,
        checksum: artifact.checksum,
        cached,
        result: 'success',
      });
      return this.metadata(artifact);
    } catch (error) {
      await this.audit(source, actor, 'generation-failed', {
        format: dto.format,
        result: 'failed',
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/documents/documents.service.ts:167](../../gai-backend/src/modules/documents/documents.service.ts#L167)

```ts
async generate(
    r: SourceRequest,
    dto: GenerateDocumentDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    if (!['pdf', 'docx'].includes(dto.format))
      throw new BadRequestException('Formato não suportado.');
    if (
      process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' &&
      process.env.DOCUMENT_STORAGE !== 'database'
    )
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'Armazenamento documental não homologado neste ambiente.',
      );
    const source = await this.source(r, actor, !!dto.include_memory);
    const cacheKey = documentHash({
      engine: DOCUMENT_ENGINE,
      org: source.organizationId,
      kind: r.kind,
      id: r.id,
      version: r.versionId,
      source_hash: source.hash,
      model: source.model,
      format: dto.format,
      memory: !!dto.include_memory,
    });
    try {
      let artifact = await this.ds.manager.findOneBy(DocumentArtifact, {
        cacheKey,
        organizationId: source.organizationId,
      });
      let cached = !!artifact;
      if (!artifact) {
        let task = this.pending.get(cacheKey);
        cached = !!task;
        if (!task) {
          task = this.create(
            source,
            dto.format,
            !!dto.include_memory,
            cacheKey,
            actor,
          );
          this.pending.set(cacheKey, task);
          void task
            .finally(() => this.pending.delete(cacheKey))
            .catch(() => undefined);
        }
        artifact = await task;
      }
      await this.source(r, actor, !!dto.include_memory);
      await this.audit(source, actor, 'generated', {
        artifact_id: artifact.id,
        format: dto.format,
        checksum: artifact.checksum,
        cached,
        result: 'success',
      });
      return this.metadata(artifact);
    } catch (error) {
      await this.audit(source, actor, 'generation-failed', {
        format: dto.format,
        result: 'failed',
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }
```

</details>

[gai-backend/src/modules/budgets/budget.service.ts:129](../../gai-backend/src/modules/budgets/budget.service.ts#L129)

```ts
async publish(
    dto: PublishPricingDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
    requested?: number,
  ) {
    const org = this.org(actor, requested),
      values = pricingValues(dto);
    civil(dto.valid_from);
    civil(dto.valid_to);
    if (
      dto.valid_to < dto.valid_from ||
      dto.reason.trim().length < 5 ||
      !dto.name.trim()
    )
      invalid('Nome, justificativa ou vigência inválidos.');
    return this.ds.transaction(async (m) => {
      await this.orgLock(m, org);
      const previous = await m.find(BudgetPricingEntity, {
        where: { organizationId: org, name: dto.name.trim() },
        order: { version: 'DESC' },
      });
      if (
        previous.some(
          (v) => v.validFrom <= dto.valid_to && v.validTo >= dto.valid_from,
        )
      )
        conflict('A vigência se sobrepõe a outra versão deste conjunto.');
      return m.save(
        BudgetPricingEntity,
        m.create(BudgetPricingEntity, {
          organizationId: org,
          name: dto.name.trim(),
          version: (previous[0]?.version ?? 0) + 1,
          validFrom: dto.valid_from,
          validTo: dto.valid_to,
          values,
          reason: dto.reason.trim(),
          actorId: actor.id,
          recordedAt: new Date(),
        }),
      );
    });
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async execute(
    query: ListCatalogAssetsQueryDto,
    actor: CatalogAssetActorContext,
  ): Promise<CatalogAssetListResponseDto> {
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const organizationId = this.scope.resolveOrganizationFilter(
      actor,
      query.organization_id,
    );
    const { items, total } = await this.repository.list({
      page,
      pageSize,
      organizationId,
      status: query.status,
      category: this.scope.cleanText(query.category) ?? undefined,
      search: this.scope.cleanText(query.search) ?? undefined,
    });

    return {
      items: items.map((item) => CatalogAssetResponseDto.fromDomain(item)),
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
      total_items: total,
      total_pages: total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    };
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/catalog-assets/application/use-cases/create-catalog-asset.use-case.ts:40](../../gai-backend/src/modules/catalog-assets/application/use-cases/create-catalog-asset.use-case.ts#L40)

```ts
async execute(
    dto: CreateCatalogAssetDto,
    actor: CatalogAssetActorContext,
  ): Promise<CatalogAssetResponseDto> {
    const organizationId = this.scope.resolveOrganizationForCreate(
      actor,
      dto.organization_id,
    );
    const organization = await this.organizations.findById(organizationId);
    if (!organization) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Organization not found',
      });
    }
    if (!organization.isActive()) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Catalog asset cannot be created for inactive organization',
      });
    }

    const description = this.scope.cleanText(dto.description);
    if (!description) {
      throw this.validation(new Error('description is required'));
    }
    const descriptionNormalized = this.scope.normalizeDescription(description);
    await this.assertUniqueDescription(organizationId, descriptionNormalized);

    const now = new Date();
    let catalogAsset: CatalogAsset;
    try {
      catalogAsset = new CatalogAsset({
        id: 0,
        organizationId,
        description,
        descriptionNormalized,
        category: this.scope.cleanText(dto.category) ?? null,
        status: CatalogAssetStatus.ACTIVE,
        metadata: dto.metadata ?? null,
        createdById: actor.id,
        updatedById: actor.id,
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
        deletedAt: null,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw this.validation(error);
    }

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(catalogAsset, {
      catalogAssetId: 0,
      organizationId,
      operation: CatalogAssetAuditOperation.CREATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: {
        organization_id: { before: null, after: organizationId },
        description: { before: null, after: catalogAsset.description },
        description_normalized: {
          before: null,
          after: catalogAsset.descriptionNormalized,
        },
        status: { before: null, after: catalogAsset.status },
      },
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'CREATE_CATALOG_ASSET',
      catalogAssetId: saved.id,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return CatalogAssetResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Catalog asset not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, catalogAsset.organizationId);

    const description =
      dto.description !== undefined
        ? this.scope.cleanText(dto.description)
        : undefined;
    if (description === null) {
      throw this.validation(new Error('description is required'));
    }
    const descriptionNormalized =
      description !== undefined
        ? this.scope.normalizeDescription(description)
        : undefined;

    if (
      descriptionNormalized !== undefined &&
      descriptionNormalized !== catalogAsset.descriptionNormalized
    ) {
      await this.assertUniqueDescription(
        catalogAsset.organizationId,
        descriptionNormalized,
        catalogAsset.id,
      );
    }

    let changes: Record<string, { before: unknown; after: unknown }>;
    try {
      changes = catalogAsset.updateFields({
        description,
        descriptionNormalized,
        category:
          dto.category !== undefined
            ? (this.scope.cleanText(dto.category) ?? null)
            : undefined,
        metadata: dto.metadata,
        updatedById: actor.id,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw this.validation(error);
    }

    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 0) {
      return CatalogAssetResponseDto.fromDomain(catalogAsset);
    }

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(catalogAsset, {
      organizationId: catalogAsset.organizationId,
      catalogAssetId: catalogAsset.id,
      operation: CatalogAssetAuditOperation.UPDATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'UPDATE_CATALOG_ASSET',
      catalogAssetId: saved.id,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return CatalogAssetResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

```ts
      changes,
    });

      operation: `CATALOG_ASSET_${action.toUpperCase()}`,
      catalogAssetId: saved.id,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
```

```ts
async listCompanies(
    query: ListCompaniesQueryDto,
    actor: CompanyActorContext,
  ): Promise<CompanyListResponseDto> {
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const { items, total } = await this.repository.listCompanies({
      page,
      pageSize,
      organizationId: this.scope.resolveOrganizationFilter(
        actor,
        query.organization_id,
      ),
      status: query.status,
      document: query.document,
      city: query.city,
      state: query.state,
      search: query.search,
    });
    return {
      items: items.map((item) => CompanyResponseDto.fromEntity(item)),
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
      total_items: total,
      total_pages: total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    };
  }
```

```ts
async createCompany(
    dto: CreateCompanyDto,
    actor: CompanyActorContext,
  ): Promise<CompanyResponseDto> {
    const organizationId = this.scope.resolveOrganizationForCreate(
      actor,
      dto.organization_id,
    );
    const organization = await this.organizations.findById(organizationId);
    if (!organization) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Organization not found',
      });
    }
    if (!organization.isActive()) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Company cannot be created for inactive organization',
      });
    }
    const document = this.normalizeDocument(dto.document);
    this.normalizeContactFields(dto, dto.country ?? 'BR');
    if (document) {
      await this.assertUniqueDocument(organizationId, document);
    }
    this.assertStatusPermission(
      actor,
      CompanyStatus.ACTIVE,
      dto.status ?? CompanyStatus.ACTIVE,
    );
    const company = new CompanyEntity();
    Object.assign(company, {
      organizationId,
      name: this.cleanRequired(dto.name, 'name'),
      corporateName: this.clean(dto.corporate_name),
      document,
      stateRegistration: this.clean(dto.state_registration),
      municipalRegistration: this.clean(dto.municipal_registration),
      email: this.clean(dto.email),
      phone: this.clean(dto.phone),
      zipcode: this.clean(dto.zipcode),
      address: this.clean(dto.address),
      number: this.clean(dto.number),
      complement: this.clean(dto.complement),
      district: this.clean(dto.district),
      city: this.clean(dto.city),
      state: this.clean(dto.state),
      country: this.clean(dto.country) ?? 'BR',
      status: dto.status ?? CompanyStatus.ACTIVE,
      deletedAt: dto.status === CompanyStatus.INACTIVE ? new Date() : null,
      metadata: dto.metadata ?? null,
      createdById: actor.id,
      updatedById: actor.id,
    });
    const saved = await this.repository.saveCompanyWithAudit(company, {
      operation: CompanyAuditOperation.CREATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: {
        organization_id: { before: null, after: organizationId },
        name: { before: null, after: company.name },
        document: { before: null, after: company.document },
        status: { before: null, after: company.status },
      },
    });
    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'CREATE_COMPANY',
      companyId: saved.id,
      organizationId,
    });
    return CompanyResponseDto.fromEntity(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async createUnit(
    companyId: number,
    dto: CreateCompanyUnitDto,
    actor: CompanyActorContext,
  ): Promise<CompanyUnitResponseDto> {
    const company = await this.findCompanyOrFail(companyId);
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, company.organizationId);
    if (company.status !== CompanyStatus.ACTIVE) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Company status blocks this operation',
      });
    }
    const unit = new CompanyUnitEntity();
    Object.assign(unit, {
      organizationId: company.organizationId,
      companyId,
      name: this.cleanRequired(dto.name, 'name'),
      code: this.clean(dto.code),
      zipcode: this.clean(dto.zipcode),
      address: this.clean(dto.address),
      number: this.clean(dto.number),
      complement: this.clean(dto.complement),
      district: this.clean(dto.district),
      city: this.clean(dto.city),
      state: this.clean(dto.state),
      country: this.clean(dto.country) ?? 'BR',
      status: CompanyUnitStatus.ACTIVE,
      metadata: dto.metadata ?? null,
      createdById: actor.id,
      updatedById: actor.id,
    });
    const saved = await this.repository.saveUnitWithAudit(unit, {
      operation: CompanyAuditOperation.CREATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: {
        company_id: { before: null, after: companyId },
        name: { before: null, after: unit.name },
        status: { before: null, after: unit.status },
      },
    });
    return CompanyUnitResponseDto.fromEntity(saved);
  }
```

```ts
async updateUnit(
    companyId: number,
    unitId: number,
    dto: UpdateCompanyUnitDto,
    actor: CompanyActorContext,
  ): Promise<CompanyUnitResponseDto> {
    const unit = await this.findUnitOrFail(companyId, unitId);
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, unit.organizationId);
    const changes: Record<string, { before: unknown; after: unknown }> = {};
    if (dto.name !== undefined) {
      this.change(changes, unit, 'name', this.cleanRequired(dto.name, 'name'));
    }
    if (dto.code !== undefined) {
      this.change(changes, unit, 'code', this.clean(dto.code));
    }
    if (dto.metadata !== undefined) {
      this.change(changes, unit, 'metadata', dto.metadata ?? null);
    }
    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 0) {
      return CompanyUnitResponseDto.fromEntity(unit);
    }
    unit.updatedById = actor.id;
    const saved = await this.repository.saveUnitWithAudit(unit, {
      operation: CompanyAuditOperation.UPDATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });
    return CompanyUnitResponseDto.fromEntity(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async changeUnitStatus(
    companyId: number,
    unitId: number,
    action: 'deactivate' | 'reactivate',
    actor: CompanyActorContext,
  ): Promise<CompanyUnitResponseDto> {
    const unit = await this.findUnitOrFail(companyId, unitId);
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, unit.organizationId);
    const nextStatus =
      action === 'deactivate'
        ? CompanyUnitStatus.INACTIVE
        : CompanyUnitStatus.ACTIVE;
    if (unit.status === nextStatus) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Company unit status blocks this operation',
      });
    }
    const beforeStatus = unit.status;
    const beforeDeletedAt = unit.deletedAt;
    unit.status = nextStatus;
    unit.deletedAt =
      nextStatus === CompanyUnitStatus.INACTIVE ? new Date() : null;
    unit.updatedById = actor.id;
    const saved = await this.repository.saveUnitWithAudit(unit, {
      operation:
        action === 'deactivate'
          ? CompanyAuditOperation.DEACTIVATE
          : CompanyAuditOperation.REACTIVATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: {
        status: { before: beforeStatus, after: unit.status },
        deleted_at: {
          before: beforeDeletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
          after: unit.deletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
        },
      },
    });
    return CompanyUnitResponseDto.fromEntity(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async updateCompany(
    id: number,
    dto: UpdateCompanyDto,
    actor: CompanyActorContext,
  ): Promise<CompanyResponseDto> {
    const company = await this.findCompanyOrFail(id);
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, company.organizationId);
    if (company.deletedAt) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Reative a empresa antes de editar seus dados.',
      });
    }
    this.normalizeContactFields(
      dto,
      dto.country === undefined ? company.country : dto.country,
    );
    const changes: Record<string, { before: unknown; after: unknown }> = {};
    if (dto.name !== undefined) {
      this.change(
        changes,
        company,
        'name',
        this.cleanRequired(dto.name, 'name'),
      );
    }
    if (dto.corporate_name !== undefined) {
      this.change(
        changes,
        company,
        'corporateName',
        this.clean(dto.corporate_name),
      );
    }
    if (dto.document !== undefined) {
      const document = this.normalizeDocument(dto.document);
      if (document) {
        await this.assertUniqueDocument(
          company.organizationId,
          document,
          company.id,
        );
      }
      this.change(changes, company, 'document', document);
    }
    if (dto.state_registration !== undefined)
      this.change(
        changes,
        company,
        'stateRegistration',
        this.clean(dto.state_registration),
      );
    if (dto.municipal_registration !== undefined)
      this.change(
        changes,
        company,
        'municipalRegistration',
        this.clean(dto.municipal_registration),
      );
    if (dto.email !== undefined)
      this.change(changes, company, 'email', this.clean(dto.email));
    if (dto.phone !== undefined)
      this.change(changes, company, 'phone', this.clean(dto.phone));
    if (dto.zipcode !== undefined)
      this.change(changes, company, 'zipcode', this.clean(dto.zipcode));
    if (dto.address !== undefined)
      this.change(changes, company, 'address', this.clean(dto.address));
    if (dto.number !== undefined)
      this.change(changes, company, 'number', this.clean(dto.number));
    if (dto.complement !== undefined)
      this.change(changes, company, 'complement', this.clean(dto.complement));
    if (dto.district !== undefined)
      this.change(changes, company, 'district', this.clean(dto.district));
    if (dto.city !== undefined)
      this.change(changes, company, 'city', this.clean(dto.city));
    if (dto.state !== undefined)
      this.change(changes, company, 'state', this.clean(dto.state));
    if (dto.country !== undefined)
      this.change(changes, company, 'country', this.clean(dto.country));
    if (dto.status !== undefined && dto.status !== company.status) {
      this.assertStatusPermission(actor, company.status, dto.status);
      this.change(changes, company, 'status', dto.status);
      this.change(
        changes,
        company,
        'deletedAt',
        dto.status === CompanyStatus.INACTIVE ? new Date() : null,
      );
    }
    if (dto.metadata !== undefined) {
      this.change(changes, company, 'metadata', dto.metadata ?? null);
    }
    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 0) {
      return CompanyResponseDto.fromEntity(company);
    }
    company.updatedById = actor.id;
    const saved = await this.repository.saveCompanyWithAudit(company, {
      operation: CompanyAuditOperation.UPDATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });
    return CompanyResponseDto.fromEntity(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async execute(
    query: ListFieldAgentsQueryDto,
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
  ): Promise<FieldAgentListResponseDto> {
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const organizationId = this.scope.resolveOrganizationFilter(
      actor,
      query.organization_id,
    );
    const { items, total } = await this.repository.list({
      page,
      pageSize,
      organizationId,
      status: query.status,
      search: query.search,
      deleted: query.deletion === 'deleted',
      excludeProjectId: query.exclude_project_id,
    });

    return {
      items: items.map((item) => FieldAgentResponseDto.fromDomain(item)),
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
      total_items: total,
      total_pages: total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    };
  }
```

```ts
async execute(
    dto: CreateFieldAgentDto,
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
  ): Promise<FieldAgentResponseDto> {
    const organizationId = this.scope.resolveOrganizationForCreate(actor);
    const organization = await this.organizations.findById(organizationId);
    if (!organization) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Organization not found',
      });
    }
    if (!organization.isActive()) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Field agent cannot be created for inactive organization',
      });
    }
    await this.assertUserScope(dto.user_id, organizationId);

    const now = new Date();
    let fieldAgent: FieldAgent;
    try {
      fieldAgent = new FieldAgent({
        id: 0,
        organizationId,
        userId: dto.user_id ?? null,
        name: dto.name.trim(),
        email: dto.email ?? null,
        phone: dto.phone ?? null,
        document: dto.document ?? null,
        status: FieldAgentStatus.ACTIVE,
        metadata: dto.metadata ?? null,
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
        deletedAt: null,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw this.validation(error);
    }

    const conflict = await this.repository.findConflict(organizationId, {
      email: fieldAgent.email,
      document: fieldAgent.document,
    });
    if (conflict) throw fieldAgentConflict(conflict);

    let saved: FieldAgent;
    try {
      saved = await this.repository.saveFieldAgentWithAudit(fieldAgent, {
        organizationId,
        fieldAgentId: 0,
        operation: FieldAgentAuditOperation.CREATE,
        performedBy: actor.id,
        changes: {
          organization_id: { before: null, after: organizationId },
          name: { before: null, after: fieldAgent.name },
          email: { before: null, after: fieldAgent.email },
          phone: { before: null, after: fieldAgent.phone },
          document: { before: null, after: fieldAgent.document },
          user_id: { before: null, after: fieldAgent.userId },
          status: { before: null, after: fieldAgent.status },
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const duplicateField = duplicateFieldFromDatabase(error);
      if (duplicateField) throw fieldAgentConflict(duplicateField);
      throw error;
    }

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'CREATE_FIELD_AGENT',
      fieldAgentId: saved.id,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return FieldAgentResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async execute(id: number, actor: FieldAgentActorContext): Promise<void> {
    const fieldAgent = await this.repository.findById(id);
    if (!fieldAgent) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Field agent not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, fieldAgent.organizationId);
    let changes;
    try {
      changes = fieldAgent.softDelete(new Date());
    } catch (error) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : 'Field agent cannot be deleted',
      });
    }
    await this.repository.saveFieldAgentWithAudit(fieldAgent, {
      organizationId: fieldAgent.organizationId,
      fieldAgentId: fieldAgent.id,
      operation: FieldAgentAuditOperation.DELETE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });
    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'DELETE_FIELD_AGENT',
      fieldAgentId: fieldAgent.id,
      organizationId: fieldAgent.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });
  }
```

```ts
async detail(
    id: number,
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
    includeDeleted = false,
  ) {
    const row = await this.agent(id, actor, includeDeleted);
    const org = await this.db
      .getRepository(OrganizationEntity)
      .findOneByOrFail({ id: row.organizationId });
    const user = row.userId
      ? await this.db
          .getRepository(UserEntity)
          .findOneBy({ id: row.userId, organizationId: row.organizationId })
      : null;
    return {
      id: row.id,
      organization_id: row.organizationId,
      organization_name: org.tradeName || org.legalName,
      user_id: row.userId,
      name: row.name,
      email: row.email,
      phone: row.phone,
      document: row.document,
      status: row.status,
      metadata: row.metadata,
      created_at: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updated_at: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
      deleted_at: row.deletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      linked_user: user
        ? {
            id: user.id,
            full_name: user.fullName,
            login: user.login,
            email: user.email,
            status: user.status,
          }
        : null,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async execute(
    id: number,
    dto: UpdateFieldAgentDto,
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
  ): Promise<FieldAgentResponseDto> {
    const fieldAgent = await this.repository.findById(id);
    if (!fieldAgent) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Field agent not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, fieldAgent.organizationId);
    await this.assertUserScope(dto.user_id, fieldAgent.organizationId);

    let changes: Record<string, { before: unknown; after: unknown }>;
    try {
      changes = fieldAgent.updateFields({
        userId: dto.user_id,
        name: dto.name?.trim(),
        email: dto.email,
        phone: dto.phone,
        document: dto.document,
        metadata: dto.metadata,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw new BadRequestException({
        code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Invalid field agent',
      });
    }

    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 0) {
      return FieldAgentResponseDto.fromDomain(fieldAgent);
    }

    const conflict = await this.repository.findConflict(
      fieldAgent.organizationId,
      { email: fieldAgent.email, document: fieldAgent.document },
      fieldAgent.id,
    );
    if (conflict) throw fieldAgentConflict(conflict);

    let saved;
    try {
      saved = await this.repository.saveFieldAgentWithAudit(fieldAgent, {
        organizationId: fieldAgent.organizationId,
        fieldAgentId: fieldAgent.id,
        operation: FieldAgentAuditOperation.UPDATE,
        performedBy: actor.id,
        changes,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const duplicateField = duplicateFieldFromDatabase(error);
      if (duplicateField) throw fieldAgentConflict(duplicateField);
      throw error;
    }

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'UPDATE_FIELD_AGENT',
      fieldAgentId: saved.id,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return FieldAgentResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

```ts
async execute(
    id: number,
    action: FieldAgentStatusAction,
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
  ): Promise<FieldAgentResponseDto> {
    const fieldAgent = await this.repository.findById(id);
    if (!fieldAgent) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Field agent not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, fieldAgent.organizationId);

    let changes: Record<string, { before: unknown; after: unknown }>;
    try {
      const transitions = {
        deactivate: () => fieldAgent.deactivate(),
        reactivate: () => fieldAgent.reactivate(),
        block: () => fieldAgent.block(),
        unblock: () => fieldAgent.unblock(),
      };
      changes = transitions[action]();
    } catch (error) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : 'Field agent status blocks this operation',
      });
    }

    const saved = await this.repository.saveFieldAgentWithAudit(fieldAgent, {
      organizationId: fieldAgent.organizationId,
      fieldAgentId: fieldAgent.id,
      operation: {
        deactivate: FieldAgentAuditOperation.DEACTIVATE,
        reactivate: FieldAgentAuditOperation.REACTIVATE,
        block: FieldAgentAuditOperation.BLOCK,
        unblock: FieldAgentAuditOperation.UNBLOCK,
      }[action],
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: `FIELD_AGENT_${action.toUpperCase()}`,
      fieldAgentId: saved.id,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return FieldAgentResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async history(
    id: number,
    query: { page?: number; page_size?: number },
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
  ) {
    const row = await this.agent(id, actor, true);
    const page = query.page ?? 1,
      size = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const [rows, total] = await this.db
      .getRepository(FieldAgentAuditLogEntity)
      .findAndCount({
        where: { organizationId: row.organizationId, fieldAgentId: id },
        order: { id: 'DESC' },
        skip: (page - 1) * size,
        take: size,
      });
    const items = await Promise.all(
      rows.map(async (a) => ({
        id: a.id,
        operation: a.operation,
        created_at: a.createdAt.toISOString(),
        performed_by_name: a.performedBy
          ? ((
              await this.db
                .getRepository(UserEntity)
                .findOneBy({ id: a.performedBy })
            )?.fullName ?? 'Usuário')
          : 'Sistema',
        changes: fieldAgentAuditChanges(a.changes),
      })),
    );
    return {
      items,
      page,
      page_size: size,
      total_items: total,
      total_pages: Math.ceil(total / size),
    };
  }
```

```ts
async invite(
    id: number,
    dto: { login: string; email: string },
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
  ) {
    const row = await this.agent(id, actor);
    if (!actor.systemRoles.includes(UserRole.ORG_ADMIN))
      throw new ForbiddenException({
        code: 'FORBIDDEN',
        message:
          'Somente o administrador da organização pode criar acesso por convite.',
      });
    if (row.userId)
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message:
          'O inventariante já possui conta. Use o reenvio de convite, se necessário.',
      });
    const orgUser = await this.db.getRepository(RoleEntity).findOneByOrFail({
      key: UserRole.ORG_USER,
      type: RoleType.SYSTEM,
      isActive: true,
    });
    const input = Object.assign(new CreateUserDto(), {
      full_name: row.name,
      email: dto.email,
      login: dto.login,
      activation_method: 'INVITATION',
      role_ids: [orgUser.id],
    });
    if ((await validate(input)).length)
      throw new BadRequestException({
        code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
        message:
          'Revise nome (mínimo 3 caracteres), login e e-mail antes de criar a conta.',
      });
    return this.users.create(input, actor, async (manager, user) => {
      // create() already holds the access-administration lock. All identity and
      // association changes roll back together if another request linked it.
      const current = await manager.getRepository(FieldAgentEntity).findOne({
        where: { id, organizationId: row.organizationId },
        ...(manager.connection.options.type === 'mysql'
          ? { lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' as const } }
          : {}),
      });
      if (!current || current.userId)
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'CONFLICT',
          message: 'O cadastro mudou ou já possui conta. Atualize a página.',
        });
      const key = `FIELD_AGENT_ORG_${row.organizationId}`;
      let role = await manager
        .getRepository(RoleEntity)
        .findOneBy({ key, organizationId: row.organizationId });
      if (!role) {
        role = await manager.getRepository(RoleEntity).save({
          key,
          organizationId: row.organizationId,
          type: RoleType.ORGANIZATION,
          name: 'Inventariante de campo',
          description:
            'Coleta somente nos projetos com vínculo ativo e vigente.',
          isActive: true,
        });
        const permissions = (
          await manager.getRepository(PermissionEntity).find()
        ).filter(
          (p) =>
            FIELD_ACCESS_PERMISSIONS.includes(p.key) &&
            p.scope === PermissionScope.ORGANIZATION,
        );
        if (permissions.length !== FIELD_ACCESS_PERMISSIONS.length)
          throw new ConflictException({
            code: 'CONFLICT',
            message:
              'O catálogo de permissões de campo está incompleto. Revise a configuração antes de convidar.',
          });
        for (const permission of permissions)
          await manager
            .getRepository(RolePermissionEntity)
            .save({ roleId: role.id, permissionId: permission.id });
      }
      if (!role.isActive)
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'CONFLICT',
          message:
            'O perfil de campo está inativo. Revise os perfis antes de convidar.',
        });
      const grants = await manager
        .getRepository(PermissionEntity)
        .createQueryBuilder('permission')
        .innerJoin(
          RolePermissionEntity,
          'grant',
          'grant.permissionId=permission.id',
        )
        .where('grant.roleId = :id', { id: role.id })
        .getMany();
      if (
        grants.length !== FIELD_ACCESS_PERMISSIONS.length ||
        grants.some(
          (p) =>
            !FIELD_ACCESS_PERMISSIONS.includes(p.key) ||
            p.scope !== PermissionScope.ORGANIZATION,
        )
      )
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'CONFLICT',
          message:
            'O perfil de campo foi alterado. Revise suas permissões mínimas antes de criar novos acessos.',
        });
      await replaceUserRoles(manager, user.id, [orgUser.id, role.id], actor);
      current.userId = user.id;
      await manager.getRepository(FieldAgentEntity).save(current);
      await manager.getRepository(FieldAgentAuditLogEntity).save({
        fieldAgentId: id,
        organizationId: row.organizationId,
        performedBy: actor.id,
        operation: FieldAgentAuditOperation.INVITE_USER,
        changes: { user_id: { before: null, after: user.id } },
      });
      await manager.getRepository(UserAuditLogEntity).save({
        userId: user.id,
        performedBy: actor.id,
        operation: 'FIELD_ACCESS_PROFILE',
        changes: {
          role_ids: { before: [orgUser.id], after: [orgUser.id, role.id] },
        },
      });
    });
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async projects(
    id: number,
    query: { page?: number; page_size?: number },
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
  ) {
    const row = await this.agent(id, actor, true);
    const page = query.page ?? 1,
      size = query.page_size ?? 20;

      .getRepository(ProjectFieldAgentEntity)
      .createQueryBuilder('a')
      .where('a.fieldAgentId=:id AND a.organizationId=:org', {
        id,
        org: row.organizationId,
      });
    const [rows, total] = await qb
      .orderBy('a.id', 'DESC')
      .skip((page - 1) * size)
      .take(size)
      .getManyAndCount();
    const items = await Promise.all(
      rows.map(async (a) => ({
        id: a.id,
        project_id: a.projectId,

          (
            await this.db.getRepository(ProjectEntity).findOne({
              where: { id: a.projectId, organizationId: row.organizationId },
              withDeleted: true,
            })
          )?.name ?? 'Projeto indisponível',
        role: a.role,
        status: a.status,
        start_date: a.startDate?.toISOString().slice(0, 10) ?? null,
        end_date: a.endDate?.toISOString().slice(0, 10) ?? null,
      })),
    );
    return {
      items,
      page,
      page_size: size,
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/field-agents/application/use-cases/update-field-agent-status.use-case.ts:36](../../gai-backend/src/modules/field-agents/application/use-cases/update-field-agent-status.use-case.ts#L36)

```ts
async execute(
    id: number,
    action: FieldAgentStatusAction,
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
  ): Promise<FieldAgentResponseDto> {
    const fieldAgent = await this.repository.findById(id);
    if (!fieldAgent) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Field agent not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, fieldAgent.organizationId);

    let changes: Record<string, { before: unknown; after: unknown }>;
    try {
      const transitions = {
        deactivate: () => fieldAgent.deactivate(),
        reactivate: () => fieldAgent.reactivate(),
        block: () => fieldAgent.block(),
        unblock: () => fieldAgent.unblock(),
      };
      changes = transitions[action]();
    } catch (error) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : 'Field agent status blocks this operation',
      });
    }

    const saved = await this.repository.saveFieldAgentWithAudit(fieldAgent, {
      organizationId: fieldAgent.organizationId,
      fieldAgentId: fieldAgent.id,
      operation: {
        deactivate: FieldAgentAuditOperation.DEACTIVATE,
        reactivate: FieldAgentAuditOperation.REACTIVATE,
        block: FieldAgentAuditOperation.BLOCK,
        unblock: FieldAgentAuditOperation.UNBLOCK,
      }[action],
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: `FIELD_AGENT_${action.toUpperCase()}`,
      fieldAgentId: saved.id,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return FieldAgentResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async detail(
    id: number,
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
    includeDeleted = false,
  ) {
    const row = await this.agent(id, actor, includeDeleted);
    const org = await this.db
      .getRepository(OrganizationEntity)
      .findOneByOrFail({ id: row.organizationId });
    const user = row.userId
      ? await this.db
          .getRepository(UserEntity)
          .findOneBy({ id: row.userId, organizationId: row.organizationId })
      : null;
    return {
      id: row.id,
      organization_id: row.organizationId,
      organization_name: org.tradeName || org.legalName,
      user_id: row.userId,
      name: row.name,
      email: row.email,
      phone: row.phone,
      document: row.document,
      status: row.status,
      metadata: row.metadata,
      created_at: row.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updated_at: row.updatedAt.toISOString(),
      deleted_at: row.deletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      linked_user: user
        ? {
            id: user.id,
            full_name: user.fullName,
            login: user.login,
            email: user.email,
            status: user.status,
          }
        : null,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async restore(id: number, actor: FieldAgentActorContext) {
    const row = await this.agent(id, actor, true);
    if (!row.deletedAt)
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'O cadastro não está excluído.',
      });
    const restored = new FieldAgent({
      ...row,
      id: Number(row.id),
```

<details><summary>Implementação chamada: UpdateFieldAgentStatusUseCase.execute</summary>

[gai-backend/src/modules/field-agents/application/use-cases/update-field-agent-status.use-case.ts:36](../../gai-backend/src/modules/field-agents/application/use-cases/update-field-agent-status.use-case.ts#L36)

```ts
async execute(
    id: number,
    action: FieldAgentStatusAction,
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
  ): Promise<FieldAgentResponseDto> {
    const fieldAgent = await this.repository.findById(id);
    if (!fieldAgent) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Field agent not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, fieldAgent.organizationId);

    let changes: Record<string, { before: unknown; after: unknown }>;
    try {
      const transitions = {
        deactivate: () => fieldAgent.deactivate(),
        reactivate: () => fieldAgent.reactivate(),
        block: () => fieldAgent.block(),
        unblock: () => fieldAgent.unblock(),
      };
      changes = transitions[action]();
    } catch (error) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : 'Field agent status blocks this operation',
      });
    }

    const saved = await this.repository.saveFieldAgentWithAudit(fieldAgent, {
      organizationId: fieldAgent.organizationId,
      fieldAgentId: fieldAgent.id,
      operation: {
        deactivate: FieldAgentAuditOperation.DEACTIVATE,
        reactivate: FieldAgentAuditOperation.REACTIVATE,
        block: FieldAgentAuditOperation.BLOCK,
        unblock: FieldAgentAuditOperation.UNBLOCK,
      }[action],
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: `FIELD_AGENT_${action.toUpperCase()}`,
      fieldAgentId: saved.id,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return FieldAgentResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

[gai-backend/src/modules/field-agents/application/services/field-agent-management.service.ts:122](../../gai-backend/src/modules/field-agents/application/services/field-agent-management.service.ts#L122)

```ts
async userOptions(
    query: {
      page?: number;
      page_size?: number;
      search?: string;
      current_agent_id?: number;
    },
    actor: FieldAgentActorContext,
  ) {
    const organizationId = this.scope.resolveOrganizationForCreate(actor);
    const qb = this.db
      .getRepository(UserEntity)
      .createQueryBuilder('u')
      .where('u.organizationId=:org', { org: organizationId })
      .andWhere(
        'NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_role_assignments a JOIN roles r ON r.id=a.role_id WHERE a.user_id=u.id AND a.is_active=1 AND a.revoked_at IS NULL AND r.`key`=:platform AND r.is_active=1)',
        { platform: UserRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN },
      )
      .andWhere(
        'NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM field_agents f WHERE f.user_id=u.id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.id<>:current)',
        { current: query.current_agent_id ?? 0 },
      );
    if (query.search)
      qb.andWhere(
        '(LOWER(u.fullName) LIKE :q OR LOWER(u.login) LIKE :q OR LOWER(u.email) LIKE :q)',
        { q: `%${query.search.toLowerCase()}%` },
      );
    const page = query.page ?? 1,
      size = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const [rows, total] = await qb
      .select(['u.id', 'u.fullName', 'u.login', 'u.email', 'u.status'])
      .orderBy('u.fullName', 'ASC')
      .addOrderBy('u.id', 'ASC')
      .skip((page - 1) * size)
      .take(size)
      .getManyAndCount();
    return {
      items: rows.map((u) => ({
        id: u.id,
        full_name: u.fullName,
        login: u.login,
        email: u.email,
        status: u.status,
      })),
      page,
      page_size: size,
      total_items: total,
      total_pages: Math.ceil(total / size),
    };
  }
```

</details>

<details><summary>Implementação chamada: DreService.editAccount</summary>

[gai-backend/src/modules/managerial-dre/dre.service.ts:241](../../gai-backend/src/modules/managerial-dre/dre.service.ts#L241)

```ts
editAccount(
    id: number,
    f: DreScopeDto,
    dto: DreAccountEditDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.command(f, dto, actor, 'account-edit:' + id, async (m, org) => {
      const a = await m.findOneBy(DreAccount, { id, organizationId: org });
      if (!a) throw new NotFoundException('Conta não encontrada.');
      if (a.revision !== dto.revision) conflict('Conta alterada. Atualize.');
      if (dto.name.trim().length < 3) invalid('Nome obrigatório.');
      a.revision++;
      a.data = { ...a.data, name: dto.name.trim(), active: dto.active };
      await m
        .createQueryBuilder()
        .update(DreAccount)
        .set({ revision: a.revision, data: () => ':data' })
        .where('id=:id AND organization_id=:org', {
          id,
          org,
          data: JSON.stringify(a.data),
        })
        .execute();
      await this.accountVersion(m, a, actor, dto.reason);
      return { ...a };
    });
  }
```

</details>

```ts
bootstrap(f: DreScopeDto, dto: DreCommandDto, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    return this.command(f, dto, actor, 'accounts-bootstrap', async (m, org) => {
      if (await m.count(DreAccount, { where: { organizationId: org } }))
        conflict(
          'O plano sugerido só pode ser publicado em organização sem contas.',
        );
      const children: Record<DreGroup, string[]> = {
        revenue: ['Receita de serviços', 'Outras receitas operacionais'],
        deductions: [
          'Tributos sobre receitas',
          'Descontos e abatimentos',
          'Devoluções e cancelamentos',
        ],
        direct_cost: [
          'Equipes de campo',
          'Deslocamento',
          'Hospedagem',
          'Alimentação',
          'Materiais',
          'Outros custos diretos',
        ],
        operating_expense: [
          'Administrativas',
          'Comerciais',
          'Tecnologia',
          'Serviços de terceiros',
          'Outras despesas operacionais',
        ],
        financial_income: ['Receitas financeiras'],
        financial_expense: ['Despesas financeiras'],
        income_tax: ['Tributos sobre lucro reconhecidos'],
      };
      let index = 0;
      for (const group of DRE_GROUPS) {
        const code = String(++index),
          parent = await this.insertAccount(
            m,
            org,
            { code, name: GROUP_LABELS[group], group, posting: false },
            actor,
            dto.reason,
          );
        let n = 0;
        for (const name of children[group])
          await this.insertAccount(
            m,
            org,
            {
              code: code + '.' + String(++n).padStart(2, '0'),
              name,
              group,
              parent_id: parent.id,
              posting: true,
            },
            actor,
            dto.reason,
          );
      }
      return {
        published: true,
        accounts: await m.count(DreAccount, { where: { organizationId: org } }),
      };
```

```ts
createEntry(f: DreScopeDto, dto: DreEntryDto, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    return this.command(f, dto, actor, 'entry-create', async (m, org) => {
      const data = await this.entryData(m, org, dto, actor);
      await this.unlocked(
        m,
        org,
        data.allocations.map((a) => a.month),
      );
      if (
        (await m.exists(DreEntry, {
          where: { organizationId: org, economicKey: data.economic_key },
        })) ||
        (data.source.key &&
          (await m.exists(DreEntry, {
            where: { organizationId: org, sourceKey: data.source.key },
          })))
      )
        conflict(
          'Fato econômico/origem já possui classificação. Ajuste o registro existente.',
        );
      const e = await m.save(
        DreEntry,
        m.create(DreEntry, {
          organizationId: org,
          projectId: data.source.project_id,
          economicKey: data.economic_key,
          sourceKey: data.source.key,
          revision: 1,
          data,
        }),
      );
      e.id = Number(e.id);
      await this.version(m, e, actor, dto.reason);
      return { ...e };
    });
  }
```

<details><summary>Implementação chamada: DreService.editEntry</summary>

[gai-backend/src/modules/managerial-dre/dre.service.ts:722](../../gai-backend/src/modules/managerial-dre/dre.service.ts#L722)

```ts
editEntry(
    id: number,
    f: DreScopeDto,
    dto: DreEntryEditDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.command(f, dto, actor, 'entry-adjust:' + id, async (m, org) => {
      const e = await m.findOneBy(DreEntry, { id, organizationId: org });
      if (!e) throw new NotFoundException('Reconhecimento não encontrado.');
      if (e.revision !== dto.revision)
        conflict('Reconhecimento alterado. Atualize.');
      if (
        e.data.source.kind !== dto.source_kind ||
        e.data.source.id !== (dto.source_id ?? null) ||
        e.economicKey !== dto.economic_key.trim() ||
        e.projectId !== (dto.project_id ?? null) ||
        e.data.currency !== dto.currency
      )
        conflict(
          'Identidade econômica, projeto, origem e moeda são imutáveis.',
        );
      const data = await this.entryData(m, org, dto, actor);
      await this.unlocked(
        m,
        org,
        [...e.data.allocations, ...data.allocations].map((a) => a.month),
      );
      e.data = data;
      e.revision++;
      const result = await m
        .createQueryBuilder()
        .update(DreEntry)
        .set({ revision: e.revision, data: () => ':data' })
        .where('id=:id AND organization_id=:org AND revision=:old', {
          id,
          org,
          old: dto.revision,
          data: JSON.stringify(data),
        })
        .execute();
      if (result.affected !== 1) conflict('Conflito de revisão.');
      await this.version(m, e, actor, dto.reason);
      return { ...e };
    });
  }
```

</details>
