[gai-backend/src/modules/managerial-dre/dre-export.service.ts:24](../../gai-backend/src/modules/managerial-dre/dre-export.service.ts#L24)

```ts
async create(dto: DreExportDto, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    const report = await this.dre.report(dto, actor);
    const permissions = [
      'dre:read',
      'dre:export',
      ...report.source_permissions,
    ];
    await this.dre.require(actor, [...permissions, 'export-jobs:create']);
    const sheets: FinanceWorkbook['sheets'] = [];
    const statement = {
      name: 'DRE Gerencial',
      headers: [
        'Moeda',
        'Linha',
        'Valor validado',
        'Apurado parcial',
        'Cobertura',
      ],
      rows: report.totals.flatMap((t) =>
        t.lines.map((l) => [
          t.currency,
          l.label,
          l.amount,
          l.known_amount,
          l.complete ? 'Validada' : 'Incompleta',
        ]),
      ),
    };
    if (dto.kind === 'statement') sheets.push(statement);
    if (dto.kind === 'projects')
      sheets.push({
        name: 'Projetos',
        headers: [
          'Projeto',
          'Moeda',
          'Linha',
          'Valor validado',
          'Apurado parcial',
        ],
        rows: report.by_project.flatMap((t) =>
          t.lines.map((l) => [
            t.project_id,
            t.currency,
            l.label,
            l.amount,
            l.known_amount,
          ]),
        ),
      });
    if (dto.kind === 'monthly' || dto.kind === 'statement')
      sheets.push({
        name: 'Comparativo mensal',
        headers: [
          'Competência',
          'Moeda',
          'Linha',
          'Validado',
          'Apurado parcial',
          'Fechado',
        ],
        rows: report.monthly.flatMap((t) =>
          t.lines.map((l) => [
            t.month,
            t.currency,
            l.label,
            l.amount,
            l.known_amount,
            t.closed,
          ]),
        ),
      });
    if (report.comparison)
      sheets.push({
        name: 'Período comparado',
        headers: [
          'Início',
          'Fim',
          'Moeda',
          'Linha',
          'Validado',
          'Apurado parcial',
        ],
        rows: report.comparison.totals.flatMap((t) =>
          t.lines.map((l) => [
            report.comparison!.start_month,
            report.comparison!.end_month,
            t.currency,
            l.label,
            l.amount,
            l.known_amount,
          ]),
        ),
      });
    const filtered = report.rows.filter((r) =>
      dto.kind === 'revenue'
        ? ['revenue', 'financial_income'].includes(r.group ?? '')
        : dto.kind === 'costs'
          ? r.group === 'direct_cost'
          : dto.kind === 'expenses'
            ? [
                'deductions',
                'operating_expense',
                'financial_expense',
                'income_tax',
              ].includes(r.group ?? '')
            : true,
    );
    if (dto.kind !== 'unclassified')
      sheets.push({
        name: 'Lançamentos',
        headers: [
          'Fato',
          'Revisão',
          'Competência',
          'Projeto',
          'Moeda',
          'Conta',
          'Grupo',
          'Descrição',
          'Valor',
          'Origem',
        ],
        rows: filtered.map((r) => [
          r.entry_id,
          r.revision,
          r.month,
          r.project_id,
          r.currency,
          r.account_name,
          r.group,
          r.description,
          r.amount,
          r.source_key,
        ]),
      });
    if (dto.kind === 'unclassified' || dto.kind === 'statement') {
      sheets.push({
        name: 'Não classificados',
        headers: ['Registro', 'Competência', 'Moeda', 'Valor', 'Motivo'],
        rows: report.unclassified.map((r) => [
          Number(r.entry_id),
          String(r.month),
          String(r.currency),
          String(r.amount),
          typeof r.reason === 'string' ? r.reason : '',
        ]),
      });
      sheets.push({
        name: 'Fontes sem competência',
        headers: [
          'Origem',
          'ID',
          'Projeto',
          'Moeda da origem',
          'Valor documental',
          'Saldo sem competência',
          'Data referência',
          'Descrição',
        ],
        rows: report.pending_sources.map((s) => [
          s.kind,
          s.id,
          s.project_id,
          s.currency,
          s.amount,
          s.remaining_amount ?? null,
          s.hint_date,
          s.description,
        ]),
      });
    }
    sheets.push({
      name: 'Cobertura e regras',
      headers: ['Informação', 'Valor'],
      rows: [
        ...report.warnings.map((w) => ['Aviso', w]),
        ['Motor', report.engine_version],
        ['Cobertura completa', String(report.complete)],
        ['Gerado em', report.generated_at],
        ['Filtros', JSON.stringify(report.filters)],
        ['Versões e hashes', JSON.stringify(report.entry_versions)],
        ...report.periods.map((p) => ['Fechamento ' + p.month, p.closure_hash]),
      ],
    });
    if (sheets.some((s) => s.rows.length > 50000))
      invalid('Limite de 50.000 linhas por aba.');
    const payload: FinanceWorkbook = {
      permissions,
      filters: report.filters,
      kind: 'dre:' + dto.kind,
      hash: hash(sheets),
      sheets,
    };
    const job = await this.dre.ds.transaction(async (m) => {
      const j = await m.save(
        ExportJobEntity,
        m.create(ExportJobEntity, {
          organizationId: report.organization_id,
          projectId: null,
          type: ExportJobType.DRE_XLSX,
          status: ExportJobStatus.PENDING,
          requestedById: actor.id,
          attemptCount: 1,
          requestedAt: new Date(),
          financePayload: payload,
        }),
      );
      await m.insert(ExportJobAuditLogEntity, {
        exportJobId: j.id,
        organizationId: report.organization_id,
        projectId: null,
        operation: ExportJobAuditOperation.REQUEST,
        performedBy: actor.id,
        changes: { kind: payload.kind, snapshot_hash: payload.hash },
      });
      return j;
    });
    this.processor.enqueue(Number(job.id));
    return { id: Number(job.id), status: job.status };
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async periodDetail(c: string, f: DreScopeDto, actor: ProjectActorContext) {

          rows.filter(

              r.operation === 'period-reopen:' + c,
          ),
        ),
    };
  }
```

<details><summary>Implementação chamada: DreService.close</summary>

[gai-backend/src/modules/managerial-dre/dre.service.ts:802](../../gai-backend/src/modules/managerial-dre/dre.service.ts#L802)

```ts
close(
    c: string,
    f: DreScopeDto,
    dto: DreCloseDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    month(c);
    return this.command(f, dto, actor, 'period-close:' + c, async (m, org) => {
      if (f.project_id)
        invalid('Fechamento é organizacional: retire o filtro de projeto.');
      if (c >= new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7))
        invalid('Fechamento exige mês civil encerrado.');
      if (dto.policy_reference.trim().length < 10)
        invalid('Referência de política aprovada obrigatória.');
      let p = await m.findOneBy(DrePeriod, { organizationId: org, month: c });
      if (p?.closed) conflict('Competência já fechada.');
      if ((p?.revision ?? 0) !== dto.revision)
        conflict('Competência alterada. Atualize.');
      const cert = {
        currency: dto.currency,
        reviewed_groups: dto.reviewed_groups,
        sources_reviewed: dto.sources_reviewed,
      };
      const report = await this.reportFrom(
        m,
        {
          organization_id: org,
          start_month: c,
          end_month: c,
          page: 1,
          page_size: 20,
        },
        actor,
        cert,
      );
      if (!report.complete && !dto.allow_incomplete)
        conflict(
          'Apuração incompleta. Classifique pendências ou autorize explicitamente fechamento parcial na política.',
        );
      const data = {
        currency: dto.currency,
        policy_reference: dto.policy_reference.trim(),
        reviewed_groups: dto.reviewed_groups,
        sources_reviewed: dto.sources_reviewed,
        allow_incomplete: dto.allow_incomplete,
        snapshot: report as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
        hash: hash(report),
      };
      if (!p) {
        p = await m.save(
          DrePeriod,
          m.create(DrePeriod, {
            organizationId: org,
            month: c,
            revision: 1,
            closed: true,
            data,
          }),
        );
        p.id = Number(p.id);
      } else {
        p.revision++;
        p.closed = true;
        p.data = data;
        await m
          .createQueryBuilder()
          .update(DrePeriod)
          .set({ revision: p.revision, closed: true, data: () => ':data' })
          .where('id=:id', { id: p.id, data: JSON.stringify(data) })
          .execute();
      }
      return { ...p };
    });
  }
```

```ts
reopen(
    c: string,
    f: DreScopeDto,
    dto: DreReopenDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    month(c);
    return this.command(f, dto, actor, 'period-reopen:' + c, async (m, org) => {
      const p = await m.findOneBy(DrePeriod, { organizationId: org, month: c });
      if (!p || !p.closed || p.revision !== dto.revision)
        conflict('Competência não fechada ou revisão divergente.');
      p.closed = false;
      p.revision++;
      await m.update(
        DrePeriod,
        { id: p.id, organizationId: org },
        { closed: false, revision: p.revision },
      );
      return { ...p };
    });
  }
```

```ts
async candidates(f: DreScopeDto, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    return this.ds.transaction('REPEATABLE READ', async (m) => {
      const pool = await this.candidatesFrom(m, f, actor),
        entries = await this.entryRows(m, f, actor),
        byKey = new Map(
          entries.filter((e) => e.sourceKey).map((e) => [e.sourceKey, e]),
        );
      const rows = pool.map((s) => ({
        ...s,
        entry_id: byKey.get(s.key)?.id ?? null,
        recognition_status: byKey.get(s.key)?.data.status ?? 'unclassified',
      }));
      return {
        items: rows.slice((f.page - 1) * f.page_size, f.page * f.page_size),
        total: rows.length,
        page: f.page,
        page_size: f.page_size,
        note: 'Datas de origem são referências documentais, não competências. Contratos, orçamentos, recebimentos e prestações agrupadoras não são novas receitas/custos.',
      };
    });
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/receivables/finance-export.service.ts:36](../../gai-backend/src/modules/receivables/finance-export.service.ts#L36)

```ts
async create(dto: FinanceExportDto, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    const keys = [
      'finance:export',
      'export-jobs:create',
      ...(['expected', 'actual', 'statement'].includes(dto.kind)
        ? [
            'cash-flow:read',
            ...(dto.filters.direction === 'out' ? [] : ['receivables:read']),
            ...(dto.filters.direction === 'in'
              ? []
              : [
                  'payments:read',
                  'expenses:read',
                  'expense-installments:read',
                ]),
          ]
        : ['receivables:read']),
    ];
    await this.r.require(actor, keys);
    const job = await this.r.ds.transaction('REPEATABLE READ', async (m) => {
      const org = await this.r.filterReferences(m, dto.filters, actor),
        sheets: FinanceWorkbook['sheets'] = [];
      if (['expected', 'actual', 'statement'].includes(dto.kind)) {
        const f = {
          ...dto.filters,
          view: dto.kind === 'statement' ? dto.filters.view : dto.kind,
        };
        const report = await this.cash.from(m, f, actor);
        sheets.push({
          name: 'Movimentos',
          headers: [
            'Fonte',
            'ID',
            'Recebível',
            'Parcela',
            'Cliente',
            'Projeto',
            'Contrato',
            'Moeda',
            'Direção',
            'Visão',
            'Data',
            'Valor',
            'Descrição',
            'Status',
          ],
          rows: report.movements.map((r) => [
            r.source,
            r.source_id,
            r.receivable_id,
            r.installment_id,
            r.company_id,
            r.project_id,
            r.contract_id,
            r.currency,
            r.direction,
            r.view,
            r.on,
            r.amount,
            r.description,
            r.status,
          ]),
        });
        sheets.push({
          name: 'Indicadores',
          headers: [
            'Moeda',
            'Entradas previstas',
            'Saídas previstas',
            'Entradas realizadas',
            'Saídas realizadas',
            'Vencido',
            'Resultado realizado',
            'Resultado projetado',
          ],
          rows: report.totals.map((t) => [
            t.currency,
            t.expected_in,
            t.expected_out,
            t.actual_in,
            t.actual_out,
            t.overdue,
            t.actual_net,
            t.projected_net,
          ]),
        });
        sheets.push({
          name: 'Limitações',
          headers: ['Limitação'],
          rows: report.limitations.map((l) => [l]),
        });
      } else {
        const data = await this.r.list(
          {
            ...dto.filters,
            ...(dto.kind === 'receipts'
              ? { date_from: undefined, date_to: undefined }
              : {}),
            page: 1,
            page_size: 10000,
          },
          actor,
        );
        if (dto.kind === 'receivables')
          sheets.push({
            name: 'Recebíveis',
            headers: [
              'ID',
              'Cliente',
              'Projeto',
              'Contrato',
              'Descrição',
              'Moeda',
              'Original',
              'Recebido líquido',
              'Aberto',
              'Status',
              'Origem',
            ],
            rows: data.items.map((r) => [
              r.id,
              r.companyId,
              r.projectId,
              r.contractId,
              r.data.description,
              r.currency,
              r.amount,
              r.received,
              r.open,
              r.status,
              r.sourceKey,
            ]),
          });
        else if (dto.kind === 'installments')
          sheets.push({
            name: 'Parcelas',
            headers: [
              'Recebível',
              'ID',
              'Número',
              'Vencimento',
              'Moeda',
              'Valor',
              'Recebido',
              'Aberto',
              'Status',
            ],
            rows: data.items.flatMap((r) =>
              r.installments
                .filter(
                  (i) =>
                    (!dto.filters.date_from ||
                      i.dueOn >= dto.filters.date_from) &&
                    (!dto.filters.date_to || i.dueOn <= dto.filters.date_to),
                )
                .map((i) => [
                  r.id,
                  i.id,
                  i.position,
                  i.dueOn,
                  r.currency,
                  i.amount,
                  i.received,
                  i.open,
                  i.status,
                ]),
            ),
          });
        else
          sheets.push({
            name: 'Recebimentos',
            headers: [
              'Recebível',
              'Evento',
              'Parcela',
              'Operação',
              'Data',
              'Moeda',
              'Valor',
              'Forma',
              'Referência',
              'Motivo',
              'Autor',
              'Registrado em',
            ],
            rows: data.items.flatMap((r) =>
              r.events
                .filter(
                  (e) =>
                    e.amount &&
                    e.effectiveOn &&
                    (!dto.filters.date_from ||
                      e.effectiveOn >= dto.filters.date_from) &&
                    (!dto.filters.date_to ||
                      e.effectiveOn <= dto.filters.date_to),
                )
                .map((e) => [
                  r.id,
                  e.id,
                  e.installmentId,
                  e.operation,
                  e.effectiveOn,
                  r.currency,
                  e.amount,
                  text(e.details.method),
                  text(e.details.reference),
                  text(e.details.reason),
                  e.actorId,
                  e.recordedAt.toISOString(),
                ]),
            ),
          });
      }
      if (sheets.some((s) => s.rows.length > 50000))
        invalid('Exportação excede 50.000 linhas.');
      sheets.push({
        name: 'Filtros',
        headers: ['Campo', 'Valor'],
        rows: Object.entries({ ...dto.filters, kind: dto.kind }).map(
          ([k, v]) => [k, String(v)],
        ),
      });
      const permissions = [
          ...new Set(keys.filter((k) => k !== 'export-jobs:create')),
        ],
        payload = {
          permissions,
          filters: dto.filters,
          kind: dto.kind,
          hash: hash(sheets),
          sheets,
        };
      const now = new Date();
      const saved = await m.save(
        ExportJobEntity,
        m.create(ExportJobEntity, {
          organizationId: org,
          projectId: null,
          type: ExportJobType.FINANCE_XLSX,
          status: ExportJobStatus.PENDING,
          requestedById: actor.id,
          attemptCount: 1,
          requestedAt: now,
          financePayload: payload,
        }),
      );
      await m.insert(ExportJobAuditLogEntity, {
        exportJobId: saved.id,
        organizationId: org,
        projectId: null,
        operation: ExportJobAuditOperation.REQUEST,
        performedBy: actor.id,
        changes: {
          kind: dto.kind,
          filters: dto.filters,
          snapshot_hash: payload.hash,
        },
      });
      return saved;
    });
    this.processor.enqueue(Number(job.id));
    return { id: Number(job.id), status: job.status };
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/receivables/finance-export.service.ts:338](../../gai-backend/src/modules/receivables/finance-export.service.ts#L338)

```ts
async download(
    id: number,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
    type = ExportJobType.FINANCE_XLSX,
  ) {
    const j = await this.job(id, actor, true, type);
    if (
      j.status === ExportJobStatus.EXPIRED ||
      (j.expiresAt && j.expiresAt <= new Date())
    )
      throw new GoneException('Exportação expirada.');
    if (j.status !== ExportJobStatus.FINISHED)
      throw new ConflictException('Exportação ainda não disponível.');
    const row = await this.r.ds
      .getRepository(ExportJobEntity)
      .createQueryBuilder('j')
      .addSelect('j.fileContent')
      .where('j.id=:id', { id })
      .getOneOrFail();
    if (
      !row.fileContent ||
      !j.checksum ||
      hashBuffer(row.fileContent) !== j.checksum
    )
      throw new ConflictException(
        'Arquivo indisponível ou checksum divergente.',
      );
    await this.r.ds.manager.insert(ExportJobAuditLogEntity, {
      exportJobId: id,
      organizationId: j.organizationId,
      projectId: null,
      operation: ExportJobAuditOperation.DOWNLOAD,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: { checksum: j.checksum },
    });
    return {
      content: row.fileContent,
      fileName: j.fileName ?? `financeiro-${id}.xlsx`,
    };
  }
```

</details>

[gai-backend/src/modules/receivables/receivable.service.ts:498](../../gai-backend/src/modules/receivables/receivable.service.ts#L498)

```ts
async list(f: FinanceFilterDto, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    return this.ds.transaction('REPEATABLE READ', async (m) => {
      const rows = await this.cohort(m, f, actor),
        items = [] as Awaited<ReturnType<ReceivableService['detailFrom']>>[];
      for (const row of rows) {
        const d = await this.detailFrom(m, row);
        if (
          f.status &&
          (f.status === 'overdue' ? !d.overdue : d.status !== f.status)
        )
          continue;
        if (
          (f.date_from || f.date_to) &&
          !d.installments.some(
            (i) =>
              (!f.date_from || i.dueOn >= f.date_from) &&
              (!f.date_to || i.dueOn <= f.date_to),
          )
        )
          continue;
        items.push(d);
      }
      return {
        items: items.slice((f.page - 1) * f.page_size, f.page * f.page_size),
        total: items.length,
        page: f.page,
        page_size: f.page_size,
      };
    });
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/receivables/receivable.service.ts:345](../../gai-backend/src/modules/receivables/receivable.service.ts#L345)

```ts
async create(dto: ConfirmReceivableDto, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    const org = this.org(actor, dto.organization_id),
      fingerprint = hash({ operation: 'create', dto });
    return this.ds.transaction(async (m) => {
      await this.orgLock(m, org);
      const retry = await this.retry(
        m,
        org,
        dto.command_key,
        fingerprint,
        actor,
      );
      if (retry) return retry;
      const p = await this.prepare(m, dto, actor, true);
      if (hash(p) !== dto.preview_hash)
        conflict('Prévia mudou. Revise e confirme novamente.');
      if (
        p.source_key &&
        (await m.exists(R, {
          where: { organizationId: org, sourceKey: p.source_key },
        }))
      )
        conflict('Esta origem já gerou um recebível, inclusive se cancelado.');
      const row = await m.save(
        R,
        m.create(R, {
          organizationId: org,
          companyId: p.company_id,
          projectId: p.project_id,
          contractId: p.contract_id,
          sourceKey: p.source_key,
          data: p.data,
          amount: p.data.amount,
          currency: p.data.currency,
          revision: 1,
          cancelled: false,
          createdAt: new Date(),
        }),
      );
      row.id = Number(row.id);
      for (const i of p.plan.rows)
        await m.insert(I, {
          organizationId: org,
          receivableId: row.id,
          position: i.position,
          kind: i.kind,
          dueOn: i.due_on,
          amount: i.amount,
        });
      await this.event(m, row, actor, dto.command_key, fingerprint, 'create', {
        reason: dto.reason,
        snapshot: p,
      });
      return this.detailFrom(m, row);
    });
  }
```

</details>

```ts
receive(id: number, dto: ReceiptDto, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    return this.mutate(id, dto, actor, 'receipt', async (m, row) => {
      const d = await this.detailFrom(m, row),
        i = d.installments.find((i) => i.id === dto.installment_id);
      if (!i) invalid('Parcela não pertence ao recebível.');
      civil(dto.received_on);
      if (
        dto.received_on < row.data.issued_on ||
        dto.received_on > new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
      )
        invalid('Data de recebimento fora do intervalo emissão/hoje.');
      const value = scaled(dto.amount);
      if (value <= 0n || value > scaled(i.open))
        conflict('Valor deve ser positivo e não superar o saldo da parcela.');
      if (!dto.method.trim() || !dto.reference.trim())
        invalid('Forma e referência obrigatórias.');
      if (
        d.events.some(
          (e) =>
            e.operation === 'receipt' &&
            e.details.reference === dto.reference.trim(),
        )
      )
        conflict('Referência de recebimento já registrada neste recebível.');
      return {
        details: {
          method: dto.method.trim(),
          reference: dto.reference.trim(),
          notes: dto.notes ?? '',
        },
        extra: {
          installmentId: i.id,
          amount: decimal(value),
          effectiveOn: dto.received_on,
        },
      };
    });
  }
```

```ts
reverse(
    id: number,
    eventId: number,
    dto: ReverseReceiptDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.mutate(id, dto, actor, 'reversal', async (m, row) => {
      const d = await this.detailFrom(m, row),
        e = d.events.find((e) => e.id === eventId && e.operation === 'receipt');
      if (!e || !e.amount || !e.effectiveOn)
        invalid('Recebimento não encontrado neste recebível.');
      if (d.events.some((r) => r.reversesId === e.id))
        conflict('Recebimento já estornado.');
      civil(dto.reversed_on);
      if (
        dto.reversed_on < e.effectiveOn ||
        dto.reversed_on > new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
      )
        invalid('Data de estorno fora do intervalo recebimento/hoje.');
      return {
        details: { original_event_id: e.id },
        extra: {
          installmentId: e.installmentId,
          reversesId: e.id,
          amount: decimal(-scaled(e.amount)),
          effectiveOn: dto.reversed_on,
        },
      };
    });
  }
```

```ts
async source(kind: string, id: number, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    if (!['contract', 'budget', 'amendment'].includes(kind))
      invalid('Origem inválida.');
    const m = this.ds.manager;
    if (kind === 'budget') {
      await this.require(actor, ['budgets:read']);
      const b = await m.findOne(BudgetEntity, { where: { id } });
      if (!b) invalid('Origem não encontrada.');
      this.scope.assertCanAccessProject(actor, b.organizationId);
      if (b.status !== 'approved' || !b.approvedVersionId)
        invalid('Orçamento não aprovado.');
      const v = await m.findOneByOrFail(BudgetVersionEntity, {
        id: b.approvedVersionId,
        budgetId: b.id,
        organizationId: b.organizationId,
      });
      return {
        company_id: b.companyId,
        project_id: b.projectId,
        organization_id: b.organizationId,
        amount: v.snapshot.calculation.final_price,
        currency: v.snapshot.calculation.currency,
        payment: v.snapshot.input.payment,
        issued_on: v.snapshot.input.prepared_on,
        description: 'Orçamento ' + b.number,
      };
    }
    await this.require(actor, ['contracts:read']);
    const a =
      kind === 'amendment'
        ? await m.findOne(ContractAmendmentEntity, { where: { id } })
        : null;
    if (kind === 'amendment' && !a) invalid('Aditivo não encontrado.');
    const c = await m.findOne(ContractEntity, {
      where: { id: a ? Number(a.contractId) : id },
    });
    if (!c) invalid('Contrato não encontrado.');
    this.scope.assertCanAccessProject(actor, Number(c.organizationId));
    return {
      company_id: Number(c.companyId),
      project_id: Number(c.projectId),
      organization_id: Number(c.organizationId),
      amount: a?.valueDelta ?? c.data.original_value,
      currency: c.data.currency,
      description:
        'Contrato ' + c.number + (a ? ' / aditivo ' + a.identifier : ''),
    };
  }
```

</details>

[gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-item-images/application/use-cases/create-inventory-item-image-download-url.use-case.ts:37](../../gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-item-images/application/use-cases/create-inventory-item-image-download-url.use-case.ts#L37)

```ts
async execute(
    imageId: number,
    actor: InventoryItemImageActorContext,
    expected?: { projectId?: number; itemId?: number },
  ): Promise<InventoryItemImageDownloadUrlResponseDto> {
    const image = await this.getImage.findAndAuthorize(
      imageId,
      actor,
      expected,
    );
    if (image.status !== InventoryItemImageStatus.UPLOADED) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Only uploaded images can be downloaded',
      });
    }

    const signed = await this.storageSigner.createDownloadUrl({
      bucket: image.bucket,
      path: image.path,
      mimeType: image.mimeType,
      expiresInSeconds: this.scope.presignedUrlTtlSeconds(),
      sizeBytes: Number(image.toProps().sizeBytes),
      checksum: image.toProps().checksum,
    });

    await this.repository.audit({
      inventoryItemImageId: image.id,
      organizationId: image.organizationId,
      inventoryItemId: image.inventoryItemId,
      operation: InventoryItemImageAuditOperation.DOWNLOAD_URL,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: {
        download_url_generated: { before: false, after: true },
      },
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'CREATE_INVENTORY_ITEM_IMAGE_DOWNLOAD_URL',
      inventoryItemImageId: image.id,
      inventoryItemId: image.inventoryItemId,
      organizationId: image.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return {
      image: InventoryItemImageResponseDto.fromDomain(image),
      download_url: signed.url,
      expires_in_seconds: signed.expiresInSeconds,
    };
  }
```

</details>

[gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-items/application/use-cases/list-inventory-items.use-case.ts:30](../../gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-items/application/use-cases/list-inventory-items.use-case.ts#L30)

```ts
async execute(
    query: ListInventoryItemsQueryDto,
    actor: InventoryItemActorContext,
    forcedProjectId?: number,
  ): Promise<InventoryItemListResponseDto> {
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const projectId = forcedProjectId ?? query.project_id;
    let organizationId = this.scope.resolveOrganizationFilter(
      actor,
      query.organization_id,
    );

    if (projectId !== undefined) {
      const project = await this.projects.findById(projectId);
      if (!project) {
        throw new NotFoundException({
          code: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: 'Project not found',
        });
      }
      this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, project.organizationId);
      organizationId = project.organizationId;
    }

    const { items, total } = await this.repository.list({
      page,
      pageSize,
      organizationId,
      projectId,
      status: query.status,
      oldPlate: this.scope.normalizePlate(query.old_plate) ?? undefined,
      newPlate: this.scope.normalizePlate(query.new_plate) ?? undefined,
      description: query.description,
      search: query.search,
    });

    return {
      items: items.map((item) => InventoryItemResponseDto.fromDomain(item)),
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
      total_items: total,
      total_pages: total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    };
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async overview(
    filters: OrganizationOverviewQueryDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    await this.authorizeFilters(filters, actor);
    const query = this.query(filters, actor);
    const [totals, statuses, timeline, projects, geography, located] =
      await Promise.all([
        query
          .clone()
          .select('COUNT(*)', 'total')
          .addSelect(
            'SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = :openStatus THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)',
            'open',
          )
          .setParameter('openStatus', ProjectStatus.ACTIVE)
          .getRawOne<{ total: string; open: string }>(),
        query
          .clone()
          .select('p.status', 'status')
          .addSelect('COUNT(*)', 'total')
          .groupBy('p.status')
          .getRawMany<{ status: string; total: string }>(),
        query
          .clone()
          .select("DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m')", 'period')
          .addSelect('COUNT(*)', 'total')
          .groupBy("DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m')")
          .orderBy('period', 'ASC')
          .getRawMany<{ period: string; total: string }>(),
        query
          .clone()
          .select(['p.id', 'p.name', 'p.status', 'p.createdAt'])
          .orderBy('p.created_at', 'DESC')
          .addOrderBy('p.id', 'DESC')
          .take(50)
          .getMany(),
        query
          .clone()
          .innerJoin(
            'project_units',
            'pu',
            'pu.project_id = p.id AND pu.organization_id = p.organization_id AND pu.deleted_at IS NULL',
          )
          .innerJoin(
            'company_units',
            'cu',
            'cu.id = pu.company_unit_id AND cu.organization_id = p.organization_id AND cu.deleted_at IS NULL',
          )
          .select('UPPER(TRIM(cu.state))', 'state')
          .addSelect('COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)', 'total')
          .andWhere('UPPER(TRIM(cu.state)) IN (:...ufs)', { ufs: UFS })
          .groupBy('UPPER(TRIM(cu.state))')
          .getRawMany<{ state: string; total: string }>(),
        query
          .clone()
          .andWhere(
            `EXISTS (SELECT 1 ${UNIT_LINK} AND UPPER(TRIM(cu.state)) IN (:...ufs))`,
            { ufs: UFS },
          )
          .getCount(),
      ]);
    const total = Number(totals?.total ?? 0);
    const open = Number(totals?.open ?? 0);
    return {
      total_projects: total,
      open_projects: open,
      open_percentage: total ? Math.round((open / total) * 10000) / 100 : 0,
      total_contract_value: null,
      average_contract_value: null,
      open_contract_value: null,
      contracted_items: null,
      statuses: statuses.map((row) => ({
        status: row.status,
        total: Number(row.total),
      })),
      timeline: timeline.map((row) => ({
        period: row.period,
        total: Number(row.total),
      })),
      geography: geography.map((row) => ({
        state: row.state,
        total: Number(row.total),
      })),
      unlocated_projects: total - located,
      projects: projects.map((p) => ({
        id: p.id,
        name: p.name,
        status: p.status,
        created_at: p.createdAt,
      })),
    };
  }
```

```ts
async overview(
    filters: OrganizationOverviewQueryDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    // All reads in this response share one repeatable-read snapshot, including
    // the project subquery, contract rows and immutable version history.
    return this.ds.transaction('REPEATABLE READ', async (m) => {
      const projects = this.operational.query(filters, actor).select('p.id');
      const q = m
        .getRepository(ContractEntity)
        .createQueryBuilder('c')
        .where('c.organization_id = :organization', {
          organization: actor.organizationId,
        })
        .andWhere(
          `c.project_id IN (${projects.getQuery()})`,
          projects.getParameters(),
        );
      applyCommercialFilters(q, 'c', filters);
      const rows = await q.orderBy('c.id', 'ASC').take(10001).getMany();
      if (rows.length > 10000)
        invalid('Refine os filtros: limite de 10.000 contratos por relatório.');
      const totals = commercialTotals(rows);
      const groupBy = (key: 'segment' | 'company_name' | 'company_state') =>
        [
          ...new Set(
            rows.map((r) =>
              key === 'company_name'
                ? String(r.companyId)
                : (r.data[key] ?? 'Não informado'),
            ),
          ),
        ]
          .sort()
          .map((value) => {
            const group = rows.filter(
              (r) =>
                (key === 'company_name'
                  ? String(r.companyId)
                  : (r.data[key] ?? 'Não informado')) === value,
            );
            return {
              label:
                key === 'company_name' ? group[0].data.company_name : value,
              count: group.length,
              totals: commercialTotals(group),
            };
          });
      const years = [
        ...new Set(
          rows.flatMap((r) =>
            r.data.contracted_on ? [r.data.contracted_on.slice(0, 4)] : [],
          ),
        ),
      ]
        .sort()
        .map((year) => {
          const group = rows.filter((r) =>
            r.data.contracted_on?.startsWith(year),
          );
          return { year, count: group.length, totals: commercialTotals(group) };
        });
      const versions = rows.length
        ? await m
            .getRepository(ContractVersionEntity)
            .createQueryBuilder('v')
            .where('v.organization_id = :org', { org: actor.organizationId })
            .andWhere('v.contract_id IN (:...ids)', {
              ids: rows.map((r) => r.id),
            })
            .orderBy('v.recorded_at', 'ASC')
            .addOrderBy('v.id', 'ASC')
            .take(100001)
            .getMany()
        : [];
      if (versions.length > 100000)
        invalid('Refine os filtros: histórico excede 100.000 versões.');
      const months = [
        ...new Set(versions.map((v) => v.recordedAt.toISOString().slice(0, 7))),
      ];
      const statusEvolution = months.map((month) => {
        const latest = new Map<number, string>();
        for (const v of versions)
          if (v.recordedAt.toISOString().slice(0, 7) <= month)
            latest.set(v.contractId, v.data.status);
        return {
          month,
          statuses: [...new Set(latest.values())].sort().map((status) => ({
            status,
            count: [...latest.values()].filter((s) => s === status).length,
          })),
        };
      });
      const estimated = rows.filter((r) => r.data.estimated_assets != null);
      const stages: {
        stage: string;
        source: string;
        total: number | null;
        completed: number | null;
        percentage: number | null;
      }[] = [];
      for (const [stage, table, doneStatus, permission] of [
        [
          'Preparação aprovada',
          'project_preparations',
          'approved',
          'project-preparation:read',
        ],
        [
          'Coordenação de campo concluída',
          'field_checklists',
          'completed',
          'field-coordination:read',
        ],
        [
          'Sessões de inventário finalizadas',
          'inventory_sessions',
          'finished',
          'inventory-sessions:read',
        ],
      ]) {
        if (!(await hasAllPermissions(actor, [permission], this.permissions)))
          continue;
        const counts = await m
          .createQueryBuilder()
          .from(table, 'stage')
          .select('COUNT(*)', 'total')
          .addSelect(
            'SUM(CASE WHEN stage.status = :doneStatus THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)',
            'completed',
          )
          .where('stage.organization_id = :stageOrg', {
            stageOrg: actor.organizationId,
          })
          .andWhere(
            `stage.project_id IN (${projects.getQuery()})`,
            projects.getParameters(),
          )
          .setParameter('doneStatus', doneStatus)
          .getRawOne<{ total: string; completed: string | null }>();
        const total = Number(counts?.total ?? 0),
          completed = Number(counts?.completed ?? 0);
        stages.push({
          stage,
          source: table,
          total: total || null,
          completed: total ? completed : null,
          percentage: total
            ? Math.round((completed / total) * 10000) / 100
            : null,
        });
      }
      const payload = {
        filters: Object.fromEntries(
          Object.entries(filters)
            .filter(
              ([k, v]) =>
                v != null &&
                ![
                  'expected_hash',
                  'page',
                  'page_size',
                  'sort',
                  'direction',
                ].includes(k),
            )
            .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)),
        ),
        count: rows.length,
        totals,
        annual: years,
        undated_contracts: rows.filter((r) => !r.data.contracted_on).length,
        estimated_assets: estimated.length
          ? estimated.reduce((s, r) => s + r.data.estimated_assets!, 0)
          : null,
        missing_estimated_assets: rows.length - estimated.length,
        segments: groupBy('segment'),
        companies: groupBy('company_name'),
        states: groupBy('company_state'),
        status_evolution: statusEvolution,
        operational_stages: stages,
        statuses: [...new Set(rows.map((r) => r.data.status))]
          .sort()
          .map((status) => ({
            status,
            count: rows.filter((r) => r.data.status === status).length,
          })),
        rows: rows.map((r) => ({
          id: r.id,
          project_id: r.projectId,
          revision: r.revision,
          ...r.data,
        })),
      };
      return {
        ...payload,
        hash: createHash('sha256')
          .update(JSON.stringify(payload))
          .digest('hex'),
      };
    });
  }
```

```ts
async saveReport(
    filters: OrganizationOverviewQueryDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    const payload = await this.overview(filters, actor);
    if (!filters.expected_hash || payload.hash !== filters.expected_hash)
      conflict('Os dados mudaram. Atualize os indicadores antes de exportar.');
    return this.ds.getRepository(CommercialReportEntity).save({
      organizationId: actor.organizationId!,
      actorId: actor.id,
      recordedAt: new Date(),
      payload,
    });
  }
```

```ts
async report(id: number, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    // Reuse role/organization enforcement even for a historical snapshot.
    this.operational.query({}, actor);
    const report = await this.ds
      .getRepository(CommercialReportEntity)
      .findOneBy({ id, organizationId: actor.organizationId! });
    if (!report)
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Relatório não encontrado.',
      });
    const payload = report.payload as Partial<CommercialPayload>;
    const sourcePermissions: Record<string, string> = {
      project_preparations: 'project-preparation:read',
      field_checklists: 'field-coordination:read',
      inventory_sessions: 'inventory-sessions:read',
    };
    for (const stage of payload.operational_stages ?? []) {
      const permission = sourcePermissions[stage.source];
      if (
        !permission ||
        !(await hasAllPermissions(actor, [permission], this.permissions))
      ) {
        throw new ForbiddenException({
          code: 'FORBIDDEN',
          message:
            'A fonte operacional deste relatório não está mais autorizada.',
        });
      }
    }
    return report;
  }
```

```ts
@Get('reports/:id/export.:format')
  async export(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Param('format') format: string,
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Res() res: Response,
  ) {
    if (!['csv', 'xlsx'].includes(format))
      invalid('Formato de exportação inválido.');
    const report = await this.service.report(id, this.actor(req)),
      payload = report.payload as CommercialPayload;
    const rows = payload.rows.map((r) => ({
      ID: r.id,
      Projeto: r.project_id,
      Versao: r.revision,
      Contrato: r.number,
      Empresa: r.company_name,
      Contratacao: r.contracted_on ?? '',
      Moeda: r.currency,
      Original: r.original_value ?? '',
      Vigente: r.current_value ?? '',
      Status: r.status,
      Recorrente: r.recurring == null ? '' : String(r.recurring),
      Segmento: r.segment ?? '',
      UF: r.company_state ?? '',
      Servicos: r.services.join('; '),
      Bens: r.estimated_assets ?? '',
    }));
    const safe = rows.map((row) =>
      Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(row).map(([k, v]) => [
          k,
          typeof v === 'string' ? safeSpreadsheetText(v) : v,
        ]),
      ),
    );
    res.setHeader(
      'Content-Disposition',
      `attachment; filename="contratos-relatorio-${id}.${format === 'csv' ? 'csv' : 'xlsx'}"`,
    );
    if (format === 'csv') {
      const headers = [
        'ID',
        'Projeto',
        'Versao',
        'Contrato',
        'Empresa',
        'Contratacao',
        'Moeda',
        'Original',
        'Vigente',
        'Status',
        'Recorrente',
        'Segmento',
        'UF',
        'Servicos',
        'Bens',
      ];
      const escape = (v: unknown) =>
        `"${(typeof v === 'string' ? v : typeof v === 'number' ? String(v) : '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
      return res
        .type('text/csv; charset=utf-8')
        .send(
          '\uFEFF' +
            [
              headers.map(escape).join(';'),
              ...safe.map((r) => headers.map((k) => escape(r[k])).join(';')),
            ].join('\r\n'),
        );
    }
    const workbook = XLSX.utils.book_new();
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(
      workbook,
      XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(safe),
      'Contratos',
    );
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(
      workbook,
      XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet([
        {
          Relatorio: id,
          Gerado: report.recordedAt.toISOString(),
          Hash: payload.hash,
          Filtros: JSON.stringify(payload.filters),
        },
      ]),
      'Recorte',
    );
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(
      workbook,
      XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(
        payload.totals.map((t) => ({
          Moeda: t.currency,
          Contratos: t.count,
          Original: t.original.value,
          Vigente: t.current.value,
          Ausentes: t.current.missing,
          Ticket: t.average,
          Ativos: t.active.value,
        })),
      ),
      'Indicadores',
    );
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(
      workbook,
      XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(
        payload.annual.flatMap((a) =>
          a.totals.map((t) => ({
            Ano: a.year,
            Moeda: t.currency,
            Contratos: t.count,
            Original: t.original.value,
            Vigente: t.current.value,
            Ticket: t.average,
            Ausentes: t.current.missing,
          })),
        ),
      ),
      'Anual',
    );
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(
      workbook,
      XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(
        payload.operational_stages.map((s) => ({
          Etapa: s.stage,
          Fonte: s.source,
          Registros: s.total,
          Concluidos: s.completed,
          Percentual: s.percentage,
        })),
      ),
      'Etapas',
    );
    for (const [title, groups] of [
      ['Segmentos', payload.segments],
      ['Empresas', payload.companies],
      ['UF', payload.states],
    ] as const) {
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(
        workbook,
        XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(
          groups.flatMap((g) =>
            g.totals.map((t) => ({
              Grupo: safeSpreadsheetText(g.label),
              Moeda: t.currency,
              Contratos: t.count,
              Original: t.original.value,
              Vigente: t.current.value,
            })),
          ),
        ),
        title,
      );
    }
    return res
      .type('application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet')
      .send(XLSX.write(workbook, { type: 'buffer', bookType: 'xlsx' }));
  }
```

```ts
async companyPage(
    filters: OrganizationOverviewQueryDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    await this.authorizeFilters(filters, actor);
    const query = this.query(filters, actor).leftJoin(
      'companies',
      'c',
      'c.id = p.company_id AND c.organization_id = p.organization_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL',
    );
    if (filters.company_search?.trim())
      query.andWhere("c.name LIKE :companySearch ESCAPE '!'", {
        companySearch: `%${filters.company_search.trim().replace(/[!%_]/g, '!$&')}%`,
      });
    const grouped = query
      .select('c.id', 'id')
      .addSelect('c.name', 'name')
      .addSelect('COUNT(*)', 'total')
      .groupBy('c.id')
      .addGroupBy('c.name');
    // Bound response size and paginate groups in SQL, including an explicit unlinked bucket.
    const counts = await this.projects.manager
      .createQueryBuilder()
      .select('COUNT(*)', 'total')
      .from(`(${grouped.getQuery()})`, 'groups')
      .setParameters(grouped.getParameters())
      .getRawOne<{ total: string | number }>();
    const total = Number(counts?.total ?? 0);
    const size = filters.page_size ?? 10;
    const page = Math.min(
      filters.page ?? 1,
      Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / size)),
    );
    const rows = await grouped
      .orderBy(
        filters.sort === 'name' ? 'c.name' : 'COUNT(*)',
        filters.direction ?? 'DESC',
      )
      .addOrderBy('c.id', 'ASC')
      .offset((page - 1) * size)
      .limit(size)
      .getRawMany<{
        id: string | number | null;
        name: string | null;
        total: string | number;
      }>();
    return {
      total,
      page,
      page_size: size,
      items: rows.map((row) => ({
        id: row.id == null ? null : Number(row.id),
        name: row.name ?? 'Sem empresa vinculada',
        total: Number(row.total),
      })),
    };
  }
```

```ts
async exportRows(
    filters: OrganizationOverviewQueryDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    await this.authorizeFilters(filters, actor);
    const rows = await this.query(filters, actor)
      .select(['p.id', 'p.name', 'p.status', 'p.createdAt'])
      .orderBy('p.id', 'ASC')
      .take(10001)
      .getMany();
    if (rows.length > 10000)
      throw new BadRequestException({
        code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
        message: 'Refine os filtros para exportar até 10.000 projetos.',
      });
    return rows.map((p) => ({
      ID: p.id,
      Projeto: p.name,
      Status: p.status,
      'Criado em': p.createdAt.toISOString(),
    }));
  }
```

```ts
async projectPage(
    filters: OrganizationOverviewQueryDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    await this.authorizeFilters(filters, actor);
    const query = this.query(filters, actor);
    const total = await query.clone().getCount();
    const size = filters.page_size ?? 10;
    const page = Math.min(
      filters.page ?? 1,
      Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / size)),
    );
    const sort =
      {
        id: 'p.id',
        name: 'p.name',
        status: 'p.status',
        created_at: 'p.created_at',
        company: 'c.name',
        addresses: 'addresses',
        states: 'states',
      }[filters.sort ?? 'created_at'] ?? 'p.created_at';
    query
      .leftJoin(
        'companies',
        'c',
        'c.id = p.company_id AND c.organization_id = p.organization_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL',
      )
      .select('p.id', 'id')
      .addSelect('p.name', 'name')
      .addSelect('p.status', 'status')
      .addSelect('p.created_at', 'created_at')
      .addSelect('c.name', 'company')
      .addSelect(`(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cu.id) ${UNIT_LINK})`, 'addresses')
      .addSelect(
        `(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(cu.state))) ${UNIT_LINK})`,
        'states',
      )
      .orderBy(sort, filters.direction ?? 'DESC');
    if (sort !== 'p.id') query.addOrderBy('p.id', 'DESC');
    const pagedRows = await query
      .offset((page - 1) * size)
      .limit(size)
      .getRawMany<{
        id: string | number;
        name: string;
        status: string;
        created_at: Date | string;
        company: string | null;
        addresses: string | number;
        states: string | null;
      }>();
    return {
      total,
      page,
      page_size: size,
      items: pagedRows.map((row) => ({
        ...row,
        id: Number(row.id),
        addresses: Number(row.addresses),
      })),
    };
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async execute(
    dto: CreateOrganizationDto,
    performedBy: number | null,
  ): Promise<OrganizationResponseDto> {
    const cnpj = Cnpj.create(dto.cnpj);
    const existing = await this.repository.findByCnpj(cnpj.getValue());
    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Organization with this CNPJ already exists',
      });
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const organization = new Organization({
      id: 0,
      legalName: dto.legal_name.trim(),
      tradeName: dto.trade_name?.trim() ?? null,
      cnpj,
      contactEmail: dto.contact_email ?? null,
      contactPhone: dto.contact_phone ?? null,
      status: dto.status ?? OrganizationStatus.ACTIVE,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    });

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(organization, {
      organizationId: 0,
      operation: OrganizationAuditOperation.CREATE,
      performedBy,
      changes: {
        legal_name: { before: null, after: organization.legalName },
        cnpj: { before: null, after: cnpj.getValue() },
        status: { before: null, after: organization.status },
      },
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'CREATE_ORGANIZATION',
      organizationId: saved.id,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return OrganizationResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async execute(
    id: number,
    dto: UpdateOrganizationDto,
    performedBy: number | null,
  ): Promise<OrganizationResponseDto> {
    if ('cnpj' in (dto as Record<string, unknown>)) {
      throw new BadRequestException({
        code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
        message: 'CNPJ cannot be changed after creation',
      });
    }

    const organization = await this.repository.findById(id);
    if (!organization) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Organization not found',
      });
    }

    const changes = organization.updateFields({
      legalName: dto.legal_name?.trim(),
      tradeName:
        dto.trade_name !== undefined
          ? (dto.trade_name?.trim() ?? null)
          : undefined,
      contactEmail: dto.contact_email,
      contactPhone: dto.contact_phone,
    });

    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 0) {
      return OrganizationResponseDto.fromDomain(organization);
    }

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(organization, {
      organizationId: organization.id,
      operation: OrganizationAuditOperation.UPDATE,
      performedBy,
      changes,
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'UPDATE_ORGANIZATION',
      organizationId: saved.id,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return OrganizationResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async execute(
    id: number,
    performedBy: number | null,
  ): Promise<OrganizationResponseDto> {
    const organization = await this.repository.findById(id);
    if (!organization) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Organization not found',
      });
    }

    if (organization.status === OrganizationStatus.ACTIVE) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Organization is already active',
      });
    }

    const sessionsRevoked = await this.sessions.revokeAllForOrganization(
      organization.id,
      new Date(),
    );
    const previousStatus = organization.status;
    organization.activate();

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(organization, {
      organizationId: organization.id,
      operation: OrganizationAuditOperation.ACTIVATE,
      performedBy,
      changes: {
        status: { before: previousStatus, after: OrganizationStatus.ACTIVE },
      },
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'ACTIVATE_ORGANIZATION',
      organizationId: saved.id,
      sessionsRevoked,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return OrganizationResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

[gai-backend/src/modules/organizations/application/use-cases/deactivate-organization.use-case.ts:32](../../gai-backend/src/modules/organizations/application/use-cases/deactivate-organization.use-case.ts#L32)

```ts
async execute(
    id: number,
    performedBy: number | null,
  ): Promise<OrganizationResponseDto> {
    const organization = await this.repository.findById(id);
    if (!organization) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Organization not found',
      });
    }

    if (organization.status === OrganizationStatus.INACTIVE) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Organization is already inactive',
      });
    }

    const sessionsRevoked = await this.sessions.revokeAllForOrganization(
      organization.id,
      new Date(),
    );
    const previousStatus = organization.status;
    organization.deactivate();

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(organization, {
      organizationId: organization.id,
      operation: OrganizationAuditOperation.DEACTIVATE,
      performedBy,
      changes: {
        status: { before: previousStatus, after: OrganizationStatus.INACTIVE },
      },
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'DEACTIVATE_ORGANIZATION',
      organizationId: saved.id,
      sessionsRevoked,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return OrganizationResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async publish(
    org: number,
    dto: VisualTemplateDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    this.scope.assertCanAccessProject(actor, org);
    for (const text of [
      dto.organization_name,
      dto.institutional,
      dto.header,
      dto.footer,
    ])
      if (
        /[<>]/.test(text) ||
        Array.from(text).some((c) => {
          const n = c.charCodeAt(0);
          return n < 32 && ![9, 10, 13].includes(n);
        })
      )
        throw new BadRequestException('Use texto simples no modelo visual.');
    const logo = dto.logo_png || null;
    if (logo) {
      const match = /^data:image\/png;base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2})$/.exec(
        logo,
      );
      const b = match ? Buffer.from(match[1], 'base64') : Buffer.alloc(0);
      if (
        b.length < 33 ||
        b.length > 128 * 1024 ||
        !b.subarray(0, 8).equals(Buffer.from('89504e470d0a1a0a', 'hex')) ||
        b.toString('ascii', 12, 16) !== 'IHDR' ||
        !b.readUInt32BE(16) ||
        !b.readUInt32BE(20) ||
        b.readUInt32BE(16) > 1024 ||
        b.readUInt32BE(20) > 1024
      )
        throw new BadRequestException(
          'Logotipo deve ser PNG de até 128 KB e 1024 × 1024 pixels.',
        );
    }
    if (logo) {
      try {
        await this.renderer.render(
          {
            title: 'Validação de logotipo',
            subtitle: '',
            version: 'preview',
            date: '',
            status: '',
            sourceHash: '',
            visual: { ...dto, logo_png: logo, version: 'preview' },
            blocks: [],
          },
          'pdf',
        );
      } catch {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          'O logotipo PNG não pôde ser decodificado com segurança.',
        );
      }
    }
    return this.ds.transaction(async (m) => {
      const row = await m.save(
        DocumentVisualVersion,
        m.create(DocumentVisualVersion, {
          organizationId: org,
          actorId: actor.id,
          recordedAt: new Date(),
          hash: documentHash(dto),
          data: { ...dto, logo_png: logo, version: 'pending' },
        }),
      );
      row.id = Number(row.id);
      row.data.version = 'visual-' + row.id;
      await m.update(
        DocumentVisualVersion,
        { id: row.id, organizationId: org },
        { data: row.data, hash: documentHash(row.data) },
      );
      await m.save(
        DocumentAudit,
        m.create(DocumentAudit, {
          organizationId: org,
          actorId: actor.id,
          recordedAt: new Date(),
          operation: 'visual-published',
          details: {
            visual_version: row.data.version,
            hash: documentHash(row.data),
          },
        }),
      );
      return { ...row, hash: documentHash(row.data) };
    });
  }
```

</details>

<details><summary>Implementação chamada: FieldService.saveTemplate</summary>

[gai-backend/src/modules/field-coordination/field.service.ts:208](../../gai-backend/src/modules/field-coordination/field.service.ts#L208)

```ts
async saveTemplate(
    org: number,
    dto: FieldTemplateDto,
    actor: Actor,
    id?: number,
  ) {
    await this.organization(org, actor);
    const definition = validateDefinition(dto.definition);
    const name = dto.name.trim();
    if (!name) invalid('Nome obrigatório');
    return this.db.transaction(async (manager) => {
      let row: FieldTemplate;
      if (id) {
        const existing = await manager.findOneBy(FieldTemplate, {
          id,
          organizationId: org,
        });
        if (!existing) this.missing();
        row = existing;
        if (row.archivedAt) conflict('Modelo arquivado');
        if (!dto.expected_version) invalid('expected_version obrigatório');
        const result = await manager.update(
          FieldTemplate,
          { id, organizationId: org, currentVersion: dto.expected_version },
          {
            name,
            description: dto.description ?? null,
            currentVersion: dto.expected_version + 1,
          },
        );
        if (result.affected !== 1) conflict('Versão do modelo alterada');
        row.currentVersion = dto.expected_version + 1;
        row.name = name;
        row.description = dto.description ?? null;
      } else
        row = await manager.save(
          FieldTemplate,
          manager.create(FieldTemplate, {
            organizationId: org,
            name,
            description: dto.description ?? null,
            currentVersion: 1,
            archivedAt: null,
          }),
        );
      await manager.save(
        FieldTemplateVersion,
        manager.create(FieldTemplateVersion, {
          organizationId: org,
          templateId: row.id,
          version: row.currentVersion,
          name,
          description: row.description,
          definition,
          createdById: actor.id,
        }),
      );
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        actor,
        org,
        id ? 'TEMPLATE_VERSION' : 'TEMPLATE_CREATE',
        { version: row.currentVersion, definition },
        undefined,
        row.id,
      );
      return { ...row, definition };
    });
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async template(org: number, id: number, actor: Actor, version?: number) {
    await this.organization(org, actor);
    const row = await this.db
      .getRepository(FieldTemplate)
      .findOneBy({ id, organizationId: org });
    if (!row) this.missing();
    const snapshot = await this.db
      .getRepository(FieldTemplateVersion)
      .findOneBy({
        templateId: id,
        organizationId: org,
        version: version ?? row.currentVersion,
      });
    if (!snapshot) this.missing();
    return {
      ...row,
      version: snapshot.version,
      name: snapshot.name,
      description: snapshot.description,
      definition: snapshot.definition,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async archiveTemplate(
    org: number,
    id: number,
    dto: FieldArchiveTemplateDto,
    actor: Actor,
  ) {
    await this.organization(org, actor);
    return this.db.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const result = await manager.update(
        FieldTemplate,
        { id, organizationId: org, currentVersion: dto.expected_version },
        {
          archivedAt: dto.archived ? new Date() : null,
          currentVersion: () => 'current_version + 1',
        },
      );
      if (result.affected !== 1) conflict('Modelo ausente ou versão alterada');
      // Archiving is metadata only: keep a version for every current_version value.
      const old = await manager.findOneBy(FieldTemplateVersion, {
        templateId: id,
        organizationId: org,
        version: dto.expected_version,
      });
      if (!old) this.missing();
      await manager.save(
        FieldTemplateVersion,
        manager.create(FieldTemplateVersion, {
          organizationId: org,
          templateId: id,
          version: dto.expected_version + 1,
          name: old.name,
          description: old.description,
          definition: old.definition,
          createdById: actor.id,
        }),
      );
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        actor,
        org,
        'TEMPLATE_ARCHIVE',
        { archived: dto.archived, version: dto.expected_version + 1 },
        undefined,
        id,
      );
      return {
        id,
        archived: dto.archived,
        currentVersion: dto.expected_version + 1,
      };
    });
  }
```

```ts
async template(org: number, id: number, actor: Actor, version?: number) {
    await this.organization(org, actor);
    const row = await this.db
      .getRepository(FieldTemplate)
      .findOneBy({ id, organizationId: org });
    if (!row) this.missing();
    const snapshot = await this.db
      .getRepository(FieldTemplateVersion)
      .findOneBy({
        templateId: id,
        organizationId: org,
        version: version ?? row.currentVersion,
      });
    if (!snapshot) this.missing();
    return {
      ...row,
      version: snapshot.version,
      name: snapshot.name,
      description: snapshot.description,
      definition: snapshot.definition,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async createTemplate(
    organizationId: number,
    dto: CreateTemplateDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    await this.organization(organizationId, actor);
    const questions = validateQuestions(dto.questions);
    const id = await this.repo.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const item = await manager.getRepository(PreparationTemplateEntity).save({
        organizationId,
        name: this.text(dto.name),
        kind: dto.kind,
        currentVersion: 1,
        archivedAt: null,
      });
      await manager.getRepository(PreparationTemplateVersionEntity).save({
        organizationId,
        templateId: item.id,
        version: 1,
        name: item.name,
        questions,
        createdById: actor.id,
      });
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        actor,
        organizationId,
        'TEMPLATE_CREATED',
        { version: 1, name: item.name, questions },
        null,
        null,
        item.id,
      );
      return item.id;
    });
    return this.getTemplate(organizationId, id, actor);
  }
```

```ts
async archiveTemplate(
    organizationId: number,
    id: number,
    revision: number,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    await this.organization(organizationId, actor);
    await this.repo.transaction(async (manager) => {
      if (!(await this.repo.template(organizationId, id, manager)))
        this.missing();
      const changed = await manager
        .getRepository(PreparationTemplateEntity)
        .update(
          {
            id,
            organizationId,
            currentVersion: revision,
            archivedAt: IsNull(),
          },
          { archivedAt: new Date() },
        );
      if (changed.affected !== 1) this.conflict();
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        actor,
        organizationId,
        'TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED',
        { version: revision },
        null,
        null,
        id,
      );
    });
    return this.getTemplate(organizationId, id, actor);
  }
```

```ts
async getTemplate(
    organizationId: number,
    id: number,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    await this.organization(organizationId, actor);
    const item = await this.repo.template(organizationId, id);
    if (!item) this.missing();
    const current = await this.repo.version(
      organizationId,
      id,
      item.currentVersion,
    );
    if (!current) this.missing();
    const versions = await this.repo.manager
      .getRepository(PreparationTemplateVersionEntity)
      .find({
        where: { organizationId, templateId: id },
        order: { version: 'DESC' },
        take: 100,
        select: {
          id: true,
          version: true,
          name: true,
          createdAt: true,
          createdById: true,
        },
      });
    return {
      ...this.templateSummary(item),
      questions: current.questions,
      versions: versions.map((v) => ({
        version: v.version,
        name: v.name,
        created_at: v.createdAt,
        created_by_id: v.createdById,
      })),
    };
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/project-preparation/preparation.service.ts:232](../../gai-backend/src/modules/project-preparation/preparation.service.ts#L232)

```ts
async updateTemplate(
    organizationId: number,
    id: number,
    dto: UpdateTemplateDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    await this.organization(organizationId, actor);
    const questions = validateQuestions(dto.questions);
    await this.repo.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const item = await this.repo.template(organizationId, id, manager);
      if (!item) this.missing();
      if (item.archivedAt)
        this.conflict('Modelo arquivado não pode ser editado');
      const versions = await manager
        .getRepository(PreparationTemplateVersionEntity)
        .find({ where: { organizationId, templateId: id } });
      const types = new Map<string, string>();
      versions.forEach((v) =>
        v.questions.forEach((q) => types.set(q.id, q.type)),
      );
      if (questions.some((q) => types.has(q.id) && types.get(q.id) !== q.type))
        invalid(
          'Mudança de tipo exige novo ID de pergunta; preserve a identidade das versões anteriores',
        );
      const name = this.text(dto.name);
      const changed = await manager
        .getRepository(PreparationTemplateEntity)
        .update(
          {
            id,
            organizationId,
            currentVersion: dto.expected_version,
            archivedAt: IsNull(),
          },
          { name, currentVersion: dto.expected_version + 1 },
        );
      if (changed.affected !== 1) this.conflict();
      await manager.getRepository(PreparationTemplateVersionEntity).save({
        organizationId,
        templateId: id,
        version: dto.expected_version + 1,
        name,
        questions,
        createdById: actor.id,
      });
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        actor,
        organizationId,
        'TEMPLATE_VERSION_CREATED',
        {
          before: { version: item.currentVersion, name: item.name },
          after: { version: dto.expected_version + 1, name, questions },
        },
        null,
        null,
        id,
      );
    });
    return this.getTemplate(organizationId, id, actor);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async cloneTemplate(
    organizationId: number,
    id: number,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    const original = await this.getTemplate(organizationId, id, actor);
    const clone = await this.createTemplate(
      organizationId,
      {
        name: `${original.name.slice(0, 185)} (cópia)`,
        kind: original.kind,
        questions: original.questions,
      },
      actor,
    );
    await this.audit(
      this.repo.manager,
      actor,
      organizationId,
      'TEMPLATE_CLONED',
      { source_template_id: id },
      null,
      null,
      clone.id,
    );
    return clone;
  }
```

```ts
async execute(
```

```ts
async execute(
    organizationId: number,
    dto: CreateOrgRoleDto,
    actor: ActorContext,
  ): Promise<OrgRoleResponseDto> {
    await this.assertOrganizationExists(organizationId);
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, organizationId);

    const existing = await this.repository.findByNameInOrganization(
      organizationId,
      dto.name.trim(),
    );
    if (existing) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Org role name already exists in this organization',
      });
    }

    const permissionRecords = await this.permissions.findByIds(
      dto.permission_ids,
    );
    this.assertValidPermissions(permissionRecords, dto.permission_ids);

    const now = new Date();
    const role = new OrgRole({
      id: 0,
      organizationId,
      name: dto.name.trim(),
      description: dto.description?.trim() ?? null,
      isActive: true,
      permissions: permissionRecords.map((permission) => ({
        id: permission.id,
        key: permission.key,
        resource: permission.resource,
        action: permission.action,
        scope: permission.scope,
        description: permission.description,
      })),
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    });

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(
      role,
      dto.permission_ids,
      {
        orgRoleId: 0,
        operation: OrgRoleAuditOperation.CREATE,
        performedBy: actor.id,
        changes: {
          name: { before: null, after: role.name },
          permission_ids: { before: null, after: dto.permission_ids },
        },
      },
    );

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'CREATE_ORG_ROLE',
      orgRoleId: saved.id,
      organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return OrgRoleResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

```ts
async execute(
    organizationId: number,
    roleId: number,
    actor: ActorContext,
  ): Promise<void> {
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, organizationId);

    const role = await this.repository.findByIdAndOrganization(
      roleId,
      organizationId,
    );
    if (!role) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Org role not found',
      });
    }

    if (!role.isActive) {
      return;
    }

    const activeUsers = await this.repository.countActiveUsersWithRole(roleId);
    if (activeUsers > 0) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Org role is assigned to active users',
      });
    }

    const previousActive = role.isActive;
    role.deactivate();

    await this.repository.saveWithAudit(
      role,
      role.permissions.map((permission) => permission.id),
      {
        orgRoleId: role.id,
        operation: OrgRoleAuditOperation.DEACTIVATE,
        performedBy: actor.id,
        changes: {
          is_active: { before: previousActive, after: false },
        },
      },
    );

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'DEACTIVATE_ORG_ROLE',
      orgRoleId: role.id,
      organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/users/application/use-cases/update-org-role.use-case.ts:35](../../gai-backend/src/modules/users/application/use-cases/update-org-role.use-case.ts#L35)

```ts
async execute(
    organizationId: number,
    roleId: number,
    dto: UpdateOrgRoleDto,
    actor: ActorContext,
  ): Promise<OrgRoleResponseDto> {
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, organizationId);

    const role = await this.repository.findByIdAndOrganization(
      roleId,
      organizationId,
    );
    if (!role) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Org role not found',
      });
    }

    const changes: Record<string, { before: unknown; after: unknown }> = {};
    let permissionIds = role.permissions.map((permission) => permission.id);

    if (dto.name !== undefined && dto.name.trim() !== role.name) {
      const existing = await this.repository.findByNameInOrganization(
        organizationId,
        dto.name.trim(),
      );
      if (existing && existing.id !== role.id) {
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'CONFLICT',
          message: 'Org role name already exists in this organization',
        });
      }
      changes.name = { before: role.name, after: dto.name.trim() };
    }

    if (dto.description !== undefined) {
      changes.description = {
        before: role.description,
        after: dto.description,
      };
    }

    if (dto.is_active !== undefined) {
      changes.is_active = { before: role.isActive, after: dto.is_active };
    }

    if (dto.permission_ids !== undefined) {
      const permissionRecords = await this.permissions.findByIds(
        dto.permission_ids,
      );
      this.assertValidPermissions(permissionRecords, dto.permission_ids);
      permissionIds = dto.permission_ids;
      changes.permission_ids = {
        before: role.permissions.map((permission) => permission.id),
        after: dto.permission_ids,
      };
      role.update({
        permissions: permissionRecords.map((permission) => ({
          id: permission.id,
          key: permission.key,
          resource: permission.resource,
          action: permission.action,
          scope: permission.scope,
          description: permission.description,
        })),
      });
    }

    role.update({
      ...(dto.name !== undefined ? { name: dto.name.trim() } : {}),
      ...(dto.description !== undefined
        ? { description: dto.description.trim() || null }
        : {}),
      ...(dto.is_active !== undefined ? { isActive: dto.is_active } : {}),
    });

    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 0) {
      return OrgRoleResponseDto.fromDomain(role);
    }

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(role, permissionIds, {
      orgRoleId: role.id,
      operation: OrgRoleAuditOperation.UPDATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'UPDATE_ORG_ROLE',
      orgRoleId: saved.id,
      organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return OrgRoleResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async execute(
    query: ListProjectsQueryDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ): Promise<ProjectListResponseDto> {
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const organizationId = this.scope.resolveOrganizationFilter(
      actor,
      query.organization_id,
    );

    const { items, total, counts } = await this.repository.list({
      page,
      pageSize,
      organizationId,
      allowedProjectIds: actor.allowedProjectIds,
      companyId: query.company_id,
      status: query.status,
      search: query.search,
      projectType: query.project_type,
      sortBy: query.sort_by,
      sortOrder: query.sort_order,
    });

    return {
      status_counts: counts ?? {},
      items: items.map((project) => ProjectResponseDto.fromDomain(project)),
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
      total_items: total,
      total_pages: total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    };
  }
```
