[gai-backend/src/modules/field-coordination/field.service.ts:916](../../gai-backend/src/modules/field-coordination/field.service.ts#L916)

```ts
async blockers(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    actor: Actor,
    manager = this.db.manager,
  ) {
    const row = await this.instance(projectId, id, actor, manager);
    // SQL first: fetch only applicable mandatory rows, never a full task list for KPIs.
    const tasks = await this.taskQuery(row, manager)
      .andWhere('task.required=:required AND task.applicable=:applies', {
        required: true,
        applies: true,
      })
      .getMany();
    const blockers: Array<{
      task_id: number;
      stable_id: string;
      group_id: string;
      code: string;
      message: string;
    }> = [];
    for (const task of tasks) {
      const add = (code: string, message: string) =>
        blockers.push({
          task_id: task.id,
          stable_id: task.stableId,
          group_id: task.groupId,
          code,
          message,
        });
      if (!['completed', 'not_applicable'].includes(task.state)) {
        add(
          task.state === 'blocked' ? 'TASK_BLOCKED' : 'TASK_PENDING',
          'Tarefa obrigatória não resolvida',
        );
        continue;
      }
      try {
        await this.validateReferences(manager, row, task, actor);
      } catch (error) {
        if (!(error instanceof HttpException)) throw error;
        const body = error.getResponse();
        const message =
          typeof body === 'object' &&
          'message' in body &&
          typeof body.message === 'string'
            ? body.message
            : 'Requisitos da tarefa não atendidos';
        add('TASK_REQUIREMENTS', message);
      }
      if (
        task.state === 'completed' &&
        task.definition.requires_approval &&
        !task.approvedById
      )
        add('APPROVAL_REQUIRED', 'Aprovação da tarefa obrigatória ausente');
    }
    return {
      can_complete: blockers.length === 0 && row.status === 'open',
      revision: row.revision,
      blockers,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async tasks(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    query: FieldPageQuery,
    actor: Actor,
  ) {
    const row = await this.instance(projectId, id, actor);
    const builder = this.taskQuery(row);
    for (const [key, column] of [
      ['group_id', 'group_id'],
      ['state', 'state'],
      ['priority', 'priority'],
      ['responsible_user_id', 'responsible_user_id'],
      ['field_agent_id', 'field_agent_id'],
    ] as const)
      if (query[key])
        builder.andWhere(`task.${column}=:${key}`, { [key]: query[key] });
    if (query.due_before)
      builder.andWhere('task.due_date<=:before', {
        before: civilDate(query.due_before),
      });
    if (query.overdue === 'true')
      builder.andWhere(
        'task.applicable=:applies AND task.state NOT IN (:...done) AND task.due_date<:today',
        {
          applies: true,
          done: ['completed', 'not_applicable'],
          today: fieldToday(),
        },
      );
    if (query.search)
      builder.andWhere('task.title LIKE :search', {
        search: `%${query.search}%`,
      });
    const [items, total] = await builder
      .orderBy('task.position', 'ASC')
      .addOrderBy('task.id', 'ASC')
      .skip((query.page - 1) * query.page_size)
      .take(query.page_size)
      .getManyAndCount();
    const mayReadIssues = await this.allowed(
      actor,
      'inventory-pending-issues:read',
    );
    const projected = [];
    const userIds = items.flatMap((task) =>
      task.responsibleUserId ? [task.responsibleUserId] : [],
    );
    const agentIds = items.flatMap((task) =>
      task.fieldAgentId ? [task.fieldAgentId] : [],
    );
    const users = userIds.length
      ? await this.db
          .getRepository(UserEntity)
          .findBy({ id: In(userIds), organizationId: row.organizationId })
      : [];
    const agents = agentIds.length
      ? await this.db
          .getRepository(FieldAgentEntity)
          .findBy({ id: In(agentIds), organizationId: row.organizationId })
      : [];
    for (const task of items) {
      const issue =
        mayReadIssues && task.linkedIssueId
          ? await this.db.getRepository(InventoryPendingIssueEntity).findOneBy({
              id: task.linkedIssueId,
              projectId,
              organizationId: row.organizationId,
            })
          : null;
      projected.push({
        ...task,
        linkedIssueId: mayReadIssues ? task.linkedIssueId : null,
        hasLinkedIssue: !!task.linkedIssueId,
        responsible: task.responsibleUserId
          ? {
              kind: 'user',
              id: task.responsibleUserId,
              name:
                users.find((user) => user.id === task.responsibleUserId)
                  ?.login ?? 'Usuário indisponível',
            }
          : task.fieldAgentId
            ? {
                kind: 'field_agent',
                id: task.fieldAgentId,
                name:
                  agents.find((agent) => agent.id === task.fieldAgentId)
                    ?.name ?? 'Inventariante indisponível',
              }
            : null,
        issue: issue
          ? { id: issue.id, title: issue.title, status: issue.status }
          : null,
      });
    }
    return {
      items: projected,
      total,
      page: query.page,
      page_size: query.page_size,
      revision: row.revision,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async addTask(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    dto: FieldAddTaskDto,
    actor: Actor,
  ) {
    return this.db.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const row = await this.instance(projectId, id, actor, manager, true);
      await this.bump(manager, row, dto.revision);
      const definitions = (
        await manager.findBy(FieldTask, { checklistId: id })
      ).map((task) => task.definition);
      validateDefinition({
        groups: row.snapshot.groups,
        tasks: [...definitions, dto.definition],
      });
      const task = await this.insertTask(manager, row, dto.definition);
      await this.recompute(manager, row);
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        actor,
        row.organizationId,
        'TASK_CREATE',
        { task },
        row,
      );
      return { task, revision: row.revision };
    });
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/field-coordination/field.service.ts:703](../../gai-backend/src/modules/field-coordination/field.service.ts#L703)

```ts
async updateTask(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    taskId: number,
    dto: FieldTaskDto & { command_key?: string },
    actor: Actor,
    approve = false,
  ) {
    const execute = async (manager: EntityManager) => {
      const row = await this.instance(projectId, id, actor, manager, true);
      await this.bump(manager, row, dto.revision);
      const task = await manager.findOneBy(FieldTask, {
        id: taskId,
        checklistId: id,
        projectId,
        organizationId: row.organizationId,
      });
      if (!task) this.missing();
      const before = structuredClone(task);
      if (approve) {
        if (task.state !== 'completed' || !task.applicable)
          invalid('Aprovação exige tarefa aplicável concluída');
        await this.validateReferences(manager, row, task, actor);
        task.approvedById = actor.id;
        task.approvedAt = new Date();
      } else {
        const next = dto.state ?? task.state;
        const transition = validateTransition(
          task.state,
          next,
          next === task.state ? task.reason : dto.reason,
        );
        if (transition.reopens)
          await this.require(actor, 'field-coordination:coordinate');
        if (
          ['completed', 'not_applicable'].includes(task.state) &&
          !transition.reopens &&
          Object.keys(dto).some((key) => !['revision', 'state'].includes(key))
        )
          conflict('Reabra a tarefa antes de editar seus dados');
        if (dto.title !== undefined) {
          if (!dto.title.trim()) invalid('Título obrigatório');
          task.title = dto.title.trim();
        }
        for (const [key, field] of [
          ['notes', 'notes'],
          ['reason', 'reason'],
          ['priority', 'priority'],
          ['responsible_user_id', 'responsibleUserId'],
          ['field_agent_id', 'fieldAgentId'],
          ['linked_issue_id', 'linkedIssueId'],
          ['start_date', 'startDate'],
          ['due_date', 'dueDate'],
        ] as const) {
          if (dto[key] !== undefined)
            (task as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[field] = dto[key];
        }
        task.startDate = civilDate(task.startDate);
        task.dueDate = civilDate(task.dueDate);
        task.state = next;
        await this.validateReferences(
          manager,
          row,
          task,
          actor,
          dto.linked_issue_id !== undefined &&
            dto.linked_issue_id !== before.linkedIssueId,
        );
        task.completedAt =
          next === 'completed' ? (before.completedAt ?? new Date()) : null;
        task.approvedById = null;
        task.approvedAt = null;
      }
      await manager.save(FieldTask, task);
      await this.recompute(manager, row);
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        actor,
        row.organizationId,
        approve ? 'TASK_APPROVE' : 'TASK_UPDATE',
        { before, after: task, revision: row.revision },
        row,
      );
      return { task, revision: row.revision };
    };
    let result: { task: FieldTask; revision: number };
    if (approve) {
      if (!dto.command_key) invalid('command_key obrigatório para aprovação');
      result = await this.command(
        projectId,
        dto.command_key,
        { operation: 'task-approve', id, taskId, ...dto },
        actor,
        execute,
      );
    } else result = await this.db.transaction(execute);
    if (!(await this.allowed(actor, 'inventory-pending-issues:read')))
      result.task.linkedIssueId = null;
    return result;
  }
```

</details>

```ts
    id: number,
    taskId: number,
    dto: FieldTaskDto & { command_key?: string },
    actor: Actor,
    approve = false,
  ) {
    const execute = async (manager: EntityManager) => {
      const row = await this.instance(projectId, id, actor, manager, true);
      await this.bump(manager, row, dto.revision);
      const task = await manager.findOneBy(FieldTask, {
        id: taskId,
        checklistId: id,
        projectId,
        organizationId: row.organizationId,
      });
      if (!task) this.missing();
      const before = structuredClone(task);
      if (approve) {
        if (task.state !== 'completed' || !task.applicable)
          invalid('Aprovação exige tarefa aplicável concluída');
        await this.validateReferences(manager, row, task, actor);
        task.approvedById = actor.id;
        task.approvedAt = new Date();
      } else {
        const next = dto.state ?? task.state;
        const transition = validateTransition(
          task.state,
          next,
          next === task.state ? task.reason : dto.reason,
        );
        if (transition.reopens)
          await this.require(actor, 'field-coordination:coordinate');
        if (
          ['completed', 'not_applicable'].includes(task.state) &&
          !transition.reopens &&
          Object.keys(dto).some((key) => !['revision', 'state'].includes(key))
        )
          conflict('Reabra a tarefa antes de editar seus dados');
        if (dto.title !== undefined) {
          if (!dto.title.trim()) invalid('Título obrigatório');
          task.title = dto.title.trim();
        }
        for (const [key, field] of [
          ['notes', 'notes'],
          ['reason', 'reason'],
          ['priority', 'priority'],
          ['responsible_user_id', 'responsibleUserId'],
          ['field_agent_id', 'fieldAgentId'],
          ['linked_issue_id', 'linkedIssueId'],
          ['start_date', 'startDate'],
          ['due_date', 'dueDate'],
        ] as const) {
          if (dto[key] !== undefined)
            (task as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[field] = dto[key];
        }
        task.startDate = civilDate(task.startDate);
        task.dueDate = civilDate(task.dueDate);
        task.state = next;
        await this.validateReferences(
          manager,
          row,
          task,
          actor,
          dto.linked_issue_id !== undefined &&
            dto.linked_issue_id !== before.linkedIssueId,
        );
        task.completedAt =
          next === 'completed' ? (before.completedAt ?? new Date()) : null;
        task.approvedById = null;
        task.approvedAt = null;
      }
      await manager.save(FieldTask, task);
      await this.recompute(manager, row);
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        actor,
        row.organizationId,
        approve ? 'TASK_APPROVE' : 'TASK_UPDATE',
        { before, after: task, revision: row.revision },
        row,
      );
      return { task, revision: row.revision };
    };
    let result: { task: FieldTask; revision: number };
    if (approve) {
      if (!dto.command_key) invalid('command_key obrigatório para aprovação');
      result = await this.command(
        projectId,
        dto.command_key,
        { operation: 'task-approve', id, taskId, ...dto },
        actor,
        execute,
      );
    } else result = await this.db.transaction(execute);
    if (!(await this.allowed(actor, 'inventory-pending-issues:read')))
      result.task.linkedIssueId = null;
    return result;
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/field-coordination/field.service.ts:979](../../gai-backend/src/modules/field-coordination/field.service.ts#L979)

```ts
async transition(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    dto: FieldTransitionDto,
    actor: Actor,
  ) {
    return this.command(
      projectId,
      dto.command_key,
      { operation: 'transition', id, ...dto },
      actor,
      async (manager) => {
        const row = await this.instance(projectId, id, actor, manager, true);
        if (row.status === 'archived') conflict('Checklist arquivado');
        if (dto.action === 'complete') {
          if (row.status !== 'open') conflict('Checklist não está aberto');
          await this.bump(manager, row, dto.revision);
          const result = await this.blockers(projectId, id, actor, manager);
          if (result.blockers.length)
            conflict('Conclusão de campo impedida', result.blockers);
          row.status = 'completed';
          row.completedAt = new Date();
          row.completedById = actor.id;
        } else {
          if (!dto.reason?.trim()) invalid('Motivo obrigatório');
          if (dto.action === 'reopen' && row.status !== 'completed')
            conflict('Somente checklist concluído pode ser reaberto');
          await this.bump(manager, row, dto.revision, false);
          row.status = dto.action === 'archive' ? 'archived' : 'open';
          row.completedAt = null;
          row.completedById = null;
        }
        await manager.update(
          FieldChecklist,
          { id: row.id },
          {
            status: row.status,
            completedAt: row.completedAt,
            completedById: row.completedById,
          },
        );
        await this.audit(
          manager,
          actor,
          row.organizationId,
          'CHECKLIST_' + dto.action.toUpperCase(),
          { reason: dto.reason ?? null, revision: row.revision },
          row,
        );
        return row;
      },
    );
  }
```

```ts
async context(projectId: number, actor: Actor, query: FieldPageQuery) {
    const project = await this.project(projectId, actor);
    const org = project.organizationId;
    if (query.kind === 'field_agent') {
      assertOperationalActor(actor);
      const builder = this.db
        .getRepository(FieldAgentEntity)
        .createQueryBuilder('agent')
        .innerJoin(
          ProjectFieldAgentEntity,
          'link',
          'link.field_agent_id=agent.id AND link.organization_id=:org AND link.project_id=:projectId AND link.status=:active AND (link.start_date IS NULL OR link.start_date<=:today) AND (link.end_date IS NULL OR link.end_date>=:today)',
          {
            org,
            projectId,
            active: ProjectFieldAgentStatus.ACTIVE,
            today: fieldToday(),
          },
        )
        .where('agent.organization_id=:org AND agent.status=:status', {
          org,
          status: FieldAgentStatus.ACTIVE,
        });
      if (query.search)
        builder.andWhere('agent.name LIKE :search', {
          search: `%${query.search}%`,
        });
      const [items, total] = await builder
        .orderBy('agent.name', 'ASC')
        .skip((query.page - 1) * query.page_size)
        .take(query.page_size)
        .getManyAndCount();
      return {
        project: {
          id: project.id,
          name: project.name,
          organizationId: org,
          status: project.status,
        },
        items: items.map((row) => ({
          id: row.id,
          name: row.name,
          kind: 'field_agent',
          linkedUserId: row.userId,
        })),
        total,
        page: query.page,
        page_size: query.page_size,
      };
    }
    const builder = this.db
      .getRepository(UserEntity)
      .createQueryBuilder('user')
      .where('user.organization_id=:org AND user.status=:status', {
        org,
        status: UserStatus.ACTIVE,
      });
    if (query.search)
      builder.andWhere('user.login LIKE :search', {
        search: `%${query.search}%`,
      });
    const [items, total] = await builder
      .orderBy('user.login', 'ASC')
      .skip((query.page - 1) * query.page_size)
      .take(query.page_size)
      .getManyAndCount();
    return {
      project: {
        id: project.id,
        name: project.name,
        organizationId: org,
        status: project.status,
      },
      items: items.map((row) => ({
        id: row.id,
        name: row.login,
        kind: 'user',
      })),
      total,
      page: query.page,
      page_size: query.page_size,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async listSessions(
    projectId: number,
    query: ImportSessionListQueryDto,
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
  ): Promise<ImportSessionListResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, false);
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const { items, total } = await this.repo.listSessions({
      page,
      pageSize,
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      status: query.status,
    });
    return this.paginate(
      items.map((item) => ImportSessionResponseDto.fromEntity(item)),
      page,
      pageSize,
      total,
    );
  }
```

```ts
async createSession(
    projectId: number,
    dto: CreateImportSessionDto,
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
  ): Promise<ImportSessionResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    const now = new Date();
    const session = this.sessionRepo.create({
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      type: dto.type,
      source: dto.source,
      status: ImportSessionStatus.OPEN,
      sessionUuid: randomUUID(),
      expectedPayloads: dto.expected_payloads ?? null,
      receivedPayloads: 0,
      processedPayloads: 0,
      failedPayloads: 0,
      totalItems: 0,
      totalImages: 0,
      totalCreated: 0,
      totalUpdated: 0,
      totalDeleted: 0,
      totalFailed: 0,
      rawBackupPath: null,
      createdById: actor.id,
      startedAt: now,
      finishedAt: null,
      expiresAt: new Date(
        now.getTime() + this.scope.sessionTtlHours() * 3600000,
      ),
      errorMessage: null,
      metadata: dto.metadata ?? null,
    });
    const saved = await this.repo.saveSession(session, {
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      operation: ImportOperation.CREATE_SESSION,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: { status: { before: null, after: ImportSessionStatus.OPEN } },
    });
    this.logger.info(
      { sessionId: saved.id, projectId },
      'import session created',
    );
    return ImportSessionResponseDto.fromEntity(saved);
  }
```

```ts
async cancelSession(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
  ): Promise<ImportSessionResponseDto> {
    const session = await this.findSession(projectId, sessionId, actor, true);
    session.status = ImportSessionStatus.CANCELLED;
    session.finishedAt = new Date();
    const saved = await this.repo.saveSession(session, {
      organizationId: session.organizationId,
      projectId,
      importSessionId: session.id,
      operation: ImportOperation.CANCEL_SESSION,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: { status: ImportSessionStatus.CANCELLED },
    });
    return ImportSessionResponseDto.fromEntity(saved);
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/import-sessions/application/services/import-sessions.service.ts:464](../../gai-backend/src/modules/import-sessions/application/services/import-sessions.service.ts#L464)

```ts
async confirmFileUpload(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    fileId: number,
    dto: ConfirmImportFileUploadDto,
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
  ): Promise<ImportFileResponseDto> {
    const session = await this.findSession(projectId, sessionId, actor, true);
    const file = await this.findFile(
      session.id,
      fileId,
      session.organizationId,
    );
    if (file.status === ImportFileStatus.UPLOADED)
      return ImportFileResponseDto.fromEntity(file);
    if (file.status !== ImportFileStatus.PENDING_UPLOAD)
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Only pending files can be confirmed',
      });
    const verified = await this.storageSigner.verifyUpload({
      bucket: file.bucket,
      path: file.path,
      mimeType: file.mimeType,
      sizeBytes: Number(file.sizeBytes),
      checksum: file.checksum,
      createdAt: file.createdAt,
      expiresInSeconds: this.scope.presignedUrlTtlSeconds(),
      assertion: { sizeBytes: dto.size_bytes, checksum: dto.checksum },
    });
    file.checksum = verified.checksum;
    file.sizeBytes = verified.sizeBytes;
    file.status = ImportFileStatus.UPLOADED;
    if (file.type === ImportFileType.RAW_BACKUP) {
      session.rawBackupPath = file.path;
    }
    const saved = await this.repo.saveFileWithAudit(file, {
      organizationId: session.organizationId,
      projectId,
      importSessionId: session.id,
      importFileId: file.id,
      operation: ImportOperation.CONFIRM_FILE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: { status: ImportFileStatus.UPLOADED },
    });
    if (file.type === ImportFileType.RAW_BACKUP) {
      await this.repo.saveSession(session, {
        organizationId: session.organizationId,
        projectId,
        importSessionId: session.id,
        operation: ImportOperation.CONFIRM_FILE,
        performedBy: actor.id,
        changes: { raw_backup_path: file.path },
      });
    }
    return ImportFileResponseDto.fromEntity(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async createFileDownloadUrl(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    fileId: number,
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
  ): Promise<ImportFileDownloadUrlResponseDto> {
    const session = await this.findSession(projectId, sessionId, actor, false);
    const file = await this.findFile(
      session.id,
      fileId,
      session.organizationId,
    );
    if (file.status !== ImportFileStatus.UPLOADED)
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'IMPORT_FILE_NOT_UPLOADED',
        message: 'Only uploaded files can be downloaded',
      });
    const signed = await this.storageSigner.createDownloadUrl({
      bucket: file.bucket,
      path: file.path,
      mimeType: file.mimeType,
      expiresInSeconds: this.scope.presignedUrlTtlSeconds(),
      sizeBytes: Number(file.sizeBytes),
      checksum: file.checksum,
    });
    await this.repo.audit({
      organizationId: session.organizationId,
      projectId,
      importSessionId: session.id,
      importFileId: file.id,
      operation: ImportOperation.DOWNLOAD_FILE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: { download_url: 'created' },
    });
    return {
      file: ImportFileResponseDto.fromEntity(file),
      download_url: signed.url,
      expires_in_seconds: signed.expiresInSeconds,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async createFileUploadUrl(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    dto: CreateImportFileUploadDto,
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
  ): Promise<ImportFileUploadUrlResponseDto> {
    const session = await this.findSession(projectId, sessionId, actor, true);
    const file = new ImportFileEntity();
    file.organizationId = session.organizationId;
    file.importSessionId = session.id;
    file.importPayloadId = null;
    file.type = dto.type;
    file.storageProvider = this.scope.storageProvider();
    file.bucket = this.scope.storageBucket();
    file.path = this.scope.buildImportFilePath({
      organizationId: session.organizationId,
      sessionId: session.id,
      storageKey: randomUUID(),
      originalName: dto.original_name,
    });
    file.originalName = dto.original_name;
    file.mimeType = dto.mime_type;
    file.sizeBytes = dto.size_bytes;
    file.checksum = null;
    file.status = ImportFileStatus.PENDING_UPLOAD;
    file.uploadedById = actor.id;
    const signed = await this.storageSigner.createUploadUrl({
      bucket: file.bucket,
      path: file.path,
      mimeType: file.mimeType,
      expiresInSeconds: this.scope.presignedUrlTtlSeconds(),
      sizeBytes: Number(file.sizeBytes),
      checksum: file.checksum,
    });

    const saved = await this.repo.saveFileWithAudit(file, {
      organizationId: session.organizationId,
      projectId,
      importSessionId: session.id,
      operation: ImportOperation.CREATE_FILE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: { status: ImportFileStatus.PENDING_UPLOAD },
    });
    return {
      file: ImportFileResponseDto.fromEntity(saved),
      upload_url: signed.url,
      expires_in_seconds: signed.expiresInSeconds,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async finishSession(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
  ): Promise<ImportSessionResponseDto> {
    const session = await this.findSession(projectId, sessionId, actor, true);
    if (
      session.expectedPayloads &&
      session.receivedPayloads < session.expectedPayloads
    ) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Expected payloads were not fully received',
      });
    }
    session.status =
      session.failedPayloads > 0
        ? ImportSessionStatus.FAILED
        : ImportSessionStatus.FINISHED;
    session.finishedAt = new Date();
    const saved = await this.repo.saveSession(session, {
      organizationId: session.organizationId,
      projectId,
      importSessionId: session.id,
      operation: ImportOperation.FINISH_SESSION,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: { status: session.status },
    });
    return ImportSessionResponseDto.fromEntity(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async receivePayload(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    dto: CreateImportPayloadDto,
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
  ): Promise<ImportPayloadResponseDto> {
    const session = await this.findSession(projectId, sessionId, actor, true);
    this.assertSessionAcceptsPayload(session);
    this.assertPayloadLimits(dto);
    const duplicate = await this.findDuplicate(session, dto);
    if (duplicate) return ImportPayloadResponseDto.fromEntity(duplicate);

    const payload = new ImportPayloadEntity();
    payload.organizationId = session.organizationId;
    payload.importSessionId = session.id;
    payload.payloadNumber = dto.payload_number;
    payload.idempotencyKey = dto.idempotency_key;
    payload.checksum = dto.checksum ?? null;
    payload.status = ImportPayloadStatus.RECEIVED;
    payload.itemsCount = dto.items.length;
    payload.imagesCount = this.countImages(dto.items);
    payload.createdCount = 0;
    payload.updatedCount = 0;
    payload.deletedCount = 0;
    payload.failedCount = 0;
    payload.rawPayloadPath =
      dto.raw_payload_path ??
      `organizations/${session.organizationId}/imports/${session.id}/payload-${dto.payload_number}.json`;
    payload.receivedAt = new Date();
    payload.processedAt = null;
    payload.errorMessage = null;
    payload.metadata = dto.metadata ?? null;
    payload.payload = { items: dto.items };

    const saved = await this.repo.savePayloadWithAudit(payload, {
      organizationId: session.organizationId,
      projectId,
      importSessionId: session.id,
      operation: ImportOperation.RECEIVE_PAYLOAD,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: { payload_number: dto.payload_number },
    });
    await this.processPayload(projectId, session.id, saved.id, actor);
    return ImportPayloadResponseDto.fromEntity(
```

```ts
async listErrors(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    query: ImportPagedQueryDto,
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
    payloadId?: number,
  ): Promise<ImportPayloadErrorListResponseDto> {
    const session = await this.findSession(projectId, sessionId, actor, false);
    if (payloadId) await this.findPayload(sessionId, payloadId);
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const { items, total } = await this.repo.listErrors({
      page,
      pageSize,
      organizationId: session.organizationId,
      importSessionId: session.id,
      importPayloadId: payloadId,
    });
    return this.paginate(
      items.map((item) => ImportPayloadErrorResponseDto.fromEntity(item)),
      page,
      pageSize,
      total,
    );
  }
```

```ts
async reprocessPayload(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    payloadId: number,
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
  ): Promise<ImportPayloadResponseDto> {
    await this.findSession(projectId, sessionId, actor, true);
    const payload = await this.findPayload(sessionId, payloadId);
    if (payload.status !== ImportPayloadStatus.FAILED) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Only failed payloads can be reprocessed',
      });
    }
    await this.processPayload(projectId, sessionId, payloadId, actor);
    return ImportPayloadResponseDto.fromEntity(
      (await this.repo.findPayloadById(payloadId))!,
    );
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/import-sessions/application/services/import-sessions.service.ts:660](../../gai-backend/src/modules/import-sessions/application/services/import-sessions.service.ts#L660)

```ts
async importPhysicalFile(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    dto: ImportPhysicalObservationsFileDto,
    file: { originalname: string; buffer: Buffer },
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
  ): Promise<ImportPayloadResponseDto> {
    const session = await this.findSession(projectId, sessionId, actor, true);
    if (session.type !== ImportSessionType.PHYSICAL_OBSERVATIONS_IMPORT)
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'IMPORT_SESSION_TYPE_MISMATCH',
        message: 'Session is not a physical observations import',
      });
    if (!file?.buffer || !file.originalname.toLowerCase().endsWith('.xlsx'))
      throw new BadRequestException({
        code: 'INVALID_IMPORT_FILE',
        message: 'XLSX file is required',
      });
    const checksum = createHash('sha256').update(file.buffer).digest('hex');
    return this.receivePayload(
      projectId,
      sessionId,
      {
        payload_number: dto.payload_number,
        idempotency_key: dto.idempotency_key,
        checksum,
        raw_payload_path: `inline-xlsx://${file.originalname}`,
        items: this.physicalParser.parse(file.buffer),
        metadata: {
          original_name: file.originalname,
          parser: 'physical_observation_aliases_v1',
        },
      },
      actor,
    );
  }
```

</details>

[gai-backend/src/modules/import-sessions/application/services/import-sessions.service.ts:338](../../gai-backend/src/modules/import-sessions/application/services/import-sessions.service.ts#L338)

```ts
async retrySession(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
  ): Promise<ImportSessionResponseDto> {
    const session = await this.findSession(projectId, sessionId, actor, true);
    const { items } = await this.repo.listPayloads({
      page: 1,
      pageSize: 100,
      organizationId: session.organizationId,
      importSessionId: session.id,
    });
    for (const payload of items.filter(
      (item) => item.status === ImportPayloadStatus.FAILED,
    )) {
      await this.processPayload(projectId, session.id, payload.id, actor);
    }
    await this.repo.audit({
      organizationId: session.organizationId,
      projectId,
      importSessionId: session.id,
      operation: ImportOperation.RETRY_SESSION,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: { retried: true },
    });
    return ImportSessionResponseDto.fromEntity(
      (await this.repo.findSessionById(session.id))!,
    );
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async getSessionByUuid(
    projectId: number,
    sessionUuid: string,
    actor: ImportSessionActorContext,
  ): Promise<ImportSessionResponseDto> {
    const session = await this.repo.findSessionByUuid(sessionUuid);
    if (!session || Number(session.projectId) !== projectId) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Import session not found',
      });
    }
    await this.assertSessionScope(projectId, session, actor, false);
    return ImportSessionResponseDto.fromEntity(session);
  }
```

```ts
async listItems(
    projectId: number,
    query: ListInventoryAccountingItemsQueryDto,
    actor: InventoryAccountingItemActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryAccountingItemListResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.getAuthorizedProject(projectId, actor, false);
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const { items, total } = await this.repository.list({
      page,
      pageSize,
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      plate: this.scope.normalizePlate(query.plate) ?? undefined,
      status: query.status,
      baseCode: this.scope.cleanText(query.base_code) ?? undefined,
      investorCode: this.scope.cleanText(query.investor_code) ?? undefined,
      description: query.description,
      search: query.search,
    });
    return {
      items: items.map((item) =>
        InventoryAccountingItemResponseDto.fromDomain(item),
      ),
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
      total_items: total,
      total_pages: total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    };
  }
```

```ts
async updateItem(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    dto: UpdateInventoryAccountingItemDto,
    actor: InventoryAccountingItemActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryAccountingItemResponseDto> {
    const item = await this.repository.findById(id);
    if (!item || item.projectId !== projectId) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Inventory accounting item not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, item.organizationId);
    await this.getAuthorizedProject(projectId, actor, true);

    const changes = item.updateFields({
      plate: this.scope.normalizePlate(dto.plate),
      description: this.scope.cleanText(dto.description),
      accountingAccountDescription: this.scope.cleanText(
        dto.accounting_account_description,
      ),
      location: this.scope.cleanText(dto.location),
      serialNumber: this.scope.cleanText(dto.serial_number),
      acquisitionDate: this.scope.parseDate(dto.acquisition_date),
      acquisitionValue: this.scope.normalizeMoney(dto.acquisition_value),
      baseCode: this.scope.cleanText(dto.base_code),
      status: dto.status,
      investorCode: this.scope.cleanText(dto.investor_code),
      note1: this.scope.cleanText(dto.note_1),
      note2: this.scope.cleanText(dto.note_2),
      newInventoryPlate: this.scope.normalizePlate(dto.new_inventory_plate),
      inventoryDescription: this.scope.cleanText(dto.inventory_description),
      inventoryLocation: this.scope.cleanText(dto.inventory_location),
      metadata: dto.metadata,
    });
    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 0) {
      return InventoryAccountingItemResponseDto.fromDomain(item);
    }
    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(item, {
      inventoryAccountingItemId: item.id,
      organizationId: item.organizationId,
      projectId: item.projectId,
      operation: InventoryAccountingItemAuditOperation.UPDATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });
    return InventoryAccountingItemResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async changeStatus(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    action: 'deactivate' | 'reactivate',
    actor: InventoryAccountingItemActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryAccountingItemResponseDto> {
    const item = await this.repository.findById(id);
    if (!item || item.projectId !== projectId) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Inventory accounting item not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, item.organizationId);
    await this.getAuthorizedProject(projectId, actor, true);
    let changes: Record<string, { before: unknown; after: unknown }>;
    try {
      changes =
        action === 'deactivate'
          ? item.deactivate(new Date())
          : item.reactivate();
    } catch (error) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : 'Status blocks this operation',
      });
    }
    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(item, {
      inventoryAccountingItemId: item.id,
      organizationId: item.organizationId,
      projectId: item.projectId,
      operation:
        action === 'deactivate'
          ? InventoryAccountingItemAuditOperation.DEACTIVATE
          : InventoryAccountingItemAuditOperation.REACTIVATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });
    return InventoryAccountingItemResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

[gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-items/application/use-cases/list-inventory-items.use-case.ts:30](../../gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-items/application/use-cases/list-inventory-items.use-case.ts#L30)

```ts
async execute(
    query: ListInventoryItemsQueryDto,
    actor: InventoryItemActorContext,
    forcedProjectId?: number,
  ): Promise<InventoryItemListResponseDto> {
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const projectId = forcedProjectId ?? query.project_id;
    let organizationId = this.scope.resolveOrganizationFilter(
      actor,
      query.organization_id,
    );

    if (projectId !== undefined) {
      const project = await this.projects.findById(projectId);
      if (!project) {
        throw new NotFoundException({
          code: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: 'Project not found',
        });
      }
      this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, project.organizationId);
      organizationId = project.organizationId;
    }

    const { items, total } = await this.repository.list({
      page,
      pageSize,
      organizationId,
      projectId,
      status: query.status,
      oldPlate: this.scope.normalizePlate(query.old_plate) ?? undefined,
      newPlate: this.scope.normalizePlate(query.new_plate) ?? undefined,
      description: query.description,
      search: query.search,
    });

    return {
      items: items.map((item) => InventoryItemResponseDto.fromDomain(item)),
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
      total_items: total,
      total_pages: total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    };
  }
```

</details>

[gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-items/application/use-cases/create-inventory-item.use-case.ts:39](../../gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-items/application/use-cases/create-inventory-item.use-case.ts#L39)

```ts
async execute(
    projectId: number,
    dto: CreateInventoryItemDto,
    actor: InventoryItemActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryItemResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.projects.findById(projectId);
    if (!project) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Project not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, project.organizationId);
    this.scope.assertProjectAllowsMutation(project);

    const now = new Date();
    let item: InventoryItem;
    try {
      item = new InventoryItem({
        id: 0,
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        externalItemId: this.scope.cleanText(dto.external_item_id) ?? null,
        sequence: this.scope.cleanText(dto.sequence) ?? null,
        oldPlate: this.scope.normalizePlate(dto.old_plate) ?? null,
        newPlate: this.scope.normalizePlate(dto.new_plate) ?? null,
        unitText: this.scope.cleanText(dto.unit_text) ?? null,
        addressText: this.scope.cleanText(dto.address_text) ?? null,
        locationText: this.scope.cleanText(dto.location_text) ?? null,
        description: this.scope.cleanText(dto.description) ?? null,
        brand: this.scope.cleanText(dto.brand) ?? null,
        model: this.scope.cleanText(dto.model) ?? null,
        serialNumber: this.scope.cleanText(dto.serial_number) ?? null,
        capacity: this.scope.cleanText(dto.capacity) ?? null,
        year: dto.year ?? null,
        notes: this.scope.cleanText(dto.notes) ?? null,
        source: this.scope.cleanText(dto.source) ?? 'manual',
        usedValue: dto.used_value ?? null,
        newValue: dto.new_value ?? null,
        status: dto.status ?? InventoryItemStatus.PENDING,
        metadata: dto.metadata ?? null,
        createdById: actor.id,
        updatedById: actor.id,
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
        deletedAt: null,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw this.validation(error);
    }

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(item, {
      inventoryItemId: 0,
      organizationId: item.organizationId,
      projectId: item.projectId,
      operation: InventoryItemAuditOperation.CREATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: {
        project_id: { before: null, after: item.projectId },
        organization_id: { before: null, after: item.organizationId },
        status: { before: null, after: item.status },
      },
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'CREATE_INVENTORY_ITEM',
      inventoryItemId: saved.id,
      projectId: saved.projectId,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return InventoryItemResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async execute(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    dto: UpdateInventoryItemDto,
    actor: InventoryItemActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryItemResponseDto> {
    const item = await this.repository.findById(id);
    if (!item || item.projectId !== projectId) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Inventory item not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, item.organizationId);

    const project = await this.projects.findById(projectId);
    if (!project) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Project not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertProjectAllowsMutation(project);

    let changes: Record<string, { before: unknown; after: unknown }>;
    try {
      changes = item.updateFields({
        externalItemId: this.scope.cleanText(dto.external_item_id),
        sequence: this.scope.cleanText(dto.sequence),
        oldPlate: this.scope.normalizePlate(dto.old_plate),
        newPlate: this.scope.normalizePlate(dto.new_plate),
        unitText: this.scope.cleanText(dto.unit_text),
        addressText: this.scope.cleanText(dto.address_text),
        locationText: this.scope.cleanText(dto.location_text),
        description: this.scope.cleanText(dto.description),
        brand: this.scope.cleanText(dto.brand),
        model: this.scope.cleanText(dto.model),
        serialNumber: this.scope.cleanText(dto.serial_number),
        capacity: this.scope.cleanText(dto.capacity),
        year: dto.year,
        notes: this.scope.cleanText(dto.notes),
        source: this.scope.cleanText(dto.source),
        usedValue: dto.used_value,
        newValue: dto.new_value,
        status: dto.status,
        metadata: dto.metadata,
        updatedById: actor.id,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw this.validation(error);
    }

    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 0) {
      return InventoryItemResponseDto.fromDomain(item);
    }

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(item, {
      inventoryItemId: item.id,
      organizationId: item.organizationId,
      projectId: item.projectId,
      operation: InventoryItemAuditOperation.UPDATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'UPDATE_INVENTORY_ITEM',
      inventoryItemId: saved.id,
      projectId: saved.projectId,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return InventoryItemResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

```ts
async execute(
    projectId: number,
    itemId: number,
    query: ListInventoryItemImagesQueryDto,
    actor: InventoryItemImageActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryItemImageListResponseDto> {
    const item = await this.inventoryItems.findById(itemId);
    if (!item) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Inventory item not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertItemBelongsToProject(item, projectId);
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, item.organizationId);

    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const result = await this.repository.list({
      page,
      pageSize,
      organizationId: item.organizationId,
      inventoryItemId: item.id,
      status: query.status,
    });

    return {
      items: result.items.map((image) =>
        InventoryItemImageResponseDto.fromDomain(image),
      ),
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
      total_items: result.total,
      total_pages: Math.ceil(result.total / pageSize),
    };
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-item-images/application/use-cases/confirm-inventory-item-image-upload.use-case.ts:40](../../gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-item-images/application/use-cases/confirm-inventory-item-image-upload.use-case.ts#L40)

```ts
async execute(
    projectId: number,
    itemId: number,
    imageId: number,
    dto: ConfirmInventoryItemImageUploadDto,
    actor: InventoryItemImageActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryItemImageResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.projects.findById(projectId);
    if (!project) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Project status blocks this operation',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertProjectAllowsMutation(project);
    if (dto.size_bytes !== undefined && dto.size_bytes !== null) {
      this.scope.assertSize(dto.size_bytes);
    }

    const image = await this.getImage.findAndAuthorize(imageId, actor, {
      projectId,
      itemId,
    });
    if (image.status !== InventoryItemImageStatus.PENDING_UPLOAD)
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Only pending upload images can be confirmed',
      });
    const props = image.toProps();
    const verified = await this.storage.verifyUpload({
      bucket: image.bucket,
      path: image.path,
      mimeType: image.mimeType,
      sizeBytes: Number(props.sizeBytes),
      checksum: props.checksum,
      createdAt: props.createdAt,
      expiresInSeconds: this.scope.presignedUrlTtlSeconds(),
      assertion: { sizeBytes: dto.size_bytes, checksum: dto.checksum },
    });
    let changes: Record<string, { before: unknown; after: unknown }>;
    try {
      changes = image.confirmUpload(actor.id, {
        checksum: verified.checksum,
        sizeBytes: verified.sizeBytes,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : 'Inventory item image upload cannot be confirmed',
      });
    }

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(image, {
      inventoryItemImageId: image.id,
      organizationId: image.organizationId,
      inventoryItemId: image.inventoryItemId,
      operation: InventoryItemImageAuditOperation.CONFIRM_UPLOAD,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'CONFIRM_INVENTORY_ITEM_IMAGE_UPLOAD',
      inventoryItemImageId: saved.id,
      inventoryItemId: saved.inventoryItemId,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return InventoryItemImageResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async execute(
    imageId: number,
    actor: InventoryItemImageActorContext,
    expected?: { projectId?: number; itemId?: number },
  ): Promise<InventoryItemImageDownloadUrlResponseDto> {
    const image = await this.getImage.findAndAuthorize(
      imageId,
      actor,
      expected,
    );
    if (image.status !== InventoryItemImageStatus.UPLOADED) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Only uploaded images can be downloaded',
      });
    }

    const signed = await this.storageSigner.createDownloadUrl({
      bucket: image.bucket,
      path: image.path,
      mimeType: image.mimeType,
      expiresInSeconds: this.scope.presignedUrlTtlSeconds(),
      sizeBytes: Number(image.toProps().sizeBytes),
      checksum: image.toProps().checksum,
    });

    await this.repository.audit({
      inventoryItemImageId: image.id,
      organizationId: image.organizationId,
      inventoryItemId: image.inventoryItemId,
      operation: InventoryItemImageAuditOperation.DOWNLOAD_URL,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: {
        download_url_generated: { before: false, after: true },
      },
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'CREATE_INVENTORY_ITEM_IMAGE_DOWNLOAD_URL',
      inventoryItemImageId: image.id,
      inventoryItemId: image.inventoryItemId,
      organizationId: image.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return {
      image: InventoryItemImageResponseDto.fromDomain(image),
      download_url: signed.url,
      expires_in_seconds: signed.expiresInSeconds,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async execute(
    projectId: number,
    itemId: number,
    imageId: number,
    actor: InventoryItemImageActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryItemImageResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.projects.findById(projectId);
    if (!project) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message: 'Project status blocks this operation',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertProjectAllowsMutation(project);

    const image = await this.getImage.findAndAuthorize(imageId, actor, {
      projectId,
      itemId,
    });
    let changes: Record<string, { before: unknown; after: unknown }>;
    try {
      changes = image.remove(actor.id, new Date());
    } catch (error) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'CONFLICT',
        message:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : 'Inventory item image cannot be removed',
      });
    }

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(image, {
      inventoryItemImageId: image.id,
      organizationId: image.organizationId,
      inventoryItemId: image.inventoryItemId,
      operation: InventoryItemImageAuditOperation.REMOVE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'REMOVE_INVENTORY_ITEM_IMAGE',
      inventoryItemImageId: saved.id,
      inventoryItemId: saved.inventoryItemId,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return InventoryItemImageResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-item-images/application/use-cases/create-inventory-item-image-upload-url.use-case.ts:55](../../gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-item-images/application/use-cases/create-inventory-item-image-upload-url.use-case.ts#L55)

```ts
async execute(
    projectId: number,
    itemId: number,
    dto: CreateInventoryItemImageUploadDto,
    actor: InventoryItemImageActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryItemImageUploadUrlResponseDto> {
    const item = await this.inventoryItems.findById(itemId);
    if (!item) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Inventory item not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertItemBelongsToProject(item, projectId);
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, item.organizationId);

    const project = await this.projects.findById(projectId);
    if (!project) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Project not found',
      });
    }
    this.scope.assertProjectAllowsMutation(project);
    this.scope.assertMimeType(dto.mime_type);
    this.scope.assertSize(dto.size_bytes);
    this.scope.assertImageLimit(
      await this.repository.countActiveByItem(itemId),
    );

    const originalName = this.scope.cleanText(dto.original_name);
    if (!originalName) {
      throw new BadRequestException({
        code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
        message: 'original_name is required',
      });
    }

    const now = new Date();
    const image = new InventoryItemImage({
      id: 0,
      organizationId: item.organizationId,
      inventoryItemId: item.id,
      storageProvider: this.scope.storageProvider(),
      bucket: this.scope.storageBucket(),
      path: this.scope.buildStoragePath({
        organizationId: item.organizationId,
        inventoryItemId: item.id,
        storageKey: randomUUID(),
        originalName,
      }),
      originalName,
      mimeType: dto.mime_type.toLowerCase(),
      sizeBytes: dto.size_bytes,
      checksum: this.scope.cleanText(dto.checksum),
      status: InventoryItemImageStatus.PENDING_UPLOAD,
      uploadedById: actor.id,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      deletedAt: null,
    });

    const signed = await this.storageSigner.createUploadUrl({
      bucket: image.bucket,
      path: image.path,
      mimeType: image.mimeType,
      expiresInSeconds: this.scope.presignedUrlTtlSeconds(),
      sizeBytes: image.toProps().sizeBytes,
      checksum: image.toProps().checksum,
    });

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(image, {
      inventoryItemImageId: 0,
      organizationId: image.organizationId,
      inventoryItemId: image.inventoryItemId,
      operation: InventoryItemImageAuditOperation.CREATE_UPLOAD_URL,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: {
        status: { before: null, after: image.status },
        original_name: { before: null, after: originalName },
        mime_type: { before: null, after: image.mimeType },
        size_bytes: { before: null, after: image.toProps().sizeBytes },
      },
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'CREATE_INVENTORY_ITEM_IMAGE_UPLOAD_URL',
      inventoryItemImageId: saved.id,
      inventoryItemId: saved.inventoryItemId,
      organizationId: saved.organizationId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return {
      image: InventoryItemImageResponseDto.fromDomain(saved),
      upload_url: signed.url,
      expires_in_seconds: signed.expiresInSeconds,
    };
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async listPlateHistory(
    projectId: number,
    itemId: number,
    query: InventoryOperationListQueryDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, false);
    await this.requireItem(projectId, itemId);
    const total = await this.plateHistory.count({
      where: {
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        inventoryItemId: itemId,
      },
    });
    const items = await this.plateHistory
      .createQueryBuilder('plate')
      .leftJoin(
        InventoryObservationEntity,
        'observation',
        'observation.id = plate.observation_id AND observation.project_id = :projectId',
        { projectId },
      )
      .leftJoin(
        InventoryRoundEntity,
        'round',
        'round.id = observation.round_id AND round.project_id = :projectId',
        { projectId },
      )
      .select('plate.id', 'id')
      .addSelect('plate.inventory_item_id', 'inventory_item_id')
      .addSelect('plate.observation_id', 'observation_id')
      .addSelect('plate.previous_plate', 'previous_plate')
      .addSelect('plate.observed_plate', 'observed_plate')
      .addSelect('plate.source', 'source')
      .addSelect('plate.recorded_by_id', 'recorded_by_id')
      .addSelect('plate.created_at', 'created_at')
      .addSelect('observation.session_id', 'session_id')
      .addSelect('observation.round_id', 'round_id')
      .addSelect('round.round_number', 'round_number')
      .addSelect('observation.captured_at', 'captured_at')
      .addSelect('observation.field_agent_id', 'field_agent_id')
      .where('plate.organization_id = :organizationId', {
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
      })
      .andWhere('plate.project_id = :projectId', { projectId })
      .andWhere('plate.inventory_item_id = :itemId', { itemId })
      .orderBy('plate.created_at', 'ASC')
      .addOrderBy('plate.id', 'ASC')
      .offset((query.page - 1) * query.page_size)
      .limit(query.page_size)
      .getRawMany<Record<string, unknown>>();
    return this.paginate(items, query, total);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async createValuation(
    projectId: number,
    itemId: number,
    dto: CreateAssetValuationDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    return this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const project = await manager.getRepository(ProjectEntity).findOne({
        where: { id: projectId },
        ...(manager.connection.options.type === 'mysql'
          ? { lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' as const } }
          : {}),
      });
      if (!project) this.notFound('Project');
      const item = await manager.getRepository(InventoryItemEntity).findOne({
        where: {
          id: itemId,
          projectId,
          organizationId: project.organizationId,
        },
        ...(manager.connection.options.type === 'mysql'
          ? { lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' as const } }
          : {}),
      });
      if (!item) this.notFound('Inventory item');
      return this.valuationResponse(
        await this.recordValuation(manager, project, item, dto, actor),
      );
    });
  }
```

```ts
async listSessions(
    projectId: number,
    query: InventorySessionListQueryDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, false);
    const [items, total] = await this.sessions.findAndCount({
      where: {
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        ...(query.status
          ? { status: query.status as InventorySessionStatus }
          : {}),
      },
      order: { createdAt: 'DESC' },
      skip: (query.page - 1) * query.page_size,
      take: query.page_size,
    });
    return this.paginate(
      items.map((item) => this.sessionResponse(item)),
      query,
      total,
    );
  }
```

```ts
async createSession(
    projectId: number,
    dto: CreateInventorySessionDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    return this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const entity = await manager.getRepository(InventorySessionEntity).save({
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        name: dto.name.trim(),
        status: InventorySessionStatus.DRAFT,
        startedAt: null,
        finishedAt: null,
        cancelledAt: null,
        cancellationReason: null,
        createdById: actor.id,
        metadata: dto.metadata ?? null,
      });
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        'inventory_session',
        entity.id,
        'CREATE',
        actor.id,
        { status: InventorySessionStatus.DRAFT },
      );
      return this.sessionResponse(entity);
    });
  }
```

```ts
async getSession(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    await this.getProject(projectId, actor, false);
    const session = await this.requireSession(projectId, sessionId);
    const currentRound = await this.rounds.findOne({
      where: {
        organizationId: session.organizationId,
        projectId,
        sessionId,
        status: InventoryRoundStatus.ACTIVE,
      },
      order: { roundNumber: 'DESC', id: 'DESC' },
    });
    return {
      ...this.sessionResponse(session),
      current_round_id: currentRound?.id ?? null,
    };
  }
```

<details><summary>Implementação chamada: AssistedService.decide</summary>

[gai-backend/src/modules/assisted-reconciliation/assisted.service.ts:510](../../gai-backend/src/modules/assisted-reconciliation/assisted.service.ts#L510)

```ts
async decide(
    p: number,
    s: number,
    id: number,
    dto: DecideAssistedDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.ds.transaction(
      this.ds.options.type === 'mysql' ? 'REPEATABLE READ' : 'SERIALIZABLE',
      async (m) => {
        const project = await this.authorize(m, p, s, actor, true);
        const org = project.organizationId;
        const fingerprint = digest({
          p,
          s,
          id,
          revision: dto.revision,
          sourceHash: dto.source_hash,
          action: dto.action,
          reason: dto.reason.trim(),
          commandKey: dto.command_key,
          actor: actor.id,
        });
        const old = await m.getRepository(AssistedDecision).findOne({
          where: {
            organizationId: org,
            projectId: p,
            commandKey: dto.command_key,
          },
        });
        if (old) {
          if (old.fingerprint !== fingerprint)
            conflict('Chave de idempotência utilizada por outro comando.');
          return old.result;
        }
        const candidate = await m.getRepository(AssistedCandidate).findOne({
          where: { id, projectId: p, sessionId: s, organizationId: org },
        });
        if (!candidate) absent();
        const run = await m.getRepository(AssistedRun).findOneByOrFail({
          id: candidate.runId,
          projectId: p,
          sessionId: s,
          organizationId: org,
        });
        if (
          candidate.status !== 'pending' ||
          candidate.revision !== dto.revision
        )
          conflict('Sugestão já revisada ou versão desatualizada.');
        if (
          dto.source_hash !== run.sourceHash ||
          (await this.sourceHash(m, p, s, org, true)) !== run.sourceHash
        )
          conflict(
            'Fontes obsoletas. Gere uma nova execução antes de decidir.',
          );
        if (dto.reason.trim().length < 5)
          conflict(
            'Informe uma justificativa com pelo menos cinco caracteres.',
          );
        let reconciliationId: number | null = null;
        if (dto.action === 'approved') {
          if (
            !candidate.accountingItemId ||
            !candidate.accounting ||
            !candidate.evidence
          )
            conflict('Não há candidato contábil para aprovação.');
          if (
            candidate.physical.result === 'not_found' ||
            candidate.physical.result === 'duplicated' ||
            candidate.warnings.some((w) => w.startsWith('Duplicidade'))
          )
            conflict(
              'Duplicidades ou observação não localizada exigem correção/reinventário e nova execução.',
            );
          const claims = m.getRepository(AssistedClaim);
          if (
            await claims.exists({
              where: [
                { projectId: p, inventoryItemId: candidate.inventoryItemId },
                { projectId: p, accountingItemId: candidate.accountingItemId },
              ],
            })
          )
            conflict(
              'Item físico ou contábil já reservado por decisão aprovada.',
            );
          const consolidated = await m
            .getRepository(InventoryConsolidationEntity)
            .createQueryBuilder('c')
            .innerJoin(
              InventoryReconciliationEntity,
              'r',
              'r.id = c.reconciliationId',
            )
            .where(
              'c.projectId = :p AND (r.inventoryItemId = :item OR r.accountingItemId = :accounting)',
              {
                p,
                item: candidate.inventoryItemId,
                accounting: candidate.accountingItemId,
              },
            )
            .getCount();
          if (consolidated)
            conflict(
              'Uma das fontes já possui decisão consolidada. O histórico existente não pode ser substituído.',
            );
          await m.getRepository(InventorySessionEntity).findOne({
            where: { id: s, projectId: p },
            ...(m.connection.options.type === 'mysql'
              ? { lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' as const } }
              : {}),
          });
          const max = await m
            .getRepository(InventoryReconciliationEntity)
            .createQueryBuilder('r')
            .select('MAX(r.runNumber)', 'max')
            .where('r.sessionId = :s', { s })
            .getRawOne<{ max: number | null }>();
          const row = await m
            .getRepository(InventoryReconciliationEntity)
            .save({
              organizationId: org,
              projectId: p,
              sessionId: s,
              runNumber: Number(max?.max ?? 0) + 1,
              inventoryItemId: candidate.inventoryItemId,
              observationId: candidate.physical.observationId,
              accountingItemId: candidate.accountingItemId,
              status:
                candidate.evidence.rule === 'exact_plate'
                  ? ReconciliationStatus.MATCHED
                  : ReconciliationStatus.PLATE_DIVERGENCE,
              physicalPlate: normalizeIdentifier(candidate.physical.plate),
              accountingPlate: normalizeIdentifier(candidate.accounting.plate),
              evidence: {
                assisted_candidate_id: id,
                assisted_run_id: run.id,
                config: run.config,
                source_hash: run.sourceHash,
                physical: candidate.physical,
                accounting: candidate.accounting,
                comparison: candidate.evidence,
                warnings: candidate.warnings,
              },
              createdById: actor.id,
            });
          await claims.save({
            organizationId: org,
            projectId: p,
            sessionId: s,
            candidateId: id,
            inventoryItemId: candidate.inventoryItemId,
            accountingItemId: candidate.accountingItemId,
          });
          await this.operations.recordConsolidation(
            m,
            project,
            row,
            {
              decision: ConsolidationDecision.ACCEPTED,
              notes: dto.reason.trim(),
            },
            actor,
          );
          reconciliationId = row.id;
        }
        const result = {
          id,
          status: dto.action,
          revision: candidate.revision + 1,
          reconciliationId,
        };
        const updated = await m
          .getRepository(AssistedCandidate)
          .update(
            { id, revision: dto.revision, status: 'pending' },
            { status: dto.action, revision: result.revision },
          );
        if (!updated.affected) conflict('Conflito de revisão.');
        await m.getRepository(AssistedDecision).save({
          organizationId: org,
          projectId: p,
          sessionId: s,
          candidateId: id,
          commandKey: dto.command_key,
          fingerprint,
          action: dto.action,
          reason: dto.reason.trim(),
          actorId: actor.id,
          revision: result.revision,
          sourceHash: run.sourceHash,
          reconciliationId,
          result,
        });
        return result;
      },
    );
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async history(
    p: number,
    s: number,
    id: number,
    q: AssistedPageQuery,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    await this.authorize(this.ds.manager, p, s, actor);
    if (
      !(await this.ds
        .getRepository(AssistedCandidate)
        .existsBy({ id, projectId: p, sessionId: s }))
    )
      absent();
    const [items, total] = await this.ds
      .getRepository(AssistedDecision)
      .findAndCount({
        where: { projectId: p, sessionId: s, candidateId: id },
        order: { id: 'DESC' },
        skip: (q.page - 1) * q.page_size,
        take: q.page_size,
      });
    return { items, total };
  }
```

```ts
async generate(
    p: number,
    s: number,
    dto: GenerateAssistedDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.ds.transaction(
      this.ds.options.type === 'mysql' ? 'REPEATABLE READ' : 'SERIALIZABLE',
      async (m) => {
        const project = await this.authorize(m, p, s, actor, true);
        const org = project.organizationId;
        const config = dto.config ?? DEFAULT_MATCH_CONFIG;
        if (config.localTextThreshold > config.textThreshold)
          conflict(
            'O limiar com localização deve ser menor ou igual ao limiar textual.',
          );
        const sourceHash = await this.sourceHash(m, p, s, org);
        const observations = await this.latest(m, p, s, org)
          .andWhere('o.inventoryItemId > :after', { after: dto.after_item_id })
          .orderBy('o.inventoryItemId')
          .take(21)
          .getMany();
        const hasMore = observations.length > 20;
        observations.splice(20);
        if (!observations.length)
          conflict('Não há observações após este cursor.');
        const physical: MatchSource[] = [];
        for (const o of observations) {
          const item = await m.getRepository(InventoryItemEntity).findOne({
            where: {
              id: o.inventoryItemId,
              projectId: p,
              organizationId: org,
            },
          });
          const round = await m.getRepository(InventoryRoundEntity).findOne({
            where: {
              id: o.roundId,
              projectId: p,
              sessionId: s,
              organizationId: org,
            },
          });
          if (!item || !round)
            conflict('Observação sem item/rodada vigente no escopo.');
          physical.push({
            id: item.id,
            plate: o.observedPlate,
            serial: o.observedSerialNumber,
            description: item.description,
            location: o.locationText,
            unit: o.unitText,
            version: digest({ item, observation: o, round }),
            observationId: o.id,
            roundId: o.roundId,
            result: o.result,
          });
        }
        const countsP = new Map<string, number>(),
          countsA = new Map<string, number>();
        const keys = (row: MatchSource) =>
          (['plate', 'serial'] as const)
            .map((k) => {
              const v = normalizeIdentifier(row[k]);
              return v ? k + ':' + v : '';
            })
            .filter(Boolean);
        const tracked = new Set(physical.flatMap(keys));
        let cursor = 0;
        for (;;) {
          const rows = await this.latest(m, p, s, org)
            .andWhere('o.id > :cursor', { cursor })
            .orderBy('o.id')
            .take(250)
            .getMany();
          if (!rows.length) break;
          for (const row of rows)
            for (const key of keys({
              plate: row.observedPlate,
              serial: row.observedSerialNumber,
            } as MatchSource))
              if (tracked.has(key))
                countsP.set(key, (countsP.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
          cursor = rows.at(-1)!.id;
        }
        const pairs: Array<{
          physical: MatchSource;
          accounting: MatchSource;
          evidence: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof compareSources>>;
        }> = [];
        let scanned = 0;
        await this.visitAccounting(
          m,
          p,
          org,
          (row) => {
            if (row.deletedAt) return;
            if (++scanned > 20000)
              conflict(
                'Limite síncrono de 20.000 registros contábeis excedido. Nenhuma sugestão parcial foi gravada.',
              );
            const a = this.accounting(row);
            for (const f of physical) {
              const evidence = compareSources(f, a, config);
              if (evidence)
                pairs.push({ physical: f, accounting: a, evidence });
            }
            if (pairs.length > 2000)
              conflict(
                'Mais de 2.000 candidatos neste lote: refine as fontes ou os critérios. Nada foi truncado ou gravado.',
              );
          },
          false,
        );
        // Also detect duplicate identifiers carried by text-only candidates, even
        // when the corresponding identifier was absent on the physical source.
        const candidateKeys = new Set(
          pairs.flatMap((pair) => keys(pair.accounting)),
        );
        await this.visitAccounting(
          m,
          p,
          org,
          (row) => {
            if (row.deletedAt) return;
            for (const key of keys(this.accounting(row)))
              if (candidateKeys.has(key))
                countsA.set(key, (countsA.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
          },
          false,
        );
        const run = await m.getRepository(AssistedRun).save({
          organizationId: org,
          projectId: p,
          sessionId: s,
          config,
          sourceHash,
          afterItemId: dto.after_item_id,
          nextItemId: hasMore ? observations.at(-1)!.inventoryItemId : null,
          createdById: actor.id,
          summary: {},
        });
        const physicalCounts = new Map<number, number>(),
          accountingCounts = new Map<number, number>();
        for (const pair of pairs) {
          physicalCounts.set(
            pair.physical.id,
            (physicalCounts.get(pair.physical.id) ?? 0) + 1,
          );
          accountingCounts.set(
            pair.accounting.id,
            (accountingCounts.get(pair.accounting.id) ?? 0) + 1,
          );
        }
        const summary = {
          physical: physical.length,
          candidates: pairs.length,
          probable: 0,
          ambiguous: 0,
          descriptionAlerts: 0,
          withoutCandidates: 0,
        };
        for (const f of physical) {
          const matches = pairs.filter((pair) => pair.physical.id === f.id);
          for (const pair of matches) {
            const warnings: string[] = [];
            for (const key of keys(f))
              if ((countsP.get(key) ?? 0) > 1)
                warnings.push('Duplicidade física de ' + key.split(':')[0]);
            for (const key of keys(pair.accounting))
              if ((countsA.get(key) ?? 0) > 1)
                warnings.push('Duplicidade contábil de ' + key.split(':')[0]);
            if ((physicalCounts.get(f.id) ?? 0) > 1)
              warnings.push('Vários candidatos para este item físico.');
            if ((accountingCounts.get(pair.accounting.id) ?? 0) > 1)
              warnings.push('Candidato contábil compartilhado neste lote.');
            if (warnings.length) summary.ambiguous++;
            else summary.probable++;
            if (pair.evidence.alerts.some((a) => a.startsWith('Descrição')))
              summary.descriptionAlerts++;
            await m.getRepository(AssistedCandidate).save({
              organizationId: org,
              projectId: p,
              sessionId: s,
              runId: run.id,
              inventoryItemId: f.id,
              accountingItemId: pair.accounting.id,
              physical: f,
              accounting: pair.accounting,
              evidence: pair.evidence,
              warnings,
              status: 'pending',
              revision: 1,
            });
          }
          if (!matches.length) {
            summary.withoutCandidates++;
            await m.getRepository(AssistedCandidate).save({
              organizationId: org,
              projectId: p,
              sessionId: s,
              runId: run.id,
              inventoryItemId: f.id,
              accountingItemId: null,
              physical: f,
              accounting: null,
              evidence: null,
              warnings: [
                'Sem candidato: confira dados incompletos, série, placa e descrição.',
              ],
              status: 'pending',
              revision: 1,
            });
          }
        }
        run.summary = summary;
        return m.getRepository(AssistedRun).save(run);
      },
    );
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/assisted-reconciliation/assisted.service.ts:436](../../gai-backend/src/modules/assisted-reconciliation/assisted.service.ts#L436)

```ts
async candidates(
    p: number,
    s: number,
    runId: number,
    q: AssistedPageQuery,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.ds.transaction(
      this.ds.options.type === 'mysql' ? 'REPEATABLE READ' : 'SERIALIZABLE',
      async (m) => {
        const project = await this.authorize(m, p, s, actor);
        const run = await m.getRepository(AssistedRun).findOne({
          where: {
            id: runId,
            projectId: p,
            sessionId: s,
            organizationId: project.organizationId,
          },
        });
        if (!run) absent();
        const currentHash = await this.sourceHash(
          m,
          p,
          s,
          project.organizationId,
        );
        const [items, total] = await m
          .getRepository(AssistedCandidate)
          .findAndCount({
            where: {
              runId,
              projectId: p,
              sessionId: s,
              ...(q.status ? { status: q.status } : {}),
            },
            order: { id: 'ASC' },
            skip: (q.page - 1) * q.page_size,
            take: q.page_size,
          });
        return {
          run,
          stale: currentHash !== run.sourceHash,
          items,
          total,
          page: q.page,
          page_size: q.page_size,
        };
      },
    );
  }
```
