[gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-operations/application/inventory-operations.service.ts:314](../../gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-operations/application/inventory-operations.service.ts#L314)

```ts
async cancelSession(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    dto: CancelInventorySessionDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    return this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const sessionRepo = manager.getRepository(InventorySessionEntity);
      const session = await sessionRepo.findOne({
        where: { id: sessionId, projectId },
        ...(manager.connection.options.type === 'mysql'
          ? { lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' as const } }
          : {}),
      });
      if (!session) this.notFound('Inventory session');
      InventoryOperationPolicy.assertCanCancelSession(session.status);
      const roundRepo = manager.getRepository(InventoryRoundEntity);
      const activeRounds = await roundRepo.find({
        where: {
          projectId,
          sessionId,
          status: InventoryRoundStatus.ACTIVE,
        },
      });
      const now = new Date();
      for (const round of activeRounds) {
        round.status = InventoryRoundStatus.CANCELLED;
        round.finishedAt = now;
      }
      if (activeRounds.length > 0) await roundRepo.save(activeRounds);
      const oldStatus = session.status;
      session.status = InventorySessionStatus.CANCELLED;
      session.cancelledAt = now;
      session.cancellationReason = dto.reason.trim();
      await sessionRepo.save(session);
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        session.organizationId,
        projectId,
        'inventory_session',
        sessionId,
        'CANCEL',
        actor.id,
        {
          old_status: oldStatus,
          new_status: InventorySessionStatus.CANCELLED,
          reason: session.cancellationReason,
          cancelled_round_ids: activeRounds.map((round) => round.id),
        },
      );
      return this.sessionResponse(session);
    });
  }
```

```ts
async finishSession(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    return this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const sessionRepo = manager.getRepository(InventorySessionEntity);
      const session = await sessionRepo.findOne({
        where: { id: sessionId, projectId },
        ...(manager.connection.options.type === 'mysql'
          ? { lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' as const } }
          : {}),
      });
      if (!session) this.notFound('Inventory session');
      const activeRoundCount = await manager
        .getRepository(InventoryRoundEntity)
        .count({
          where: {
            projectId,
            sessionId,
            status: InventoryRoundStatus.ACTIVE,
          },
        });
      InventoryOperationPolicy.assertCanFinishSession(
        session.status,
        activeRoundCount,
      );
      const oldStatus = session.status;
      session.status = InventorySessionStatus.FINISHED;
      session.finishedAt = new Date();
      await sessionRepo.save(session);
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        session.organizationId,
        projectId,
        'inventory_session',
        sessionId,
        'FINISH',
        actor.id,
        {
          old_status: oldStatus,
          new_status: InventorySessionStatus.FINISHED,
        },
      );
      return this.sessionResponse(session);
    });
```

```ts
async listObservations(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    query: InventoryObservationListQueryDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    await this.getProject(projectId, actor, false);
    await this.requireSession(projectId, sessionId);
    const [items, total] = await this.observations.findAndCount({
      where: {
        projectId,
        sessionId,
        ...(query.round_id ? { roundId: query.round_id } : {}),
        ...(query.inventory_item_id
          ? { inventoryItemId: query.inventory_item_id }
          : {}),
        ...(query.field_agent_id ? { fieldAgentId: query.field_agent_id } : {}),
      },
      order: { capturedAt: 'ASC', id: 'ASC' },
      skip: (query.page - 1) * query.page_size,
      take: query.page_size,
    });
    return this.paginate(
      items.map((item) => this.observationResponse(item)),
      query,
      total,
    );
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-operations/application/inventory-operations.service.ts:904](../../gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-operations/application/inventory-operations.service.ts#L904)

```ts
async reconcile(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ): Promise<InventoryReconciliationRunResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    await this.requireSession(projectId, sessionId);
    const observations = await this.observations.find({
      where: { projectId, sessionId },
      order: { capturedAt: 'DESC', id: 'DESC' },
    });
    const latest = new Map<number, InventoryObservationEntity>();
    for (const observation of observations)
      if (!latest.has(observation.inventoryItemId))
        latest.set(observation.inventoryItemId, observation);
    if (latest.size === 0)
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRES_OBSERVATIONS',
        message: 'No observations available',
      });
    const accounting = await this.accountingItems.find({
      where: {
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        deletedAt: IsNull(),
      },
    });
    const byPlate = new Map<string, InventoryAccountingItemEntity[]>();
    for (const row of accounting) {
      const plate = InventoryOperationPolicy.normalizePlate(
        row.newInventoryPlate ?? row.plate,
      );
      if (!plate) continue;
      byPlate.set(plate, [...(byPlate.get(plate) ?? []), row]);
    }
    const physicalCounts = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const row of latest.values())
      if (row.observedPlate)
        physicalCounts.set(
          row.observedPlate,
          (physicalCounts.get(row.observedPlate) ?? 0) + 1,
        );
    return this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
      await manager.getRepository(InventorySessionEntity).findOne({
        where: { id: sessionId, projectId },
        ...(manager.connection.options.type === 'mysql'
          ? { lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' as const } }
          : {}),
      });
      const max = await manager
        .getRepository(InventoryReconciliationEntity)
        .createQueryBuilder('r')
        .select('MAX(r.runNumber)', 'max')
        .where('r.sessionId = :sessionId', { sessionId })
        .getRawOne<{ max: string | null }>();
      const runNumber = Number(max?.max ?? 0) + 1;
      const rows: InventoryReconciliationEntity[] = [];
      const matchedAccounting = new Set<number>();
      for (const observation of latest.values()) {
        const matches = observation.observedPlate
          ? (byPlate.get(observation.observedPlate) ?? [])
          : [];
        let status = ReconciliationStatus.PHYSICAL_SURPLUS;
        if (
          observation.observedPlate &&
          (physicalCounts.get(observation.observedPlate) ?? 0) > 1
        )
          status = ReconciliationStatus.DUPLICATE;
        else if (matches.length > 1) status = ReconciliationStatus.DUPLICATE;
        else if (matches.length === 1) status = ReconciliationStatus.MATCHED;
        const accountingItem = matches[0] ?? null;
        if (accountingItem) matchedAccounting.add(accountingItem.id);
        rows.push(
          manager.getRepository(InventoryReconciliationEntity).create({
            organizationId: project.organizationId,
            projectId,
            sessionId,
            runNumber,
            inventoryItemId: observation.inventoryItemId,
            observationId: observation.id,
            accountingItemId: accountingItem?.id ?? null,
            status,
            physicalPlate: observation.observedPlate,
            accountingPlate: accountingItem
              ? InventoryOperationPolicy.normalizePlate(
                  accountingItem.newInventoryPlate ?? accountingItem.plate,
                )
              : null,
            evidence: {
              observation_result: observation.result,
              accounting_match_count: matches.length,
            },
            createdById: actor.id,
          }),
        );
      }
      for (const row of accounting)
        if (!matchedAccounting.has(row.id))
          rows.push(
            manager.getRepository(InventoryReconciliationEntity).create({
              organizationId: project.organizationId,
              projectId,
              sessionId,
              runNumber,
              inventoryItemId: null,
              observationId: null,
              accountingItemId: row.id,
              status: ReconciliationStatus.ACCOUNTING_SURPLUS,
              physicalPlate: null,
              accountingPlate: InventoryOperationPolicy.normalizePlate(
                row.newInventoryPlate ?? row.plate,
              ),
              evidence: { reason: 'no_latest_physical_observation' },
              createdById: actor.id,
            }),
          );
      const saved = await manager
        .getRepository(InventoryReconciliationEntity)
        .save(rows);
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        'inventory_reconciliation_run',
        null,
        'CREATE',
        actor.id,
        { session_id: sessionId, run_number: runNumber, records: saved.length },
      );
      return {
        run_number: runNumber,
        records: saved.map((row) => this.reconciliationResponse(row)),
      };
    });
  }
```

```ts
async consolidate(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    reconciliationId: number,
    dto: ConsolidateReconciliationDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    const reconciliation = await this.reconciliations.findOne({
      where: { id: reconciliationId, projectId, sessionId },
    });
    if (!reconciliation) this.notFound('Reconciliation');
    if (reconciliation.status === ReconciliationStatus.DUPLICATE)
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'DUPLICATE_BLOCKS_CONSOLIDATION',
        message: 'Duplicate evidence must be resolved before consolidation',
      });
    try {
      return await this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
        await manager.getRepository(ProjectEntity).findOne({
          where: { id: projectId },
          ...(manager.connection.options.type === 'mysql'
            ? { lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' as const } }
            : {}),
        });
        return this.recordConsolidation(
          manager,
          project,
          reconciliation,
          dto,
          actor,
        );
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!this.isUniqueViolation(error)) throw error;
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'RECONCILIATION_ALREADY_CONSOLIDATED',
        message: 'Reconciliation already consolidated',
      });
    }
  }
```

```ts
async requestReinventory(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    dto: RequestReinventoryDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    await this.requireItem(projectId, dto.inventory_item_id);
    const prior = await this.observations.findOne({
      where: { projectId, sessionId, inventoryItemId: dto.inventory_item_id },
      order: { capturedAt: 'DESC', id: 'DESC' },
    });
    if (!prior)
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'REINVENTORY_REQUIRES_PRIOR_OBSERVATION',
        message: 'Reinventory requires an earlier observation',
      });
    try {
      return await this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
        const session = await manager
          .getRepository(InventorySessionEntity)
          .findOne({
            where: { id: sessionId, projectId },
            ...(manager.connection.options.type === 'mysql'
              ? { lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' as const } }
              : {}),
          });
        if (!session) this.notFound('Inventory session');
        if (session.status !== InventorySessionStatus.ACTIVE)
          throw new ConflictException({
            code: 'INVENTORY_SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE',
            message: 'Session must be active',
          });
        const latest = await manager
          .getRepository(InventoryRoundEntity)
          .findOne({ where: { sessionId }, order: { roundNumber: 'DESC' } });
        const round = await manager.getRepository(InventoryRoundEntity).save({
          organizationId: session.organizationId,
          projectId,
          sessionId,
          roundNumber: (latest?.roundNumber ?? 0) + 1,
          kind: InventoryRoundKind.REINVENTORY,
          inventoryItemId: dto.inventory_item_id,
          reason: dto.reason.trim(),
          status: InventoryRoundStatus.ACTIVE,
          requestedById: actor.id,
          startedAt: new Date(),
          finishedAt: null,
        });
        await this.audit(
          manager,
          session.organizationId,
          projectId,
          'inventory_round',
          round.id,
          'REQUEST_REINVENTORY',
          actor.id,
          { item_id: dto.inventory_item_id, reason: round.reason },
        );
        return this.roundResponse(round);
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!this.isUniqueViolation(error)) throw error;
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'INVENTORY_ROUND_CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION',
        message: 'Round number was allocated by a concurrent operation',
      });
    }
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async listRounds(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    query: InventoryRoundListQueryDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, false);
    await this.requireSession(projectId, sessionId);
    const [items, total] = await this.rounds.findAndCount({
      where: {
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        sessionId,
        ...(query.status ? { status: query.status } : {}),
        ...(query.type ? { kind: query.type } : {}),
      },
      order: { roundNumber: 'DESC', id: 'DESC' },
      skip: (query.page - 1) * query.page_size,
      take: query.page_size,
    });
    return this.paginate(
      items.map((item) => this.roundResponse(item)),
      query,
      total,
    );
  }
```

```ts
async finishRound(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    roundId: number,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    return this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const repo = manager.getRepository(InventoryRoundEntity);
      const round = await repo.findOne({
        where: { id: roundId, projectId, sessionId },
        ...(manager.connection.options.type === 'mysql'
          ? { lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' as const } }
          : {}),
      });
      if (!round) this.notFound('Inventory round');
      if (round.status !== InventoryRoundStatus.ACTIVE)
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'INVENTORY_ROUND_NOT_ACTIVE',
          message: 'Only active rounds can be finished',
        });
      round.status = InventoryRoundStatus.FINISHED;
      round.finishedAt = new Date();
      await repo.save(round);
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        round.organizationId,
        projectId,
        'inventory_round',
        roundId,
        'FINISH',
        actor.id,
        { status: InventoryRoundStatus.FINISHED },
      );
      return this.roundResponse(round);
    });
  }
```

```ts
async recordObservation(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    roundId: number,
    dto: CreateInventoryObservationDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    assertOperationalActor(actor);
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    const item = await this.requireItem(projectId, dto.inventory_item_id);
    if (dto.idempotency_key) {
      const existing = await this.observations.findOne({
        where: {
          organizationId: project.organizationId,
          idempotencyKey: dto.idempotency_key,
        },
      });
      if (existing) {
        if (
          existing.projectId !== projectId ||
          existing.sessionId !== sessionId ||
          existing.roundId !== roundId
        )
          throw new ConflictException({
            code: 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED',
            message: 'Idempotency key belongs to another operation',
          });
        return this.observationResponse(existing);
      }
    }
    const [session, round, assignment] = await Promise.all([
      this.requireSession(projectId, sessionId),
      this.rounds.findOne({ where: { id: roundId, projectId, sessionId } }),
      this.assignments.findOne({
        where: {
          organizationId: project.organizationId,
          projectId,
          fieldAgentId: dto.field_agent_id,
          status: ProjectFieldAgentStatus.ACTIVE,
        },
      }),
    ]);
    if (!round) this.notFound('Inventory round');
    if (!assignment)
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'FIELD_AGENT_NOT_ASSIGNED',
        message: 'Field agent must have an active project assignment',
      });
    InventoryOperationPolicy.assertCanReceiveObservation(
      session.status,
      round.status,
      round.kind,
      round.inventoryItemId,
      item.id,
    );
    const roundObservation = await this.observations.findOne({
      where: { projectId, sessionId, roundId, inventoryItemId: item.id },
    });
    if (roundObservation) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'OBSERVATION_ALREADY_RECORDED',
        message: 'Item already has an observation in this round',
      });
    }
    const prior = await this.observations.findOne({
      where: { projectId, sessionId, inventoryItemId: item.id },
      order: { capturedAt: 'DESC', id: 'DESC' },
    });
    const observedPlate = InventoryOperationPolicy.normalizePlate(
      dto.observed_plate,
    );
    const masterPlate = InventoryOperationPolicy.normalizePlate(
      item.newPlate ?? item.oldPlate,
    );
    try {
      return await this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
        await requireOperationalAssignment(
          manager,
          project.organizationId,
          projectId,
          dto.field_agent_id,
          actor,
        );
        const observation = await manager
          .getRepository(InventoryObservationEntity)
          .save({
            organizationId: project.organizationId,
            projectId,
            sessionId,
            roundId,
            inventoryItemId: item.id,
            fieldAgentId: dto.field_agent_id,
            priorObservationId: prior?.id ?? null,
            idempotencyKey: dto.idempotency_key ?? null,
            result: dto.result,
            observedPlate,
            observedSerialNumber: this.clean(dto.observed_serial_number),
            unitText: this.clean(dto.unit_text),
            sectorText: this.clean(dto.sector_text),
            locationText: this.clean(dto.location_text),
            notes: this.clean(dto.notes),
            capturedAt: dto.captured_at
              ? new Date(dto.captured_at)
              : new Date(),
            receivedAt: new Date(),
            createdById: actor.id,
          });
        if (observedPlate) {
          await manager.getRepository(InventoryPlateHistoryEntity).save({
            organizationId: project.organizationId,
            projectId,
            inventoryItemId: item.id,
            observationId: observation.id,
            previousPlate: masterPlate,
            observedPlate,
            source: PlateEvidenceSource.FIELD,
            recordedById: actor.id,
          });
        }
        await this.audit(
          manager,
          project.organizationId,
          projectId,
          'inventory_observation',
          observation.id,
          'RECORD',
          actor.id,
          {
            result: dto.result,
            prior_observation_id: prior?.id ?? null,
            master_plate: masterPlate,
            observed_plate: observedPlate,
          },
        );
        return this.observationResponse(observation);
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!this.isUniqueViolation(error)) throw error;
      if (dto.idempotency_key) {
        const existing = await this.observations.findOne({
          where: {
            organizationId: project.organizationId,
            idempotencyKey: dto.idempotency_key,
          },
        });
        if (
          existing &&
          existing.projectId === projectId &&
          existing.sessionId === sessionId &&
          existing.roundId === roundId
        )
          return this.observationResponse(existing);
        if (existing)
          throw new ConflictException({
            code: 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED',
            message: 'Idempotency key belongs to another operation',
          });
      }
      if (
        await this.observations.findOne({
          where: { projectId, sessionId, roundId, inventoryItemId: item.id },
        })
      )
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'OBSERVATION_ALREADY_RECORDED',
          message: 'Item already has an observation in this round',
        });
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'INVENTORY_OBSERVATION_CONFLICT',
        message: 'Observation conflicts with a concurrent operation',
      });
    }
  }
```

```ts
async listObservationEvidence(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    roundId: number,
    observationId: number,
    query: InventoryOperationListQueryDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {

    await this.requireObservation(projectId, sessionId, roundId, observationId);
    const [items, total] = await this.observationEvidence.findAndCount({
      where: {
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        sessionId,
        roundId,
        observationId,
      },
      order: { createdAt: 'ASC', id: 'ASC' },
      skip: (query.page - 1) * query.page_size,
      take: query.page_size,
    });
    return this.paginate(
      items.map((item) => this.evidenceResponse(item)),
      query,
      total,
    );
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-operations/application/inventory-operations.service.ts:723](../../gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-operations/application/inventory-operations.service.ts#L723)

```ts
async confirmEvidenceUpload(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    roundId: number,
    observationId: number,
    evidenceId: number,
    dto: ConfirmObservationEvidenceUploadDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    const session = await this.requireSession(projectId, sessionId);
    this.assertSessionAcceptsEvidence(session);
    await this.requireObservation(projectId, sessionId, roundId, observationId);
    if (dto.size_bytes != null) this.imageScope.assertSize(dto.size_bytes);
    return this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const repo = manager.getRepository(InventoryObservationEvidenceEntity);
      const evidence = await repo.findOne({
        where: {
          id: evidenceId,
          organizationId: session.organizationId,
          projectId,
          sessionId,
          roundId,
          observationId,
        },
        ...(manager.connection.options.type === 'mysql'
          ? { lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' as const } }
          : {}),
      });
      if (!evidence) this.notFound('Observation evidence');
      if (evidence.status === InventoryObservationEvidenceStatus.UPLOADED)
        return this.evidenceResponse(evidence);
      const verified = await this.storageSigner.verifyUpload({
        bucket: evidence.bucket,
        path: evidence.storageKey,
        mimeType: evidence.mimeType,
        sizeBytes: Number(evidence.sizeBytes),
        checksum: evidence.checksum,
        createdAt: evidence.createdAt,
        expiresInSeconds: this.imageScope.presignedUrlTtlSeconds(),
        assertion: { sizeBytes: dto.size_bytes, checksum: dto.checksum },
      });
      const before = {
        status: evidence.status,
        checksum: evidence.checksum,
        size_bytes: evidence.sizeBytes,
      };
      evidence.status = InventoryObservationEvidenceStatus.UPLOADED;
      evidence.checksum = verified.checksum;
      evidence.sizeBytes = verified.sizeBytes;
      evidence.confirmedAt = new Date();
      await repo.save(evidence);
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        evidence.organizationId,
        projectId,
        'inventory_observation_evidence',
        evidenceId,
        'CONFIRM_UPLOAD',
        actor.id,
        {
          before,
          after: {
            status: evidence.status,
            checksum: evidence.checksum,
            size_bytes: evidence.sizeBytes,
          },
        },
      );
      return this.evidenceResponse(evidence);
    });
  }
```

```ts
async createEvidenceDownloadUrl(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    roundId: number,
    observationId: number,
    evidenceId: number,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, false);
    await this.requireObservation(projectId, sessionId, roundId, observationId);
    const evidence = await this.observationEvidence.findOne({
      where: {
        id: evidenceId,
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        sessionId,
        roundId,
        observationId,
      },
    });
    if (!evidence) this.notFound('Observation evidence');
    if (evidence.status !== InventoryObservationEvidenceStatus.UPLOADED)
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'OBSERVATION_EVIDENCE_NOT_UPLOADED',
        message: 'Only uploaded evidence can be downloaded',
      });
    const signed = await this.storageSigner.createDownloadUrl({
      bucket: evidence.bucket,
      path: evidence.storageKey,
      mimeType: evidence.mimeType,
      expiresInSeconds: this.imageScope.presignedUrlTtlSeconds(),
      sizeBytes: Number(evidence.sizeBytes),
      checksum: evidence.checksum,
    });
    return {
      evidence: this.evidenceResponse(evidence),
      download_url: signed.url,
      expires_in_seconds: signed.expiresInSeconds,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async createEvidenceUploadUrl(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    roundId: number,
    observationId: number,
    dto: CreateObservationEvidenceUploadDto,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    const session = await this.requireSession(projectId, sessionId);
    this.assertSessionAcceptsEvidence(session);
    await this.requireObservation(projectId, sessionId, roundId, observationId);
    this.imageScope.assertMimeType(dto.mime_type);
    this.imageScope.assertSize(dto.size_bytes);
    const originalName = this.imageScope.cleanText(dto.original_name);
    if (!originalName)
      throw new BadRequestException({
        code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
        message: 'original_name is required',
      });
    const storageKey = this.observationEvidenceStorageKey(
      project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      sessionId,
      observationId,
      originalName,
    );
    const signed = await this.storageSigner.createUploadUrl({
      bucket: this.imageScope.storageBucket(),
      path: storageKey,
      mimeType: dto.mime_type.toLowerCase(),
      expiresInSeconds: this.imageScope.presignedUrlTtlSeconds(),
      sizeBytes: dto.size_bytes,
      checksum: dto.checksum,
    });

    const evidence = await this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const saved = await manager
        .getRepository(InventoryObservationEvidenceEntity)
        .save({
          organizationId: project.organizationId,
          projectId,
          sessionId,
          roundId,
          observationId,
          storageProvider: this.imageScope.storageProvider(),
          bucket: this.imageScope.storageBucket(),
          storageKey,
          originalName,
          mimeType: dto.mime_type.toLowerCase(),
          sizeBytes: dto.size_bytes,
          checksum: this.imageScope.cleanText(dto.checksum),
          status: InventoryObservationEvidenceStatus.PENDING_UPLOAD,
          createdById: actor.id,
          confirmedAt: null,
        });
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        'inventory_observation_evidence',
        saved.id,
        'CREATE_UPLOAD_URL',
        actor.id,
        {
          session_id: sessionId,
          round_id: roundId,
          observation_id: observationId,
          mime_type: saved.mimeType,
          size_bytes: saved.sizeBytes,
        },
      );
      return saved;
    });
    return {
      evidence: this.evidenceResponse(evidence),
      upload_url: signed.url,
      expires_in_seconds: signed.expiresInSeconds,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async startSession(
    projectId: number,
    sessionId: number,
    actor: InventoryOperationActor,
  ) {
    await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    return this.dataSource.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const repo = manager.getRepository(InventorySessionEntity);
      const session = await repo.findOne({
        where: { id: sessionId, projectId },
        ...(manager.connection.options.type === 'mysql'
          ? { lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' as const } }
          : {}),
      });
      if (!session) this.notFound('Inventory session');
      InventoryOperationPolicy.assertCanStart(session.status);
      const now = new Date();
      session.status = InventorySessionStatus.ACTIVE;
      session.startedAt = now;
      await repo.save(session);
      const round = await manager.getRepository(InventoryRoundEntity).save({
        organizationId: session.organizationId,
        projectId,
        sessionId,
        roundNumber: 1,
        kind: InventoryRoundKind.INITIAL,
        inventoryItemId: null,
        reason: null,
        status: InventoryRoundStatus.ACTIVE,
        requestedById: actor.id,
        startedAt: now,
        finishedAt: null,
      });
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        session.organizationId,
        projectId,
        'inventory_session',
        sessionId,
        'START',
        actor.id,
        { round_id: round.id },
      );
      return {
        session: this.sessionResponse(session),
```

```ts
async listPayments(
    projectId: number,
    query: ListPaymentsQueryDto,
    actor: PaymentsExpensesActorContext,
  ): Promise<PaymentListResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, false);
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const { items, total } = await this.repo.listPayments({
      page,
      pageSize,
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      fieldAgentId: query.field_agent_id,
      status: query.status,
      state: query.state,
      startDate: query.start_date,
      endDateExclusive: this.scope.nextDateString(query.end_date),
      paymentDate: query.payment_date,
      paymentDateExclusive: this.scope.nextDateString(query.payment_date),
      search: query.search,
    });
    return {
      items: items.map((item) => PaymentResponseDto.fromDomain(item)),
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
      total_items: total,
      total_pages: total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    };
  }
```

```ts
async createPayment(
    projectId: number,
    dto: PaymentInputDto,
    actor: PaymentsExpensesActorContext,
  ): Promise<PaymentResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    await this.assertFieldAgent(
      project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      dto.field_agent_id,
    );
    const startDate = this.requiredDate(dto.start_date, 'start_date');
    const endDate = this.requiredDate(dto.end_date, 'end_date');
    const now = new Date();
    const payment = new FieldAgentPayment({
      id: 0,
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      fieldAgentId: dto.field_agent_id,
      state: this.scope.cleanText(dto.state) ?? null,
      startDate,
      endDate,
      paymentDate: this.scope.parseDate(dto.payment_date),
      days: this.scope.daysBetweenInclusive(startDate, endDate),
      dailyRate: dto.daily_rate,
      additionalAmount: dto.additional_amount ?? '0.00',
      dailyTotal: '0.00',
      discountAmount: dto.discount_amount ?? '0.00',
      finalAmount: '0.00',
      status: PaymentStatus.PENDING,
      notes: this.scope.cleanText(dto.notes) ?? null,
      approvedById: null,
      approvedAt: null,
      paidById: null,
      paidAt: null,
      createdById: actor.id,
      updatedById: actor.id,
      metadata: dto.metadata ?? null,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      deletedAt: null,
    });
    const saved = await this.repo.savePaymentWithAudit(payment, {
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      operation: PaymentExpenseAuditOperation.CREATE_PAYMENT,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: { status: { before: null, after: PaymentStatus.PENDING } },
    });
    return PaymentResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async updatePayment(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    dto: PaymentInputDto,
    actor: PaymentsExpensesActorContext,
  ): Promise<PaymentResponseDto> {
    return this.mutatePayment(projectId, id, actor, (payment) => {
      const startDate = this.requiredDate(dto.start_date, 'start_date');
      const endDate = this.requiredDate(dto.end_date, 'end_date');
      const changes = payment.updateFields({
        state: this.scope.cleanText(dto.state) ?? null,
        startDate,
        endDate,
        paymentDate: this.scope.parseDate(dto.payment_date),
        days: this.scope.daysBetweenInclusive(startDate, endDate),
        dailyRate: dto.daily_rate,
        additionalAmount: dto.additional_amount ?? '0.00',
        discountAmount: dto.discount_amount ?? '0.00',
        notes: this.scope.cleanText(dto.notes) ?? null,
        metadata: dto.metadata ?? null,
        updatedById: actor.id,
      });
      return {
        organizationId: payment.organizationId,
        projectId,
        paymentId: payment.id,
        operation: PaymentExpenseAuditOperation.UPDATE_PAYMENT,
        performedBy: actor.id,
        changes,
      };
    });
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async list(
    projectId: number,
    query: ListInventoryPendingIssuesQueryDto,
    actor: InventoryPendingIssueActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryPendingIssueListResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, false);
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const { items, total } = await this.repository.list({
      page,
      pageSize,
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      type: query.type,
      status: query.status,
      severity: query.severity,
      inventoryItemId: query.inventory_item_id,
      accountingItemId: query.accounting_item_id,
      plate: this.scope.normalizePlate(query.plate) ?? undefined,
      search: query.search,
    });
    return {
      items: items.map((item) =>
        InventoryPendingIssueResponseDto.fromDomain(item),
      ),
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
      total_items: total,
      total_pages: total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    };
  }
```

```ts
async create(
    projectId: number,
    dto: CreateInventoryPendingIssueDto,
    actor: InventoryPendingIssueActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryPendingIssueResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    await this.assertLinkedItems(
      project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      dto.inventory_item_id ?? null,
      dto.accounting_item_id ?? null,
      actor,
    );
    await this.assertNoOpenDuplicate(
      project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      dto.type,
      dto.inventory_item_id ?? null,
      dto.accounting_item_id ?? null,
    );

    const now = new Date();
    const issue = new InventoryPendingIssue({
      id: 0,
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      projectId,
      inventoryItemId: dto.inventory_item_id ?? null,
      accountingItemId: dto.accounting_item_id ?? null,
      type: dto.type,
      status: InventoryPendingIssueStatus.OPEN,
      severity: dto.severity ?? InventoryPendingIssueSeverity.MEDIUM,
      title: this.scope.cleanText(dto.title) ?? dto.title,
      description: this.scope.cleanText(dto.description) ?? null,
      oldValue: dto.old_value ?? null,
      newValue: dto.new_value ?? null,
      resolutionNotes: null,
      resolvedById: null,
      resolvedAt: null,
      ignoredById: null,
      ignoredAt: null,
      createdById: actor.id,
      updatedById: actor.id,
      metadata: dto.metadata ?? null,
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      deletedAt: null,
    });

    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(issue, {
      inventoryPendingIssueId: 0,
      organizationId: issue.organizationId,
      projectId: issue.projectId,
      operation: InventoryPendingIssueAuditOperation.CREATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes: { status: { before: null, after: issue.status } },
    });
    return InventoryPendingIssueResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

```ts
async update(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    dto: UpdateInventoryPendingIssueDto,
    actor: InventoryPendingIssueActorContext,
  ): Promise<InventoryPendingIssueResponseDto> {
    const issue = await this.findIssue(projectId, id, actor);
    await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    const changes = issue.updateFields({
      type: dto.type,
      status: dto.status,
      severity: dto.severity,
      title: this.scope.cleanText(dto.title) ?? undefined,
      description: this.scope.cleanText(dto.description),
      oldValue: dto.old_value,
      newValue: dto.new_value,
      metadata: dto.metadata,
      updatedById: actor.id,
    });
    if (Object.keys(changes).length === 0) {
      return InventoryPendingIssueResponseDto.fromDomain(issue);
    }
    const saved = await this.repository.saveWithAudit(issue, {
      inventoryPendingIssueId: issue.id,
      organizationId: issue.organizationId,
      projectId: issue.projectId,
      operation: InventoryPendingIssueAuditOperation.UPDATE,
      performedBy: actor.id,
      changes,
    });
    return InventoryPendingIssueResponseDto.fromDomain(saved);
  }
```

```ts
async generate(
    projectId: number,
    actor: InventoryPendingIssueActorContext,
  ): Promise<GenerateInventoryPendingIssuesResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.getProject(projectId, actor, true);
    const physical = await this.listAllInventoryItems(
      project.organizationId,
      projectId,
    );
    const accounting = await this.listAllAccountingItems(
      project.organizationId,
      projectId,
    );
    let created = 0;
    let skipped = 0;

    const accountingByPlate = new Map(
      accounting
        .map((item) => [item.toProps().plate, item] as const)
        .filter(([plate]) => plate),
    );
    const physicalPlateSet = new Set<string>();
    for (const item of physical) {
      const props = item.toProps();
      const plate = props.newPlate ?? props.oldPlate;
      if (plate) physicalPlateSet.add(plate);
      if (!plate) {
        created += await this.createGeneratedIssue(
          project.organizationId,
          projectId,
          actor.id,
          InventoryPendingIssueType.MISSING_PLATE,
          item.id,
          null,
          'Item fisico sem placa',
          { plate: null },
          null,
        );
        continue;
      }
      const match = accountingByPlate.get(plate);
      if (!match) {
        created += await this.createGeneratedIssue(
          project.organizationId,
          projectId,
          actor.id,
          InventoryPendingIssueType.PHYSICAL_ITEM_WITHOUT_ACCOUNTING_MATCH,
          item.id,
          null,
          'Item fisico sem correspondencia contabil',
          { plate },
          null,
        );
        continue;
      }
      const accountProps = match.toProps();
      if (this.differs(props.description, accountProps.description)) {
        created += await this.createGeneratedIssue(
          project.organizationId,
          projectId,
          actor.id,
          InventoryPendingIssueType.DESCRIPTION_DIVERGENCE,
          item.id,
          match.id,
          'Divergencia de descricao',
          { inventory: props.description },
          { accounting: accountProps.description },
        );
      }
      if (this.differs(props.locationText, accountProps.location)) {
        created += await this.createGeneratedIssue(
          project.organizationId,
          projectId,
          actor.id,
          InventoryPendingIssueType.LOCATION_DIVERGENCE,
          item.id,
          match.id,
          'Divergencia de localizacao',
          { inventory: props.locationText },
          { accounting: accountProps.location },
        );
      }
    }

    for (const account of accounting) {
      const props = account.toProps();
      if (props.plate && physicalPlateSet.has(props.plate)) continue;
      const result = await this.createGeneratedIssue(
        project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        actor.id,
        InventoryPendingIssueType.ACCOUNTING_ITEM_NOT_FOUND,
        null,
        account.id,
        'Bem contabil nao encontrado no inventario fisico',
        { plate: props.plate },
        null,
      );
      created += result;
      skipped += result === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'GENERATE_INVENTORY_PENDING_ISSUES',
      projectId,
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      created,
      skipped,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });
    return { created, skipped };
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async list(projectId: number, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    const project = await this.project(projectId, actor);
    const instances = await this.repo.manager
      .getRepository(ProjectPreparationEntity)
      .find({
        where: { organizationId: project.organizationId, projectId },
        order: { id: 'DESC' },
        take: 100,
      });
    const items = await Promise.all(
      instances.map(async (row) =>
        this.view(row, await this.repo.answers(row)),
```

```ts
async create(
    projectId: number,
    dto: CreatePreparationDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    const project = await this.project(projectId, actor, true);
    validDate(dto.scheduled_date);
    validDate(dto.due_date);
    const id = await this.repo.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const template = await this.repo.template(
        project.organizationId,
        dto.template_id,
        manager,
      );
      if (!template) this.missing();
      if (template.archivedAt)
        this.conflict('Modelo arquivado não pode originar novas instâncias');
      const version = await this.repo.version(
        project.organizationId,
        template.id,
        dto.template_version ?? template.currentVersion,
        manager,
      );
      if (!version) this.missing();
      await this.responsible(
        dto.responsible_user_id,
        project.organizationId,
        manager,
      );
      const row = await manager.getRepository(ProjectPreparationEntity).save({
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        projectId,
        templateVersionId: version.id,
        kind: template.kind,
        title: this.text(dto.title),
        snapshot: {
          name: version.name,
          version: version.version,
          questions: version.questions,
        },
        status: 'draft',
        revision: 1,
        responsibleUserId: dto.responsible_user_id ?? null,
        scheduledDate: dto.scheduled_date ?? null,
        dueDate: dto.due_date ?? null,
        notes: null,
        createdById: actor.id,
        approvedById: null,
        approvedAt: null,
      });
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        actor,
        project.organizationId,
        'INSTANCE_CREATED',
        {
          snapshot: row.snapshot,
          title: row.title,
          responsible_user_id: row.responsibleUserId,
          scheduled_date: row.scheduledDate,
          due_date: row.dueDate,
        },
        projectId,
        row.id,
        template.id,
      );
      return row.id;
    });
    return this.get(projectId, id, actor);
  }
```

```ts
async transition(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    revision: number,
    action: 'approve' | 'reopen' | 'archive',
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    const project = await this.project(projectId, actor, true);
    await this.repo.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const row = await this.scopedInstance(project, id, manager);
      if (row.revision !== revision) this.conflict();
      const changes: Partial<ProjectPreparationEntity> = {};
      if (action === 'approve') {
        this.editable(row);
        const answers = await this.repo.answers(row, manager);
        await this.validateAll(
          row.snapshot.questions,
          answers,
          project,
          manager,
        );
        const missing = progress(
          row.snapshot.questions,
          answers,
        ).missing_required;
        if (missing.length)
          this.conflict(
            `Perguntas obrigatórias pendentes: ${missing.join(', ')}`,
          );
        Object.assign(changes, {
          status: 'approved',
          approvedById: actor.id,
          approvedAt: new Date(),
        });
      } else if (action === 'reopen') {
        if (row.status !== 'approved')
          this.conflict('Somente uma instância aprovada pode ser reaberta');
        Object.assign(changes, {
          status: 'in_progress',
          approvedById: null,
          approvedAt: null,
        });
      } else {
        this.editable(row);
        changes.status = 'archived';
      }
      await this.claim(manager, row, revision, changes);
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        actor,
        project.organizationId,
        `INSTANCE_${action.toUpperCase()}`,
        { before: row.status, after: changes, revision: revision + 1 },
        projectId,
        id,
      );
    });
    return this.get(projectId, id, actor);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async update(

  ) {
    const project = await this.project(projectId, actor, true);
    validDate(dto.scheduled_date);
    validDate(dto.due_date);
    await this.repo.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const row = await this.scopedInstance(project, id, manager);
      if (row.revision !== dto.revision) this.conflict();
      this.editable(row);
      await this.responsible(
        dto.responsible_user_id,
        project.organizationId,

      );
      const changes: Partial<ProjectPreparationEntity> = {};
      if (dto.title !== undefined) changes.title = this.text(dto.title);
      if (dto.responsible_user_id !== undefined)
        changes.responsibleUserId = dto.responsible_user_id;
      if (dto.scheduled_date !== undefined)
        changes.scheduledDate = dto.scheduled_date;
      if (dto.due_date !== undefined) changes.dueDate = dto.due_date;
      if (dto.notes !== undefined) changes.notes = dto.notes;
      await this.claim(manager, row, dto.revision, changes);
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        actor,
        project.organizationId,
        'INSTANCE_UPDATED',
        {
          before: {
            title: row.title,
            responsibleUserId: row.responsibleUserId,
            scheduledDate: row.scheduledDate,
            dueDate: row.dueDate,
            notes: row.notes,
          },
          after: changes,
          revision: dto.revision + 1,
        },
        projectId,
        id,
      );
    });
    return this.get(projectId, id, actor);
```

```ts
async saveAnswers(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    dto: SaveAnswersDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    const project = await this.project(projectId, actor, true);
    await this.repo.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const row = await this.scopedInstance(project, id, manager);
      if (row.revision !== dto.revision) this.conflict();
      this.editable(row);
      const existing = await this.repo.answers(row, manager);
      const merged = new Map<string, PolicyAnswer>(
        existing.map((answer) => [answer.questionId, answer]),
      );
      if (
        new Set(dto.answers.map((answer) => answer.question_id)).size !==
        dto.answers.length
      )
        invalid('Não repita uma pergunta no mesmo lote');
      for (const answer of dto.answers) {
        if (!row.snapshot.questions.some((q) => q.id === answer.question_id))
          invalid('Pergunta não pertence à versão desta instância');
        validDate(answer.due_date);
        await this.responsible(
          answer.responsible_user_id,
          project.organizationId,
          manager,
        );
        merged.set(answer.question_id, {
          questionId: answer.question_id,
          state: answer.state,
          value: answer.value,
          notes: answer.notes ?? null,
        });
      }
      const answers = [...merged.values()];
      const enabled = applicability(row.snapshot.questions, answers);
      if (
        dto.answers.some(
          (answer) =>
            !enabled.get(answer.question_id) ||
            !row.snapshot.questions.find((q) => q.id === answer.question_id)!
              .visible,
        )
      )
        invalid(
          'Pergunta oculta ou desabilitada por condição não pode receber alterações',
        );
      await this.validateAll(row.snapshot.questions, answers, project, manager);
      await this.claim(manager, row, dto.revision, { status: 'in_progress' });
      for (const answer of dto.answers) {
        const before = existing.find(
          (item) => item.questionId === answer.question_id,
        );
        const saved = await manager
          .getRepository(PreparationAnswerEntity)
          .save({
            id: before?.id,
            organizationId: project.organizationId,
            projectId,
            preparationId: id,
            questionId: answer.question_id,
            state: answer.state,
            value: answer.value,
            notes: answer.notes ?? null,
            responsibleUserId:
              answer.responsible_user_id === undefined
                ? (before?.responsibleUserId ?? null)
                : answer.responsible_user_id,
            dueDate:
              answer.due_date === undefined
                ? (before?.dueDate ?? null)
                : answer.due_date,
            answeredById: actor.id,
            answeredAt: answer.state === 'pending' ? null : new Date(),
          });
        await this.audit(
          manager,
          actor,
          project.organizationId,
          'ANSWER_SAVED',
          {
            question_id: answer.question_id,
            question_label: row.snapshot.questions.find(
              (q) => q.id === answer.question_id,
            )!.label,
            before: before ?? null,
            after: saved,
            revision: dto.revision + 1,
          },
          projectId,
          id,
        );
      }
    });
    return this.get(projectId, id, actor);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async communication(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
    channel: 'email' | 'guidance',
  ) {
    const instance = await this.get(projectId, id, actor);
    const context = await this.context(projectId, actor);
    const users = new Map(
      context.responsible_users.map((user) => [user.id, user.label]),
    );
    const lines = [
      channel === 'email'
        ? 'Ata e orientações de preparação'
        : 'Orientações para a equipe técnica',
      `Projeto: ${context.project.name}`,
      `Empresa: ${context.company?.name ?? 'Não vinculada'}`,
      `Documento: ${instance.title} — ${instance.snapshot.name} v${instance.snapshot.version}`,
      `Situação: ${instance.status}`,
      `Responsável: ${users.get(instance.responsible_user_id ?? -1) ?? 'Não definido'}`,
      `Data: ${instance.scheduled_date ?? 'Não definida'} | Prazo: ${instance.due_date ?? 'Não definido'}`,
      ...context.units.map((unit) => `Unidade: ${unit.name} — ${unit.address}`),
      '',
    ];
    for (const question of instance.snapshot.questions) {
      const answer = instance.answers.find(
        (a) => a.question_id === question.id,
      )!;
      if (!question.visible || !answer.applicable || answer.state === 'pending')
        continue;
      const value =
        answer.state === 'not_applicable'
          ? 'Não aplicável'
          : typeof answer.value === 'boolean'
            ? answer.value
              ? 'Sim'
              : 'Não'
            : Array.isArray(answer.value)
              ? answer.allocations
                  .map(
                    (allocation) =>
                      `${context.units.find((unit) => unit.id === allocation.unit_id)?.name ?? 'Unidade desvinculada'}: ${allocation.quantity} itens (${allocation.participation_percent}%)`,
                  )
                  .join('; ')
              : answer.value && typeof answer.value === 'object'
                ? `${answer.value.start} a ${answer.value.end}`
                : String(answer.value);
      lines.push(
        `[${question.category}] ${question.label}: ${value}`,
        ...(answer.notes ? [`Observações: ${answer.notes}`] : []),
      );
    }
    if (instance.notes) lines.push(`Observações gerais: ${instance.notes}`);
    lines.push('', 'Conteúdo para revisão. Esta prévia não foi enviada.');
    await this.audit(
      this.repo.manager,
      actor,
      context.project.organization_id,
      'COMMUNICATION_PREVIEW',
      { channel, revision: instance.revision },
      projectId,
      id,
    );
    return {
      channel,
      recipient: null,
      subject: `${instance.kind === 'kickoff' ? 'Kick-off' : 'Checklist do cliente'} — ${context.project.name}`,
      body: lines.join('\n'),
      delivery_status: 'preview_only' as const,
    };
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async history(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
    beforeId?: number,
  ) {
    const project = await this.project(projectId, actor);
    await this.scopedInstance(project, id);
    const rows = await this.repo.manager
      .getRepository(PreparationAuditEntity)
      .find({
        where: {
          organizationId: project.organizationId,
          projectId,
          preparationId: id,
          ...(beforeId ? { id: LessThan(beforeId) } : {}),
        },
        order: { id: 'DESC' },
        take: 50,
      });
    return {
      items: rows.map((row) => ({
        id: row.id,
        operation: row.operation,
        performed_by_id: row.performedById,
        created_at: row.createdAt,
        changes: row.changes,
      })),
      next_before_id: rows.length === 50 ? rows.at(-1)!.id : null,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async transition(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    revision: number,
    action: 'approve' | 'reopen' | 'archive',
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    const project = await this.project(projectId, actor, true);
    await this.repo.transaction(async (manager) => {
      const row = await this.scopedInstance(project, id, manager);
      if (row.revision !== revision) this.conflict();
      const changes: Partial<ProjectPreparationEntity> = {};
      if (action === 'approve') {
        this.editable(row);
        const answers = await this.repo.answers(row, manager);
        await this.validateAll(
          row.snapshot.questions,
          answers,
          project,
          manager,
        );
        const missing = progress(
          row.snapshot.questions,
          answers,
        ).missing_required;
        if (missing.length)
          this.conflict(
            `Perguntas obrigatórias pendentes: ${missing.join(', ')}`,
          );
        Object.assign(changes, {
          status: 'approved',
          approvedById: actor.id,
          approvedAt: new Date(),
        });
      } else if (action === 'reopen') {
        if (row.status !== 'approved')
          this.conflict('Somente uma instância aprovada pode ser reaberta');
        Object.assign(changes, {
          status: 'in_progress',
          approvedById: null,
          approvedAt: null,
        });
      } else {
        this.editable(row);
        changes.status = 'archived';
      }
      await this.claim(manager, row, revision, changes);
      await this.audit(
        manager,
        actor,
        project.organizationId,
        `INSTANCE_${action.toUpperCase()}`,
        { before: row.status, after: changes, revision: revision + 1 },
        projectId,
        id,
      );
    });
    return this.get(projectId, id, actor);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async context(projectId: number, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    const project = await this.project(projectId, actor);
    const company = project.companyId
      ? await this.repo.manager.getRepository(CompanyEntity).findOneBy({
          id: project.companyId,
          organizationId: project.organizationId,
        })
      : null;
    const users = await this.repo.manager.getRepository(UserEntity).find({
      where: {
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        status: UserStatus.ACTIVE,
      },
      select: { id: true, login: true },
      order: { login: 'ASC' },
      take: 500,
    });
    return {
      project: {
        id: project.id,
        name: project.name,
        organization_id: project.organizationId,
        status: project.status,
      },
      company: company ? { id: company.id, name: company.name } : null,
      units: await this.units(project),
      responsible_users: users.map((user) => ({
        id: user.id,
        label: user.login,
      })),
    };
  }
```

```ts
async getSummary(
    projectId: number,
    query: ProjectSummaryQueryDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ): Promise<ProjectSummaryResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.projects.findById(projectId);
    if (!project) {
      this.logger.warn(
        { projectId, actorId: actor.id },
        'project_summary_not_found',
      );
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Project not found',
      });
    }

    this.scope.assertCanAccessProject(actor, project.organizationId);
    this.logger.info(
      {
        projectId,
        actorId: actor.id,
        includeFinancial: Boolean(query.include_financial),
        includeImports: Boolean(query.include_imports),
        includeExports: Boolean(query.include_exports),
        includeRecentActivity: Boolean(query.include_recent_activity),
      },
      'project_summary_requested',
    );

    const mandatorySummaryPromises: [
      Promise<ProjectInventorySummaryDto>,
      Promise<ProjectImagesSummaryDto>,
      Promise<ProjectAccountingSummaryDto>,
      Promise<ProjectPendingIssuesSummaryDto>,
      Promise<ProjectFieldAgentsSummaryDto>,
    ] = [
      this.summaries.getInventorySummary(projectId),
      this.summaries.getImagesSummary(projectId),
      this.summaries.getAccountingSummary(projectId),
      this.summaries.getPendingIssuesSummary(projectId),
      this.summaries.getFieldAgentsSummary(projectId),
    ];
    const [inventory, images, accounting, pendingIssues, fieldAgents] =
      await Promise.all(mandatorySummaryPromises);

    const response: ProjectSummaryResponseDto = {
      project: this.toProjectDto(project),
      inventory,
      images,
      accounting,
      pending_issues: pendingIssues,
      field_agents: fieldAgents,
    };

    if (
      query.include_financial &&
      (await hasAllPermissions(
        actor,
        ['payments:read', 'expenses:read'],
        this.permissions,
      ))
    ) {
      response.financial = await this.summaries.getFinancialSummary(projectId);
    }
    if (query.include_imports) {
      response.imports = await this.summaries.getImportsSummary(projectId);
    }
    if (query.include_exports) {
      response.exports = await this.summaries.getExportsSummary(projectId);
    }
    if (query.include_recent_activity) {
      response.recent_activity =
        await this.summaries.getRecentActivitySummary(projectId);
    }

    return response;
  }
```

</details>

```ts
      status: r.status,
      title: r.data.title,
```

```ts
create(projectId: number, d: CreateReportDto, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    return this.command(projectId, d, actor, 'report-create', async (m, p) => {
      const org = Number(p.organizationId),
        v = await m.findOneBy(ReportTemplateVersion, {
          id: d.template_version_id,
          organizationId: org,
          operation: 'publish',
        });
      if (!v)
        reportInvalid('Selecione uma versão publicada desta organização.');
      const t = await this.template(m, p, v.templateId);
      if (t.archived)
        reportInvalid('Modelo arquivado não permite novos laudos.');
      const sources = await this.sources.capture(m, p, d.selection, actor);
      const fields = v.data.fields.map<ReportContent['fields'][number]>(
        (f) => ({
          key: f.key,
          label: f.label,
          value: f.system_key ? (sources.fields[f.system_key] ?? '') : '',
          origin:
            f.system_key && sources.fields[f.system_key] != null
              ? 'system'
              : 'empty',
          source_key: f.system_key ?? null,
          original_value: f.system_key
            ? (sources.fields[f.system_key] ?? null)
            : null,
        }),
      );
      const data: ReportContent = {
        title: plain(d.title),
        template: {
          id: Number(t.id),
          version_id: Number(v.id),
          hash: v.hash,
          data: v.data,
        },
        sections: v.data.sections.map((s) => ({
          key: s.key,
          title: s.title,
          text: plain(s.text),
          origin: 'template',
        })),
        fields,
        sources,
        responsibles: [],
        technical_notes: '',
        conclusion: '',
      };
      const r = await m.save(
        TechnicalReport,
        m.create(TechnicalReport, {
          organizationId: org,
          projectId,
          revision: 1,
          status: 'draft',
          approvedVersionId: null,
          data,
        }),
      );
      r.id = Number(r.id);
      await this.versionSave(
        m,
        r,
        reportValidation(data, sources.hash),
        actor,
        d.reason,
      );
      return { ...r };
    });
  }
```

```ts
async detail(projectId: number, id: number, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    return this.ds.transaction('REPEATABLE READ', async (m) => {
      const p = await this.project(m, projectId, actor),
        r = await this.report(m, p, id, actor);
      const versions = await m.find(TechnicalReportVersion, {
        // History only exposes metadata. Do not hydrate every large immutable
        // snapshot just to discard its data after the query.
        select: [
          'id',
          'revision',
          'status',
          'hash',
          'actorId',
          'recordedAt',
          'reason',
        ],
        where: { reportId: id, projectId, organizationId: r.organizationId },
        order: { revision: 'DESC' },
      });
      return {
        ...r,
        versions: versions.map((v) => ({
          id: v.id,
          revision: v.revision,
          status: v.status,
          hash: v.hash,
          actorId: v.actorId,
          recordedAt: v.recordedAt,
          reason: v.reason,
        })),
      };
    });
  }
```

```ts
edit(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    d: EditReportDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.command(
      projectId,
      d,
      actor,
      'report-edit:' + id,
      async (m, p) => {
        const r = await this.report(m, p, id, actor);
        this.editable(r, d.revision);
        if (
          d.sections.length !== r.data.sections.length ||
          new Set(d.sections.map((s) => s.key)).size !== d.sections.length
        )
          reportInvalid('Envie todas as seções, sem chaves repetidas.');
        if (
          d.fields.length !== r.data.fields.length ||
          new Set(d.fields.map((f) => f.key)).size !== d.fields.length
        )
          reportInvalid('Envie todos os campos, sem chaves repetidas.');
        for (const s of d.sections) {
          const old = r.data.sections.find((c) => c.key === s.key);
          if (!old) reportInvalid('Seção não pertence ao modelo.');
          const text = plain(s.text);
          if (text !== old.text) {
            old.text = text;
            old.origin = 'manual';
          }
        }
        for (const f of d.fields) {
          const old = r.data.fields.find((c) => c.key === f.key);
          if (!old) reportInvalid('Campo não pertence ao modelo.');
          const value = plain(f.value);
          if (value !== old.value) {
            old.value = value;
            old.origin = value ? 'manual' : 'empty';
          }
        }
        r.data.responsibles = [];
        for (const rid of d.responsible_ids) {
          const resp = await m.findOneBy(ReportResponsible, {
            id: rid,
            organizationId: r.organizationId,
          });
          if (!resp) reportInvalid('Responsável não pertence à organização.');
          await this.activeUser(m, r.organizationId, resp.userId);
          r.data.responsibles.push(resp.data);
        }
        r.data.title = plain(d.title);
        r.data.technical_notes = plain(d.technical_notes);
        r.data.conclusion = plain(d.conclusion);
        r.revision++;
        await this.update(m, r);
        await this.versionSave(
          m,
          r,
          reportValidation(r.data, r.data.sources.hash),
          actor,
          d.reason,
        );
        return { ...r };
      },
    );
  }
```

</details>

```ts
refresh(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    d: RefreshReportDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.command(
      projectId,
      d,
      actor,
      'report-refresh:' + id,
      async (m, p) => {
        const r = await this.report(m, p, id, actor);
        this.editable(r, d.revision);
        r.data.sources = await this.sources.capture(m, p, d.selection, actor);
        for (const f of r.data.fields)
          if (f.source_key) {
            const value = r.data.sources.fields[f.source_key] ?? null;
            f.original_value = value;
            if (f.origin !== 'manual') {
              f.value = value ?? '';
              f.origin = value === null ? 'empty' : 'system';
            }
          }
        r.revision++;
        await this.update(m, r);
        await this.versionSave(
          m,
          r,
          reportValidation(
            r.data,
            r.data.sources.hash,
            await this.invalidResponsibles(m, r),
          ),
          actor,
          d.reason,
        );
        return { ...r };
      },
    );
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/technical-reports/report.service.ts:687](../../gai-backend/src/modules/technical-reports/report.service.ts#L687)

```ts
transition(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    d: TransitionReportDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.command(
      projectId,
      d,
      actor,
      'report-' + d.action + ':' + id,
      async (m, p) => {
        const r = await this.report(m, p, id, actor);
        if (r.revision !== d.revision)
          reportConflict('Revisão divergente. Atualize antes de continuar.');
        let validation: Validation;
        if (d.action === 'review') {
          if (!['draft', 'reopened'].includes(r.status))
            reportConflict(
              'Somente rascunho/reaberto pode seguir para revisão.',
            );
          const current = await this.sources.capture(
            m,
            p,
            r.data.sources.selection,
            actor,
          );
          validation = reportValidation(
            r.data,
            current.hash,
            await this.invalidResponsibles(m, r),
          );
          if (!validation.valid)
            reportConflict(
              'Há bloqueios de validação. Consulte a validação estruturada.',
            );
          r.status = 'in_review';
        } else if (d.action === 'approve') {
          if (r.status !== 'in_review')
            reportConflict('Prepare uma versão em revisão antes de aprovar.');
          r.data.visual_template = await this.visualTemplates.current(
            r.organizationId,
            m,
          );
          const current = await this.sources.capture(
            m,
            p,
            r.data.sources.selection,
            actor,
          );
          validation = reportValidation(
            r.data,
            current.hash,
            await this.invalidResponsibles(m, r),
          );
          if (!validation.valid)
            reportConflict(
              'Há bloqueios de validação; fontes ou requisitos mudaram.',
            );
          r.status = 'approved';
        } else if (d.action === 'reopen') {
          if (!['approved', 'in_review'].includes(r.status))
            reportConflict('Somente aprovado/em revisão pode ser reaberto.');
          r.status = 'reopened';
          validation = reportValidation(r.data, r.data.sources.hash);
        } else {
          if (!['draft', 'reopened', 'approved'].includes(r.status))
            reportConflict('Estado não permite arquivamento.');
          r.status = 'archived';
          validation = reportValidation(r.data, r.data.sources.hash);
        }
        r.revision++;
        const version = await this.versionSave(
          m,
          r,
          validation,
          actor,
          d.reason,
        );
        if (d.action === 'approve') r.approvedVersionId = Number(version.id);
        await this.update(m, r);
        return { ...r, validation, version_id: Number(version.id) };
      },
    );
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async version(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    versionId: number,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    const p = await this.project(this.ds.manager, projectId, actor);
    await this.report(this.ds.manager, p, id, actor);
    const v = await this.ds.manager.findOneBy(TechnicalReportVersion, {
      id: versionId,
      reportId: id,
      projectId,
      organizationId: Number(p.organizationId),
    });
    if (!v) throw new NotFoundException('Versão não pertence ao laudo.');
    await this.sources.require(actor, v.data.sources.permissions);
    return v;
  }
```

```ts
async generate(
    r: SourceRequest,
    dto: GenerateDocumentDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    if (!['pdf', 'docx'].includes(dto.format))
      throw new BadRequestException('Formato não suportado.');
    if (
      process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' &&
      process.env.DOCUMENT_STORAGE !== 'database'
    )
      throw new ServiceUnavailableException(
        'Armazenamento documental não homologado neste ambiente.',
      );
    const source = await this.source(r, actor, !!dto.include_memory);
    const cacheKey = documentHash({
      engine: DOCUMENT_ENGINE,
      org: source.organizationId,
      kind: r.kind,
      id: r.id,
      version: r.versionId,
      source_hash: source.hash,
      model: source.model,
      format: dto.format,
      memory: !!dto.include_memory,
    });
    try {
      let artifact = await this.ds.manager.findOneBy(DocumentArtifact, {
        cacheKey,
        organizationId: source.organizationId,
      });
      let cached = !!artifact;
      if (!artifact) {
        let task = this.pending.get(cacheKey);
        cached = !!task;
        if (!task) {
          task = this.create(
            source,
            dto.format,
            !!dto.include_memory,
            cacheKey,
            actor,
          );
          this.pending.set(cacheKey, task);
          void task
            .finally(() => this.pending.delete(cacheKey))
            .catch(() => undefined);
        }
        artifact = await task;
      }
      await this.source(r, actor, !!dto.include_memory);
      await this.audit(source, actor, 'generated', {
        artifact_id: artifact.id,
        format: dto.format,
        checksum: artifact.checksum,
        cached,
        result: 'success',
      });
      return this.metadata(artifact);
    } catch (error) {
      await this.audit(source, actor, 'generation-failed', {
        format: dto.format,
        result: 'failed',
      });
      throw error;
    }
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async download(r: SourceRequest, id: number, actor: ProjectActorContext) {
    // Authorize before looking up an artifact, and repeat source permissions after lookup.
    const source = await this.source(r, actor, false);
    const row = await this.ds.manager
      .getRepository(DocumentArtifact)
      .createQueryBuilder('a')
      .addSelect('a.bytes')
      .where(
        'a.id=:id AND a.organization_id=:org AND a.kind=:kind AND a.source_id=:source AND a.version_id=:version',
        {
          id,
          org: source.organizationId,
          kind: r.kind,
          source: r.id,
          version: r.versionId,
        },
      )
      .getOne();
    if (!row || row.projectId !== source.projectId)
      throw new NotFoundException('Arquivo indisponível nesta versão.');
    await this.source(r, actor, row.includeMemory);
    if (
      row.sourceHash !== source.hash ||
      !row.bytes ||
      row.sizeBytes > MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES ||
      row.bytes.length !== row.sizeBytes ||
      createHash('sha256').update(row.bytes).digest('hex') !== row.checksum
    ) {
      await this.audit(source, actor, 'download-failed', {
        artifact_id: id,
        result: 'integrity-failed',
      });
      throw new ConflictException(
        'Arquivo indisponível: falha de integridade.',
      );
    }
    await this.audit(source, actor, 'download', {
      artifact_id: id,
      format: row.format,
      checksum: row.checksum,
      result: 'delivered',
    });
    return { ...this.metadata(row), bytes: row.bytes };
  }
```

```ts
async export(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    versionId: number,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    const version = await this.version(projectId, id, versionId, actor);
    if (version.status !== 'approved')
      reportConflict('Exportação exige uma versão aprovada preservada.');
    await this.ds.manager.save(
      ReportCommand,
      this.ds.manager.create(ReportCommand, {
        organizationId: version.organizationId,
        commandKey: 'download-' + randomUUID(),
        hash: version.hash,
        actorId: actor.id,
        operation: 'report-export:' + id,
        reason: 'Download do snapshot aprovado ' + versionId,
        recordedAt: new Date(),
        result: { report_id: id, version_id: versionId, hash: version.hash },
      }),
    );
    return {
      format: 'gai-technical-report-snapshot-v1',
      engine: REPORT_ENGINE,
      version,
      pdf_docx_contract: {
        input: 'immutable approved snapshot',
        required: [
          'escaped plain text',
          'professional A4 template',
          'paginated tables',
          'authorized private artifact and download',
          'render and visual QA',
          'checksum and current source permission validation',
        ],
        available: true,
        formats: ['pdf', 'docx'],
        generation_endpoint: `/projects/${projectId}/technical-reports/${id}/versions/${versionId}/documents`,
      },
    };
  }
```

```ts
createResponsible(
    projectId: number,
    d: ResponsibleDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.command(
      projectId,
      d,
      actor,
      'responsible-register',
      async (m, p) => {
        const org = Number(p.organizationId);
        await this.activeUser(m, org, d.user_id);
        if (
          await m.exists(ReportResponsible, {
            where: { organizationId: org, userId: d.user_id },
          })
        )
          reportConflict('Usuário já cadastrado como responsável.');
        const data = {
          id: 0,
          user_id: d.user_id,
          display_name: plain(d.display_name),
          function: plain(d.function),
          professional_registration: plain(d.professional_registration),
          registration_evidence: plain(d.registration_evidence),
        };
        if (data.professional_registration && !data.registration_evidence)
          reportInvalid('Registro profissional exige referência documental.');
        const r = await m.save(
          ReportResponsible,
          m.create(ReportResponsible, {
            organizationId: org,
            userId: d.user_id,
            data,
          }),
        );
        r.id = Number(r.id);
        r.data.id = r.id;
        await m
          .createQueryBuilder()
          .update(ReportResponsible)
          .set({ data: () => ':data' })
          .where('id=:id', { id: r.id, data: JSON.stringify(r.data) })
          .execute();
        return { ...r };
      },
    );
  }
```

</details>

```ts
createTemplate(
    projectId: number,
    d: CreateTemplateDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.command(
      projectId,
      d,
      actor,
      'template-create',
```

```ts
editTemplate(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    d: EditTemplateDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.command(
      projectId,
      d,
      actor,
      'template-edit:' + id,
      async (m, p) => {
        const t = await this.template(m, p, id);
        if (t.archived || t.revision !== d.revision)
          reportConflict('Modelo arquivado ou revisão divergente.');
        t.revision++;
        t.data = validateTemplate(d.data);
        await m
          .createQueryBuilder()
          .update(ReportTemplate)
          .set({ revision: t.revision, data: () => ':data' })
          .where('id=:id AND organization_id=:org', {
            id,
            org: t.organizationId,
            data: JSON.stringify(t.data),
          })
          .execute();
        await this.templateVersion(m, t, actor, 'draft', d.reason);
        return { ...t };
      },
    );
  }
```

```ts
templateAction(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    d: ReportRevisionDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
    action: 'publish' | 'archive',
  ) {
    return this.command(
      projectId,
      d,
      actor,
      'template-' + action + ':' + id,
      async (m, p) => {
        const t = await this.template(m, p, id);
        if (t.revision !== d.revision || t.archived)
          reportConflict('Modelo arquivado ou revisão divergente.');
        t.revision++;
        t.archived = action === 'archive';
        const v = await this.templateVersion(m, t, actor, action, d.reason);
        if (action === 'publish') t.publishedVersionId = Number(v.id);
        await m.update(
          ReportTemplate,
          { id, organizationId: t.organizationId },
          {
            revision: t.revision,
            archived: t.archived,
            publishedVersionId: t.publishedVersionId,
          },
        );
        return { ...t };
      },
    );
  }
```

</details>
