```ts
templateAction(
    projectId: number,
    id: number,
    d: ReportRevisionDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
    action: 'publish' | 'archive',
  ) {
    return this.command(
      projectId,
      d,
      actor,
      'template-' + action + ':' + id,
      async (m, p) => {
        const t = await this.template(m, p, id);
        if (t.revision !== d.revision || t.archived)
          reportConflict('Modelo arquivado ou revisão divergente.');
        t.revision++;
        t.archived = action === 'archive';
        const v = await this.templateVersion(m, t, actor, action, d.reason);
        if (action === 'publish') t.publishedVersionId = Number(v.id);
        await m.update(
          ReportTemplate,
          { id, organizationId: t.organizationId },
          {
            revision: t.revision,
            archived: t.archived,
            publishedVersionId: t.publishedVersionId,
          },
        );
        return { ...t };
      },
    );
```
```ts
  }
```

```ts
async listProjectUnits(
    projectId: number,
    actor: CompanyActorContext,
  ): Promise<ProjectUnitListResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.findProjectOrFail(projectId);
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, project.organizationId);
    if (!project.companyId) {
      return { items: [] };
    }
    const items = await this.repository.listProjectUnits(projectId);
    return {
      items: items.map(({ projectUnit, companyUnit }) =>
        ProjectUnitResponseDto.fromEntity(projectUnit, companyUnit),
      ),
    };
  }
```

```ts
async assignProjectUnit(
    projectId: number,
    dto: AssignProjectUnitDto,
    actor: CompanyActorContext,
  ): Promise<ProjectUnitResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.findProjectOrFail(projectId);
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, project.organizationId);
    if (!project.companyId) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'PROJECT_HAS_NO_COMPANY',
        message: 'Project has no company linked',
        details: { project_id: projectId },
      });
    }

    const result = await this.repository.assignProjectUnitWithAudit({
      projectId,
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      companyUnitId: dto.company_unit_id,
      performedBy: actor.id,
    });
    if (result.kind === 'success') {
      return ProjectUnitResponseDto.fromEntity(
        result.projectUnit,
        result.companyUnit,
      );
    }

    switch (result.kind) {
      case 'project_not_found':
        throw new NotFoundException({
          code: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: 'Project not found',
        });
      case 'project_has_no_company':
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'PROJECT_HAS_NO_COMPANY',
          message: 'Project has no company linked',
          details: { project_id: projectId },
        });
      case 'project_status_blocks':
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'PROJECT_STATUS_BLOCKS_OPERATION',
          message: 'Project status blocks this operation',
          details: { current_status: result.currentStatus },
        });
      case 'unit_not_found':
        throw new NotFoundException({
          code: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: 'Company unit not found',
        });
      case 'unit_scope_mismatch':
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'PROJECT_UNIT_SCOPE_MISMATCH',
          message:
            'Project and company unit must belong to the same company and organization',
          details: { company_unit_id: dto.company_unit_id },
        });
      case 'unit_inactive':
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'COMPANY_UNIT_STATUS_BLOCKS_OPERATION',
          message: 'Company unit status blocks this operation',
          details: { company_unit_id: dto.company_unit_id },
        });
      case 'already_assigned':
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'PROJECT_UNIT_ALREADY_ASSIGNED',
          message: 'Company unit already assigned to project',
          details: { company_unit_id: dto.company_unit_id },
        });
    }
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async removeProjectUnit(
    projectId: number,
    unitId: number,
    actor: CompanyActorContext,
  ): Promise<ProjectUnitResponseDto> {
    const project = await this.findProjectOrFail(projectId);
    this.scope.assertCanAccessOrganization(actor, project.organizationId);

    const result = await this.repository.removeProjectUnitWithAudit({
      projectId,
      organizationId: project.organizationId,
      companyUnitId: unitId,
      performedBy: actor.id,
    });
    if (result.kind === 'success') {
      return ProjectUnitResponseDto.fromEntity(
        result.projectUnit,
        result.companyUnit,
      );
    }

    switch (result.kind) {
      case 'project_not_found':
        throw new NotFoundException({
          code: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: 'Project not found',
        });
      case 'project_status_blocks':
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'PROJECT_STATUS_BLOCKS_OPERATION',
          message: 'Project status blocks this operation',
          details: { current_status: result.currentStatus },
        });
      case 'assignment_not_found':
        throw new NotFoundException({
          code: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: 'Project unit assignment not found',
        });
      case 'already_removed':
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'PROJECT_UNIT_ALREADY_REMOVED',
          message: 'Project unit assignment is already removed',
          details: { company_unit_id: unitId },
        });
      case 'unit_not_found':
        throw new NotFoundException({
          code: 'NOT_FOUND',
          message: 'Company unit not found',
        });
      case 'unit_scope_mismatch':
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'PROJECT_UNIT_SCOPE_MISMATCH',
          message:
            'Project and company unit must belong to the same organization',
          details: { company_unit_id: unitId },
        });
    }
  }
```

```ts
async list(

    q: InventoryOperationListQueryDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    const project = await this.project(this.ds.manager, p, actor);
    const [items, total] = await this.ds
      .getRepository(ValuationBatch)
      .findAndCount({
        where: { projectId: p, organizationId: project.organizationId },
        order: { id: 'DESC' },
        skip: (q.page - 1) * q.page_size,
        take: q.page_size,
      });
    return {
      items,
      total,
      page: q.page,
      page_size: q.page_size,
      limit: this.limit,
    };
  }
```

```ts
async confirm(
    p: number,
    id: number,
    dto: ConfirmValuationBatchDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.ds.transaction(async (m) => {
      const project = await this.project(m, p, actor, true);
      const batch = await m.getRepository(ValuationBatch).findOneBy({
        id,
        projectId: p,
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
      });
      if (!batch)
        throw new NotFoundException('Operação não encontrada neste projeto.');
      if (batch.createdById !== actor.id)
        throw new ForbiddenException(
          'Somente o autor da prévia pode confirmá-la.',
        );
      if (
        dto.command_key !== batch.commandKey ||
        dto.preview_hash !== batch.previewHash ||
        dto.revision !== 1
      )
        conflict('Confirmação não corresponde à prévia original.');
      if (batch.status === 'applied') return this.response(m, batch);
      if (
        batch.status !== 'preview' ||
        batch.revision !== dto.revision ||
        batch.expiresAt.getTime() < Date.now()
      )
        conflict('Prévia expirada ou já modificada. Gere outra prévia.');
      const current = await this.selected(
        m,
        project,
        batch.request.selection,
        true,
      );
      const rows = await m.getRepository(ValuationBatchRow).find({
        where: {
          batchId: id,
          projectId: p,
          organizationId: project.organizationId,
        },
        order: { inventoryItemId: 'ASC' },
      });
      if (
        current.length !== rows.length ||
        current.some((item, index) => item.id !== rows[index].inventoryItemId)
      )
        conflict(
          'Seleção dos filtros mudou desde a prévia. Gere outra prévia.',
          [],
          batch.total,
        );
      const errors: unknown[] = [];
      for (let n = 0; n < current.length; n++)
        if (
          (await this.snapshot(m, current[n])).version !==
          rows[n].snapshot.version
        )
          errors.push({
            inventory_item_id: current[n].id,
            reason: 'Cadastro ou histórico de avaliação mudou após a prévia.',
          });
      if (errors.length)
        conflict(
          'Fontes obsoletas; nada foi gravado. Gere uma nova prévia.',
          errors,
          batch.total,
        );
      for (let n = 0; n < current.length; n++) {
        const proposed = rows[n].proposed;
        let valuation: AssetValuationEntity;
        try {
          valuation = await this.operations.recordValuation(
            m,
            project,
            current[n],
            {
              source: proposed.source,
              valuation_date: proposed.valuationDate,
              new_value: proposed.newValue,
              used_value: proposed.usedValue,
              notes: proposed.notes,
            },
            actor,
            batch.id,
          );
        } catch {
          throw new HttpException(
            {
              code: 'VALUATION_BATCH_APPLY_FAILED',
              message:
                'Falha ao registrar um item. A operação inteira foi revertida.',
              details: {
                summary: {
                  total_requested: batch.total,
                  total_processed: 0,
                  total_approved: 0,
                  total_rejected: batch.total,
                },
                errors: [
                  {
                    inventory_item_id: current[n].id,
                    reason:
                      'Falha de gravação; nenhuma avaliação deste lote foi mantida. Tente novamente ou consulte o suporte.',
                  },
                ],
              },
            },
            500,
          );
        }
        await m
          .getRepository(ValuationBatchRow)
          .update(rows[n].id, { valuationId: valuation.id });
      }
      const changed = await m.getRepository(ValuationBatch).update(
        { id, revision: 1, status: 'preview' },
        {
          status: 'applied',
          revision: 2,
          confirmedById: actor.id,
          confirmedAt: new Date(),
        },
      );
      if (!changed.affected)
        conflict('Outra confirmação venceu a concorrência.');
      return this.response(
        m,
        await m.getRepository(ValuationBatch).findOneByOrFail({ id }),
      );
    });
  }
```

</details>

[gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-operations/application/valuation-batch.service.ts:264](../../gai-backend/src/modules/inventory-operations/application/valuation-batch.service.ts#L264)

```ts
async preview(
    p: number,
    dto: PreviewValuationBatchDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.ds.transaction(async (m) => {
      const project = await this.project(m, p, actor, true);
      const fingerprint = hash(canonical({ actor: actor.id, request: dto }));
      const existing = await m.getRepository(ValuationBatch).findOneBy({
        projectId: p,
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        commandKey: dto.command_key,
      });
      if (existing) {
        if (existing.fingerprint !== fingerprint)
          conflict('Chave idempotente já utilizada por outro conteúdo/ator.');
        return this.response(m, existing);
      }
      const items = await this.selected(m, project, dto.selection, true);
      if (dto.mode === 'individual') {
        const ids = dto.values?.map((v) => v.inventory_item_id) ?? [];
        if (
          ids.length !== items.length ||
          new Set(ids).size !== ids.length ||
          ids.some((id) => !items.some((i) => i.id === id))
        )
          throw new BadRequestException(
            'Valores individualizados devem corresponder exatamente aos itens selecionados, sem duplicação.',
          );
      } else if (dto.values?.length)
        throw new BadRequestException(
          'Valores individualizados não são aceitos no modo comum.',
        );
      const rows: Array<{
        snapshot: ValuationItemSnapshot;
        proposed: ReturnType<typeof valuationValues>;
      }> = [];
      for (const item of items) {
        const values =
          dto.mode === 'individual'
            ? dto.values!.find((v) => v.inventory_item_id === item.id)
            : null;
        rows.push({
          snapshot: await this.snapshot(m, item),
          proposed: valuationValues({
            ...dto.common,
            ...(values
              ? {
                  new_value: values.new_value ?? null,
                  used_value: values.used_value ?? null,
                }
              : {}),
          }),
        });
      }
      const previewHash = hash(rows);
      const batch = await m.getRepository(ValuationBatch).save({
        organizationId: project.organizationId,
        projectId: p,
        commandKey: dto.command_key,
        fingerprint,
        previewHash,
        request: dto,
        status: 'preview',
        revision: 1,
        total: rows.length,
        createdById: actor.id,
        createdAt: new Date(),
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60 * 1000),
      });
      await m.getRepository(ValuationBatchRow).save(
        rows.map((row) => ({
          batchId: batch.id,
          organizationId: project.organizationId,
          projectId: p,
          inventoryItemId: row.snapshot.id,
          ...row,
          valuationId: null,
        })),
      );
      return this.response(m, batch);
    });
  }
```

```ts
async selection(
    p: number,
    selection: ValuationSelectionDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
  ) {
    return this.ds.transaction(async (m) => {
      const project = await this.project(m, p, actor);

        project: { id: project.id, name: project.name },

        total: items.length,
        items: snapshots,
      };
    });
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/projects/application/services/project-registration.service.ts:38](../../gai-backend/src/modules/projects/application/services/project-registration.service.ts#L38)

```ts
async options(
    query: ProjectOptionsQueryDto,
    actor: ProjectActorContext,
    companiesOnly = false,
  ) {
    const organizationId = this.scope.resolveOrganizationForCreate(
      actor,
      query.organization_id,
    );
    if (
      !(await this.companies.manager.getRepository(OrganizationEntity).exists({
        where: { id: organizationId, status: OrganizationStatus.ACTIVE },
      }))
    ) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'PROJECT_INVALID_CONTEXT',
        message: 'Organização indisponível para seleção de recursos.',
      });
    }
    if (companiesOnly && query.resource === 'users')
      throw new BadRequestException('Only company options are available here');
    const resource = query.resource ?? 'companies';
    const page = query.page ?? 1,
      pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    // These endpoints intentionally return IDs and labels, never full company/user records.
    const builder =
      resource === 'users'
        ? this.users
            .createQueryBuilder('option')
            .select(['option.id', 'option.fullName', 'option.login'])
        : this.companies
            .createQueryBuilder('option')
            .select(['option.id', 'option.name']);
    builder
      .where('option.organization_id = :organizationId', { organizationId })
      .andWhere('option.status = :status', {
        status: resource === 'users' ? 'ACTIVE' : 'active',
      });
    if (query.selected_id)
      builder.andWhere('option.id = :selectedId', {
        selectedId: query.selected_id,
      });
    if (query.search)
      builder.andWhere(
        resource === 'users'
          ? '(LOWER(option.full_name) LIKE :term OR LOWER(option.login) LIKE :term)'
          : 'LOWER(option.name) LIKE :term',
        { term: `%${query.search.toLowerCase()}%` },
      );
    builder
      .orderBy('option.id', 'ASC')
      .skip((page - 1) * pageSize)
      .take(pageSize);
    const [rows, total] = await builder.getManyAndCount();
    return {
      organization_id: organizationId,
      items: rows.map((row) => ({
        id: Number(row.id),
        name: row instanceof UserEntity ? row.fullName || row.login : row.name,
      })),
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
      total_items: total,
      total_pages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    };
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async execute(
    query: ListUsersQueryDto,
    actor: ActorContext,
  ): Promise<UserListResponseDto> {
    const page = query.page ?? 1;
    const pageSize = query.page_size ?? 20;
    const organizationId = this.scope.assertCanFilterByOrganization(
      actor,
      query.organization_id,
    );

    const { items, total } = await this.repository.list({
      page,
      pageSize,
      sortBy: query.sort_by,
      sortOrder: query.sort_order,
      organizationId,
      status: query.status,
      role: query.role,
      search: query.search,
      roleId: query.role_id,
      scope: query.scope,
    });

    const assignmentMap = await this.assignments.findActiveByUserIds(
      items.map((user) => user.id),
    );

    const totalPages = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(total / pageSize);

    return {
      data: items.map((user) =>
        UserResponseDto.fromDomain(user, assignmentMap.get(user.id) ?? []),
      ),
      meta: {
        page,
        page_size: pageSize,
        total,
        total_pages: totalPages,
      },
    };
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async execute(id: number, actor: ActorContext): Promise<UserResponseDto> {
    const user = await this.repository.findById(id);
    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'User not found',
      });
    }

    this.scope.assertCanAccessUser(actor, user);
    const roleAssignments = await this.assignments.findActiveByUserId(user.id);
    return UserResponseDto.fromDomain(user, roleAssignments);
  }
```

[gai-backend/src/modules/users/application/services/user-lifecycle.service.ts:293](../../gai-backend/src/modules/users/application/services/user-lifecycle.service.ts#L293)

```ts
async setStatus(id: number, status: UserStatus, actor: ActorContext) {
    const saved = await identityTransaction(this.db, async (manager) => {
      await lockAccessAdministration(manager);
      await assertCurrentAccessAdministrator(manager, actor);
      const user = await lockUser(manager, id);
      if (!user) throw new NotFoundException();
      this.scope.assertCanAccessUser(actor, new ManagedUser(user));
      if (
        user.status === UserStatus.PENDING_ACTIVATION &&
        status === UserStatus.ACTIVE
      )
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'CONFLICT',
          message: 'A ativação depende do convite e da definição de senha.',
        });
      if (status === UserStatus.ACTIVE)
        await assertActiveAccessOrganization(manager, user.organizationId);
      if (status !== UserStatus.ACTIVE)
        await assertAdministratorSurvives(manager, user, []);
      const before = user.status;
      user.status = status;
      user.authVersion++;
      user.failedLoginAttempts = 0;
      user.lockedUntil = null;
      await manager.getRepository(UserEntity).save(user);
      await manager
        .getRepository(SessionEntity)
        .update({ userId: id, revokedAt: IsNull() }, { revokedAt: new Date() });
      await manager
        .getRepository(PasswordResetTokenEntity)
        .update({ userId: id, usedAt: IsNull() }, { usedAt: new Date() });
      await manager.getRepository(UserAuditLogEntity).save({
        userId: id,
        operation:
          status === UserStatus.ACTIVE
            ? 'ACTIVATE'
            : status === UserStatus.INACTIVE
              ? 'DEACTIVATE'
              : 'BLOCK',
        performedBy: actor.id,
        changes: { status: { before, after: status } },
      });
      return user;
    });
    return this.response(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async resend(id: number, actor: ActorContext) {
    const { user, token } = await identityTransaction(
      this.db,
      async (manager) => {
        await lockAccessAdministration(manager);
        await assertCurrentAccessAdministrator(manager, actor);
        const user = await lockUser(manager, id);
        if (!user) throw new NotFoundException();
        this.scope.assertCanAccessUser(actor, new ManagedUser(user));
        if (user.status !== UserStatus.PENDING_ACTIVATION)
          throw new ConflictException({
            code: 'CONFLICT',
            message: 'A conta não está pendente de ativação.',
          });
        await this.credentials.assertEligible(manager, user, true);
        return {
          user,
          token: await this.credentials.issueToken(manager, user, 'INVITATION'),
        };
      },
    );
    return { invitation_delivery: await this.deliver(user, token, actor) };
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async resetPassword(id: number, password: string, actor: ActorContext) {
    const hash = await this.hasher.hash(Password.create(password).getValue());
    await identityTransaction(this.db, async (manager) => {
      await lockAccessAdministration(manager);
      await assertCurrentAccessAdministrator(manager, actor);
      const user = await lockUser(manager, id);
      if (!user) throw new NotFoundException();
      this.scope.assertCanAccessUser(actor, new ManagedUser(user));
      if (user.status === UserStatus.PENDING_ACTIVATION)
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'CONFLICT',
          message: 'Reenvie o convite para uma conta pendente.',
        });
      await this.credentials.replacePassword(manager, user, hash, true);
      await manager.getRepository(UserAuditLogEntity).save({
        userId: id,
        performedBy: actor.id,
        operation: 'PASSWORD_RESET',
        changes: { password: { before: '[redacted]', after: '[redacted]' } },
      });
    });
    return {
      message:
        'Senha temporária definida. As sessões foram encerradas; a troca será exigida no próximo acesso.',
    };
  }
```

</details>

[gai-backend/src/modules/users/application/use-cases/assign-user-role.use-case.ts:41](../../gai-backend/src/modules/users/application/use-cases/assign-user-role.use-case.ts#L41)

```ts
async execute(
    userId: number,
    dto: AssignUserRoleDto,
    actor: ActorContext,
  ): Promise<RoleAssignmentResponseDto> {
    this.scope.assertCanAssignRoles(actor);

    const user = await this.users.findById(userId);
    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'User not found',
      });
    }

    this.scope.assertCanAccessUser(actor, user);

    const role = await this.roleRepo.findOne({ where: { id: dto.role_id } });
    if (!role || !role.isActive) {
      throw new BadRequestException({
        code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
        message: 'Validation failed',
        details: [{ field: 'role_id', message: 'Invalid or inactive role' }],
      });
    }

    if (
      role.type === RoleType.SYSTEM &&
      role.key === UserRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN &&
      !actor.systemRoles.includes(UserRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN)
    ) {
      throw new ConflictException({
        code: 'FORBIDDEN',
        message: 'Insufficient permissions',
      });
    }

    try {
      this.scope.assertCanAssignRole(actor, user.organizationId, {
        type: role.type,
        key: role.key,
        organizationId: role.organizationId,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn({
        operation: 'ASSIGN_USER_ROLE',
        actorId: actor.id,
        userId,
        roleId: dto.role_id,
        result: 'DENIED_SCOPE',
      });
      throw error;
    }

    // Idempotency and authoritative scope checks run under the same DB lock.
    const saved = await this.assignments.assign({
      userId,
      roleId: dto.role_id,
      assignedBy: actor.id,
      actor,
    });

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'ASSIGN_USER_ROLE',
      userId,
      roleId: dto.role_id,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });

    return RoleAssignmentResponseDto.fromAssignedRole(saved);
  }
```

</details>

```ts
async replace(userId: number, roleIds: number[], actor: ActorContext) {
    this.scope.assertCanAssignRoles(actor);
    const user = await this.db
      .getRepository(UserEntity)
      .findOneBy({ id: userId });
    if (!user)
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'User not found',
      });
    this.scope.assertPlatformOnlyAssignment(actor, user.organizationId);
    this.scope.assertCanFilterByOrganization(
      actor,
      user.organizationId ?? undefined,
    );
    await this.assignments.replace(userId, roleIds, actor);
    return (await this.assignments.findActiveByUserId(userId)).map(
      (assignment) => RoleAssignmentResponseDto.fromAssignedRole(assignment),
    );
  }
```

<details><summary>Implementação chamada: RevokeUserRoleAssignmentUseCase.execute</summary>

[gai-backend/src/modules/users/application/use-cases/revoke-user-role-assignment.use-case.ts:33](../../gai-backend/src/modules/users/application/use-cases/revoke-user-role-assignment.use-case.ts#L33)

```ts
async execute(
    userId: number,
    assignmentId: number,
    actor: ActorContext,
  ): Promise<void> {
    this.scope.assertCanAssignRoles(actor);

    const user = await this.users.findById(userId);
    if (!user) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'User not found',
      });
    }

    this.scope.assertCanAccessUser(actor, user);

    const activeAssignments =
      await this.assignments.findAllActiveByUserId(userId);
    const target = activeAssignments.find(
      (item) => item.assignmentId === assignmentId,
    );
    if (!target) {
      throw new NotFoundException({
        code: 'NOT_FOUND',
        message: 'Role assignment not found',
      });
    }

    this.scope.assertCanRevokeRole(actor, user.organizationId, {
      type: target.roleType,
      key: target.roleKey,
      organizationId: target.organizationId,
    });

    if (
      target.roleType === RoleType.SYSTEM &&
      target.roleKey === UserRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN
    ) {
      const others = await this.assignments.countActiveUsersWithSystemRole(
        UserRole.PLATFORM_ADMIN,
        userId,
      );
      if (others === 0) {
        throw new ConflictException({
          code: 'CONFLICT',
          message: 'Cannot revoke the last active PLATFORM_ADMIN assignment',
        });
      }
    }

    await this.assignments.revoke(assignmentId, new Date(), actor);

    this.logger.info({
      operation: 'REVOKE_USER_ROLE',
      userId,
      assignmentId,
      result: 'SUCCESS',
    });
  }
```

</details>

```ts
  @ApiProperty() total_rows!: number;

  @ApiProperty() success_rows!: number;

  finished_at!: string | null;
  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  updated_at!: string;

  static fromDomain(
    batch: AccountingImportBatch,

      finished_at: props.finishedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      created_at: props.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updated_at: props.updatedAt.toISOString(),

}
```

```ts
  category!: string | null;

      created_at: catalogAsset.createdAt.toISOString(),

}
```

```ts
  organization_id!: number;

  @ApiProperty()
  name!: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  corporate_name!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  document!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  state_registration!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  municipal_registration!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  email!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  phone!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  zipcode!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  address!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  number!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  complement!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  district!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  city!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  state!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  country!: string | null;

  @ApiProperty({ enum: CompanyStatus })
  status!: CompanyStatus;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: 'object', additionalProperties: true })
  metadata!: JsonRecord | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64', nullable: true })
  created_by_id!: number | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64', nullable: true })
  updated_by_id!: number | null;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  created_at!: string;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  updated_at!: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ format: 'date-time', nullable: true })
  deleted_at!: string | null;

  static fromEntity(entity: CompanyEntity): CompanyResponseDto {
    return {
      id: Number(entity.id),
      organization_id: Number(entity.organizationId),
      name: entity.name,
      corporate_name: entity.corporateName,
      document: entity.document,
      state_registration: entity.stateRegistration,
      municipal_registration: entity.municipalRegistration,
      email: entity.email,
      phone: entity.phone,
      zipcode: entity.zipcode,
      address: entity.address,
      number: entity.number,
      complement: entity.complement,
      district: entity.district,
      city: entity.city,
      state: entity.state,
      country: entity.country,
      status: entity.status,
      metadata: entity.metadata,
      created_by_id:
        entity.createdById === null ? null : Number(entity.createdById),
      updated_by_id:
        entity.updatedById === null ? null : Number(entity.updatedById),
      created_at: entity.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updated_at: entity.updatedAt.toISOString(),
      deleted_at: entity.deletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
  full_name!: string;
  @ApiProperty()
  @NormalizedIdentifier()
  @IsString()

      'Login: use de 3 a 100 letras, números, ponto, hífen ou sublinhado, sem @ ou espaços.',
  })
  login!: string;
  @ApiProperty()
  @NormalizedIdentifier()

  @Trimmed()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(120)

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  @ValidateIf((_o, v) => v !== undefined && v !== null)
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  organization_id?: number | null;
  @ApiProperty({ type: [Number] })
  @IsArray()
  @ArrayMinSize(1)
  @ArrayUnique()
  @IsInt({ each: true })
  @Min(1, { each: true })

  @IsIn(['INVITATION', 'TEMPORARY_PASSWORD'])
  activation_method!: 'INVITATION' | 'TEMPORARY_PASSWORD';
  @ApiPropertyOptional({
    minLength: Password.MIN_LENGTH,
    maxLength: Password.MAX_LENGTH,

}
```

### CurrentUserDto

[gai-backend/src/modules/auth/application/dto/login-response.dto.ts:15](../../gai-backend/src/modules/auth/application/dto/login-response.dto.ts#L15)

```ts
export class CurrentUserDto {
  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  id!: number;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) full_name!: string | null;
  @ApiProperty() must_change_password!: boolean;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'platform.admin' })
  login!: string;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'email', example: 'admin@gai.local' })
  email!: string;

  @ApiProperty({ enum: UserStatus })
  status!: UserStatus;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64', nullable: true })
  organization_id!: number | null;

  @ApiProperty({ type: [RoleAssignmentResponseDto] })
  role_assignments!: RoleAssignmentResponseDto[];

  @ApiProperty({ type: [CurrentUserPermissionDto] })
  permissions!: CurrentUserPermissionDto[];

  static fromUser(user: {
    id: number;
    fullName?: string | null;
    mustChangePassword?: boolean;
    login: string;
    email: string;
    status: UserStatus;
    organizationId: number | null;
    roleAssignments: RoleAssignmentResponseDto[];
    permissions: ResolvedPermission[];
  }): CurrentUserDto {
    return {
      id: user.id,
      full_name: user.fullName ?? null,
      must_change_password: user.mustChangePassword ?? false,
```

```ts
export class ExportJobResponseDto {
  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  id!: number;

  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  organization_id!: number;

  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  project_id!: number;

  @ApiProperty({ enum: ExportJobType })
  type!: ExportJobType;

  @ApiProperty({ enum: ExportJobStatus })
  status!: ExportJobStatus;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  file_name!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  mime_type!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64', nullable: true })
  size_bytes!: number | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  checksum!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64', nullable: true })
  requested_by_id!: number | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64', nullable: true })
  retry_of_id!: number | null;

  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', minimum: 1 })
  attempt_count!: number;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  requested_at!: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ format: 'date-time', nullable: true })
  started_at!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ format: 'date-time', nullable: true })
  finished_at!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ format: 'date-time', nullable: true })
  expires_at!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  error_code!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  error_message!: string | null;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  created_at!: string;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  updated_at!: string;

  static fromEntity(entity: ExportJobEntity): ExportJobResponseDto {
    return {
      id: Number(entity.id),
      organization_id: Number(entity.organizationId),
      project_id: Number(entity.projectId),
      type: entity.type,
      status: entity.status,
      file_name: entity.fileName,
      mime_type: entity.mimeType,
      size_bytes: entity.sizeBytes === null ? null : Number(entity.sizeBytes),
      checksum: entity.checksum,
      requested_by_id:
        entity.requestedById === null ? null : Number(entity.requestedById),
      retry_of_id: entity.retryOfId === null ? null : Number(entity.retryOfId),
      attempt_count: Number(entity.attemptCount),
      requested_at: iso(entity.requestedAt)!,
      started_at: iso(entity.startedAt),
      finished_at: iso(entity.finishedAt),
      expires_at: iso(entity.expiresAt),
      error_code: entity.errorCode,
      error_message: entity.errorMessage,
      created_at: iso(entity.createdAt)!,
      updated_at: iso(entity.updatedAt)!,
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  updated_at!: string;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ format: 'date-time', nullable: true })
  deleted_at!: string | null;

  static fromDomain(
    item: InventoryAccountingItem,
  ): InventoryAccountingItemResponseDto {
    const props = item.toProps();
    return {
      id: props.id,
      organization_id: props.organizationId,
      project_id: props.projectId,
      plate: props.plate,
      description: props.description,
      accounting_account_description: props.accountingAccountDescription,
      location: props.location,
      serial_number: props.serialNumber ?? null,
      acquisition_date:

      base_code: props.baseCode,

      investor_code: props.investorCode,

      metadata: props.metadata,
      imported_by_id: props.importedById,

      created_at: props.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updated_at: props.updatedAt.toISOString(),
      deleted_at: props.deletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
export class PaymentResponseDto {
  @ApiProperty() id!: number;
  @ApiProperty() organization_id!: number;
  @ApiProperty() project_id!: number;
  @ApiProperty() field_agent_id!: number;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) state!: string | null;
  @ApiProperty() start_date!: string;
  @ApiProperty() end_date!: string;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) payment_date!: string | null;
  @ApiProperty() days!: number;
  @ApiProperty() daily_rate!: string;
  @ApiProperty() additional_amount!: string;
  @ApiProperty() daily_total!: string;
  @ApiProperty() discount_amount!: string;
  @ApiProperty() final_amount!: string;
  @ApiProperty({ enum: PaymentStatus }) status!: PaymentStatus;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) notes!: string | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({
    type: 'object',
    additionalProperties: true,
    nullable: true,
  })
  metadata!: JsonRecord | null;
  @ApiProperty() created_at!: string;
  @ApiProperty() updated_at!: string;
  static fromDomain(p: FieldAgentPayment): PaymentResponseDto {
    const x = p.toProps();
    return {
      id: x.id,
      organization_id: x.organizationId,
      project_id: x.projectId,
      field_agent_id: x.fieldAgentId,
      state: x.state,
      start_date: x.startDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      end_date: x.endDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      payment_date: x.paymentDate?.toISOString().slice(0, 10) ?? null,
      days: x.days,
      daily_rate: x.dailyRate,
      additional_amount: x.additionalAmount,
      daily_total: x.dailyTotal,
      discount_amount: x.discountAmount,
      final_amount: x.finalAmount,
      status: x.status,
      notes: x.notes,
      metadata: x.metadata,
      created_at: x.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updated_at: x.updatedAt.toISOString(),
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
export class ProjectFieldAgentResponseDto {
  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  id!: number;

  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  organization_id!: number;

  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  project_id!: number;

  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  field_agent_id!: number;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  role!: string | null;

  @ApiProperty({ enum: ProjectFieldAgentStatus })
  status!: ProjectFieldAgentStatus;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ format: 'date', nullable: true })
  start_date!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ format: 'date', nullable: true })
  end_date!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  notes!: string | null;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  created_at!: string;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  updated_at!: string;

  static fromDomain(
    assignment: ProjectFieldAgent,
  ): ProjectFieldAgentResponseDto {
    return {
      id: assignment.id,
      organization_id: assignment.organizationId,
      project_id: assignment.projectId,
      field_agent_id: assignment.fieldAgentId,
      role: assignment.role,
      status: assignment.status,
      start_date: assignment.startDate
        ? assignment.startDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
        : null,
      end_date: assignment.endDate
        ? assignment.endDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
        : null,
      notes: assignment.notes,
      created_at: assignment.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updated_at: assignment.updatedAt.toISOString(),
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
export class ProjectResponseDto {
  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  id!: number;

  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  organization_id!: number;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64', nullable: true })
  company_id!: number | null;

  @ApiProperty()
  name!: string;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) code!: string | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ enum: ProjectType, nullable: true })
  project_type!: ProjectType | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) responsible_user_id!: number | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) planning_responsible_user_id!:
    | number
    | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) planning_notes!: string | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) company_name!: string | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) responsible_user_name!:
    | string
    | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) planning_responsible_user_name!:
    | string
    | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true })
  description!: string | null;

  @ApiProperty({ enum: ProjectStatus })
  status!: ProjectStatus;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ format: 'date', nullable: true })
  start_date!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ format: 'date', nullable: true })
  end_date!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ format: 'date-time', nullable: true })
  finished_at!: string | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({
    type: 'object',
    additionalProperties: true,
    nullable: true,
  })
  settings!: JsonRecord | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({
    type: 'object',
    additionalProperties: true,
    nullable: true,
  })
  metadata!: JsonRecord | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64', nullable: true })
  created_by_id!: number | null;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64', nullable: true })
  updated_by_id!: number | null;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  created_at!: string;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  updated_at!: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ format: 'date-time', nullable: true })
  deleted_at!: string | null;

  @ApiProperty({ type: [ProjectAvailableActionDto] })
  available_actions!: ProjectAvailableActionDto[];

  static fromDomain(project: Project): ProjectResponseDto {
    return {
      id: project.id,
      organization_id: project.organizationId,
      company_id: project.companyId,
      name: project.name,
      code: project.code,
      project_type: project.projectType,
      responsible_user_id: project.responsibleUserId,
      planning_responsible_user_id: project.planningResponsibleUserId,
      planning_notes: project.planningNotes,
      company_name: project.companyName,
      responsible_user_name: project.responsibleUserName,
      planning_responsible_user_name: project.planningResponsibleUserName,
      description: project.description,
      status: project.status,
      start_date: project.startDate
        ? project.startDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
        : null,
      end_date: project.endDate
        ? project.endDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10)
        : null,
      finished_at: project.finishedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      settings: project.settings,
      metadata: project.metadata,
      created_by_id: project.createdById,
      updated_by_id: project.updatedById,
      created_at: project.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updated_at: project.updatedAt.toISOString(),
      deleted_at: project.deletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      available_actions: ProjectStatusTransitionPolicy.availableActions(
        project.status,
      ),
    };
  }
}
```

```ts
export class ProjectUnitResponseDto {

  id!: number;

  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  organization_id!: number;

  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  project_id!: number;

  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  company_unit_id!: number;

  @ApiProperty({ type: CompanyUnitResponseDto })
  company_unit!: CompanyUnitResponseDto;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  created_at!: string;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  updated_at!: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ format: 'date-time', nullable: true })
  deleted_at!: string | null;

  static fromEntity(
    entity: ProjectUnitEntity,
    companyUnit: CompanyUnitEntity,
  ): ProjectUnitResponseDto {
    return {
      id: Number(entity.id),
      organization_id: Number(entity.organizationId),
      project_id: Number(entity.projectId),
      company_unit_id: Number(entity.companyUnitId),
      company_unit: CompanyUnitResponseDto.fromEntity(companyUnit),
      created_at: entity.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updated_at: entity.updatedAt.toISOString(),
      deleted_at: entity.deletedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    };
  }
}
```

### UserResponseDto

[gai-backend/src/modules/users/application/dto/user-response.dto.ts:42](../../gai-backend/src/modules/users/application/dto/user-response.dto.ts#L42)

```ts
export class UserResponseDto {
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) full_name!: string | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) phone!: string | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) job_title!: string | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) organization_name!: string | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) last_login_at!: string | null;
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ nullable: true }) locked_until!: string | null;
  @ApiProperty() must_change_password!: boolean;
  @ApiProperty({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64' })
  id!: number;

  @ApiProperty()
  login!: string;

  @ApiProperty()
  email!: string;

  @ApiProperty({ enum: UserStatus })
  status!: UserStatus;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: 'integer', format: 'int64', nullable: true })
  organization_id!: number | null;

  @ApiProperty({ type: [RoleAssignmentResponseDto] })
  role_assignments!: RoleAssignmentResponseDto[];

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  created_at!: string;

  @ApiProperty({ format: 'date-time' })
  updated_at!: string;

  static fromDomain(
    user: ManagedUser,
    roleAssignments: AssignedRole[] = [],
  ): UserResponseDto {
    return {
      id: user.id,
      full_name: user.fullName,
      phone: user.phone,
      job_title: user.jobTitle,
      last_login_at: user.lastLoginAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      locked_until: user.lockedUntil?.toISOString() ?? null,
      must_change_password: user.mustChangePassword,
      organization_name: user.organizationName,
      login: user.login,
      email: user.email,
      status: user.status,
      organization_id: user.organizationId,
      role_assignments: roleAssignments.map((assignment) =>
        RoleAssignmentResponseDto.fromAssignedRole(assignment),
      ),
      created_at: user.createdAt.toISOString(),
      updated_at: user.updatedAt.toISOString(),
    };
  }
}
```
